1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E02 - Dead Lots of Times
1.plot: Blythe's team heads to Mexico to pull off a daring mission for a deadly cartel in exchange for information on the shipment at the port.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E03 - Happy Birthday Final
1.plot: The team stages a high stakes prison break in an attempt to gain knowledge on the identity and whereabouts of the mysterious Volchek.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E04 - Bite 'Em Down
1.plot: Still reeling from their loss, the team tracks down Timur Novikov's uncle, Mikhail… and hatches a plan to lure Volchek out into the open.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E05 - Blurred Edges
1.plot: The team pays a visit to the Belarusian consulate in search of files that could finally reveal who Volchek is… and how far he's willing to go.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E06 - A Needle or a Bullet
1.plot: The team follows a new lead out to the California desert, where their suspect isn't going down without a fight. Meanwhile, Volchek initiates the next phase of his plan.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E07 - Nothing Else Helps
1.plot: While the team splits up to pursue a trio of new leads, consul general Astapov's security detail attempts to persuade Volchek to abandon his plans... by force.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E08 - The Nail in the Chair
1.plot: The team races to try and catch Volchek as he begins to deploy his weapons of mass destruction around Los Angeles.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E09 - 10-33
1.plot: With their leader fighting for his life and Meachum's medical condition worsening by the minute, the team finally comes face to face with the true nature of their enemy's plans as time is running out to stop him.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E10 - The Muzzle Pile
1.plot: The task force violently confronts Volchek to save a city of millions. As the smoke clears and Meachum works to resolve his medical issues, a new threat emerges from Secret Service agent Ryan Fitzgerald.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E11 - Run
1.plot: Shepherd works to decipher the manifesto recovered at Cabin 6 while the rest of the team pursues a suspect on the run.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E12 - This Is His Signature
1.plot: As another death ratchets up the pressure, the team makes a startling new discovery about their suspect.

1.title: FR - Compte à rebours - S01E13 - Your People Are in Danger
1.plot: The team zeroes in on a suspect and moves for a take-down... but soon find one of their own in grave danger.

meta.plot: Quand un agent de la Sécurité intérieure est tué, l’inspecteur de police Mark Meachum est intégré dans une cellule spéciale secrète, composée d’agents en civil provenant de divers services de police, afin d’enquêter. La traque du meurtrier révèle un complot bien plus sinistre qu'on aurait pu l’imaginer, entraînant une course contre la montre pour sauver une ville de millions d’habitants.

1.title: FR - Ironheart - S01E01 - Take Me Home
1.plot: Determined to complete her newest armored suit, Riri Williams teams up with Parker Robbins.

1.title: FR - Ironheart - S01E02 - Will the Real Natalie Please Stand Up?
1.plot: Riri's new A.I. dredges up painful memories ahead of her first heist with Parker and his crew.

1.title: FR - Ironheart - S01E03 - We in Danger, Girl
1.plot: Riri is uncomfortable being part of Parker's crew—two more heists, max, and she's out, she promises.

1.title: FR - Ironheart - S01E04 - Bad Magic
1.plot: When Parker suspects Riri of wrongdoing, she knows she has to figure out the source of his powers.

1.title: FR - Ironheart - S01E05 - Karma's a Glitch
1.plot: Riri sets out to create a suit unlike anything she has ever attempted—but at what cost?

1.title: FR - Ironheart - S01E06 - The Past Is the Past
1.plot: Riri builds her most powerful suit yet, but she's unsure if it's enough to beat Parker and The Hood.

meta.plot: De retour à Chicago, Riri Williams, inventrice de génie, rencontre Parker Robbins, alias The Hood.

meta.plot: Un petit village du Burkina vit au rythme des traditions qui l'animent. Loin des tourments des grandes villes, les affres de la modernité s'insinuent dans la vie des habitants.

1.title: FR - Apocalypse, Les débarquements - S01E01 - The Great Challenge
1.plot: Spring 1944: the Allies want to put an end to Hitler's domination of Western Europe. In England, the troops are secretly training for an amphibious operation. The weather forces the commanders to postpone the operation.

1.title: FR - Apocalypse, Les débarquements - S01E02 - The Great Assault
1.plot: On 6 June 1944, the Allied armada launched an assault on the Normandy coast. After a day of unrest, the Normandy coastline was in the hands of the Allies. The operation was repeated in Provence, and caught the Germans in a vice-like grip.

meta.plot: À l’aube du 6 juin, des milliers de navires se lancent à l’assaut des côtes normandes pour le plus grand débarquement de l’Histoire. Deux mois plus tard, la première armée française débarque à son tour en Provence pour prendre en tenaille les Allemands en déroute.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E01 - Go For Launch!
1.plot: After being stranded on a mysterious Island, Mia, Buddy, Rosie, and Hamylton must overcome their differences in order to find a way home.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E02 - Gim(Mia) Shelter
1.plot: The gang decides to build a shelter, but Mia lets her designer skills go to her head.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E03 - The Egg-splorers
1.plot: When the gang finds an unhatched egg, they venture deep into the jungle to find its family.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E04 - The Worm Turns
1.plot: The gang builds a raft to sail home, but their departure is disrupted by a seismic force.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E05 - Phone-y Business
1.plot: The gang finds an old cell phone, but must get creative to send a message home.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E06 - Truffled Feathers
1.plot: Mia and Hamylton face off in a cooking competition, but Hamy discovers a secret ingredient to sniff out a victory.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E07 - On Island Time
1.plot: After making a powerful wish, Mia finds herself stuck repeating every day.

1.title: FR - Angry Birds, l'île mystérieuse - S01E08 - Chums in the Water
1.plot: Rosie makes a new friend who might be the gang’s best hope of making it home.

meta.plot: Les oiseaux, Mia, Rosie et Buddy, ainsi qu'un porcelet nommé Hamylton, sont catapultés par erreur sur une île inconnue. Afin de rentrer chez eux, ils devront percer ensemble les mystères de ce terrain.

En 1971, quatre femmes défient les lois ultraconservatrices et rejoignent les premières forces de police féminines du Mexique. Elles comprennent alors qu’il s’agit d’un simple coup de pub pour détourner l’attention d’un tueur en série. Alors que le nombre de victimes augmente, elles font le serment de traduire le coupable en justice.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E01 - María
1.plot: As a serial killer targeting women terrorizes the city, María, Valentina, Gabina, and Ángeles join the first female police force.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E02 - Paola
1.plot: María and the other Azules stumble upon a new victim of the Undresser and watch as a man they believe is innocent gets arrested.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E03 - Norma
1.plot: Dissatisfied with the detectives' conclusions, the Azules conduct their own investigation off the books.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E04 - Alma
1.plot: Another Undresser victim is found, confirming the Azules' suspicions. Their investigation points detectives to a new suspect.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E05 - Ángeles
1.plot: Romandía gets pulled into the investigation as the Azules uncover a clue that may reveal the Undresser's identity.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E06 - Laura
1.plot: The detectives take drastic measures to find answers. María seeks the help of someone who can offer new insight: a convicted serial killer.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E07 - Dora
1.plot: The Azules turn their attention to unsolved murders, hoping to find a connection to the Undresser.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E08 - Rosa
1.plot: María and Ángeles interview the adopted son of a woman named Rosa, who the Azules believe may have been the Undresser's first victim.

1.title: FR - Las Azules : la brigade bleue - S01E09 - Gabina
1.plot: The Azules work with the detectives to stage a trap for the man they think is the Undresser—but things don't go as planned.

meta.plot: Fanny Legoff, biologiste reconnue et admirée, vit depuis plus de quinze ans à Paris, après avoir quitté la fac de Paimpont pendant ses études à la suite de la disparition de sa meilleure amie Laura, pour laquelle elle avait été soupçonnée. Lorsque Fanny reçoit un colis contenant une serpe recouverte de sang séché et une lettre l’accusant à nouveau d’être la responsable de la disparition de Laura, elle décide de revenir dans sa région natale, quinze ans après le drame.

FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - I Want to be Popular
1.plot: When his boss Reigen calls, Mob helps him out even though he doesn't want to. His attempt to talk to his crush Tsubomi fails, too.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Read the Room
1.plot: Mob confides to his brother that he wants to get muscular and date Tsubomi, but a number of people tell him to work on his social skills instead.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Collapse
1.plot: The cult leader tries to compel Mob to laugh, but with Mob's emotions already at 99%, he ends up touching off a psychic battle.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The Gifted One
1.plot: Dimple's spirit attaches himself to Mob, offering commentary on his life. Fake letters embroil Mob and the Body Improvement Club in a turf war.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Like Looking at Trash
1.plot: The secret boss of Kurozu Middle School appears: known as Teru, he's a powerful psychic who attempts to goad Mob into a psychic showdown.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Conclusion
1.plot: With his emotions driven up to 100%, Mob finally fights back against Teru. But his outburst attracts the attention of a research group.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Awakening Lab
1.plot: Ritsu visits Awakening Lab, whose boss claims to be able to enhance psychic powers. Mob realizes the truth about "White T Poison."

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Aberration
1.plot: Dimple convinces Ritsu to join up with him, enhancing Ritsu's powers. When he turns on the high school tough guys, Ritsu becomes quite popular.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - The Will to Destruct
1.plot: Ritsu turns on Mob, but a member of the mysterious Claw shows up and attacks Mob too. Meanwhile, Reigen's new client is one of his old colleagues.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Incursion
1.plot: Working together, Mob and Teru head to Awakening Lab. Meanwhile, Ritsu and the other kidnapped espers plan an escape from the clutches of Claw.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - No Control
1.plot: Members of Claw brainwash the Shiratori boys into hunting Ritsu and the others through the school while Mob and Teru try to find and save them.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Still Not Popular
1.plot: The real boss of Claw arrives. Reigen joins Mob, Teru and Ritsu in facing him and his underlings down in one final psychic battle.

meta.plot:
Kageyama Shigeo, élève de deuxième année au collège, n'a pas vraiment de bonnes notes en classe, n'est pas non plus bon en sport et n'a pas spécialement de copain. Amoureux de son amie d'enfance Tsubomi qui ne n'en aperçoit pas, Shigeo a quand même un atout insoupçonné dans sa poche : il dispose de puissants pouvoirs surnaturels.

Il évite cependant de les utiliser mais l'apparition d'autres personnes avec des super-pouvoirs et de mauvaises intentions va le pousser à forcer sa nature.

meta.plot: MOAH. Différent. Une mère qui s’inquiète un peu trop. Un père absent. Un chef qui n’écoute jamais ses idées. Des acolytes jaloux et méchants. Zéro perspective d’évolution. Puis il y a ce logement dans une zone à risque. Cette belle étrangère qui ne le remarque pas. Des voisins terriblement dangereux. Bref, la vie de MOAH est compliquée. Et le fait que ce soit il y a 45.000 ans n’arrange pas vraiment les choses.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E01 - Shelter From The Storm
1.plot: After the death of her parents, Jax matriculates at the Fleet Training Academy on Earth where she learns to defend the Galaxy from intergalactic threats and makes a new family of friends, but also makes a shocking discovery about her own identity.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E02 - Chimes of Freedom
1.plot: When Atria Nine learns that Adari leader, Seeker Creston Hubbell, will be speaking on campus, she enlists the help of Jax and the study group to stand up against her former masters to help free her clone sisters and brothers from oppression on her homeworld.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E03 - Masters of War
1.plot: A war veteran from the legendary space battle cruiser Sea Hawk makes a shocking revelation to Jax and Greg  that could lead Jax to discover who actually killed her parents.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E04 - I Shall Be Released
1.plot: Jax joins Xander and her fellow cadets in responding to an emergency distress call from a secret lab, only to discover that a deadly experiment has infected the scientists and the cadets.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E05 - Most Likely You Go Your Way (And I'll Go Mine)
1.plot: Thomas's telepathic father arrives on campus and tries to enlist his estranged son in a dangerous heist in which nothing is as simple as it appears.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E06 - What Was It You Wanted
1.plot: When Pilar's bio-organic implants are hacked, Jax and Ralen lead an investigation to help save their friend and find out who's responsible and stop them from continuing to torment Pilar.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E07 - Time out of Mind
1.plot: Jax discovers a deadly secret from her past that she is desperate to understand with the help of Ralen and Pilar while the CIS grows increasingly suspicious of Xander’s divided loyalties.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E08 - Under the Red Sky
1.plot: When Xander enlists Jax on a dangerous mission in which she must rekindle a relationship with an old flame, Xander, must confront his own feelings for Jax and question if all orders are meant to be obeyed.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E09 - It Ain't Me Babe
1.plot: Trapped on an alien world, Jax, Xander and Ralen are stranded with no way home. They must band together to survive, but divided loyalties threaten to destroy them from within. And Jax will ultimately be forced decide her allegiances if they make it through the long night.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E10 - Hurricane
1.plot: Ralen is on trial for his life after being accused of having sabotaged the Tereshkova. But even Jax has her doubts about Ralen's veracity when his wife arrives from Zatar to defend him.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E11 - I'll Be Your Baby Tonight
1.plot: As the Fleet Academy, students prepare to celebrate Armistice Day (the anniversary of the end of the Zatarians war), Jax continues to struggle with the revelation that Ralen is married. Meanwhile, Ralen must decide where his loyalties truly lie.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E12 - Knocking on Heaven's Door
1.plot: Jax and Xander have their hands full as a dangerous cat-and-mouse game erupts on campus. Various parties from across the galaxy arrive on Earth, all in pursuit of Jax, during which she encounters a surprise ally who not only protects Jax, but also sheds light on who she really is. Meanwhile, Atria joined by Pilar, bravely explores her new life mission on Adar, helping her clone brothers and sisters, while Thomas searches for his missing father and Ralen contemplates his return to Zatar.

1.title: FR - Pandora - S01E13 - Simple Twist of Fate
1.plot: Picking up the pieces from the attack on the Fleet Training Academy by Leone Vokk, Jax and Xander must confront Tierney to stop her sinister plans for galactic domination while Atria's grassroots movement on Adar to run for Seeker may have serious consequences for the clones as well as her friends.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Things Have Changed
2.plot: Jax and Xander try to track down a fugitive who is searching for a destructive weapon that could destroy the universe and Jax comes face-to-face with her mother.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Don't Think Twice, It's All Right
2.plot: Jax, Xander, Ralen, and Matta track the fugitives Tierney and Jax's mother, Eve, to a remote planet with a mysterious secret, only to come into the crosshairs of the planet's strange religious cult, who will stop at nothing to maintain their sinister order.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Gates of Eden
2.plot: Jax and the team visit the distant planet where Professor Osborn first discovered Jax as an infant during the Earth-Zatarian War in an attempt to find the Ancients in the hopes of saving our Universe. But is dealt a tragic blow when Ralen suffers a loss that will change him forever.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - Beyond Here Lies Nothin'
2.plot: Jax and the team go in search of a lost alien race that may be the key to saving the universe, but they find themselves plagued by disturbing nightmares that arise out of each individual's personal traumas and most personal fears.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - On a Night Like This
2.plot: Xander and Jett set out to save Ralen, who has gotten caught up in the high stakes world of an intergalactic fight club. Meanwhile, Jax is on a mission for Osborn to acquire intel from a beautiful Sumi princess who is about to get married, but finds herself falling for Jax.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Pay in Blood
2.plot: Xander, Ralen, and Jett help defend a mining colony in the Outer Rim that is under constant siege from Sumi Pirates. Meanwhile, back at the Academy, Jax is recruited by Osborn for a secret mission.

2.title: FR - Pandora [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - A Fool Such As I
2.plot: Xander, Ralen, and Jett discover and track a consignment of illegal weapons to a freighter captained by a desperate cargo pilot, Roy Scantron, where they discover the cargo is clones of dead EarthCom soldiers.

meta.plot: Pleine de ressources, Jax a dû très tôt apprendre à se débrouiller seule après le décès de ses parents. Une nouvelle vie s'offre à elle quand elle décide d'intégrer la Earth's Space Training Academy. La jeune femme y apprend à protéger et défendre la galaxie des menaces extraterrestres comme humaines. Quand des secrets sur ses origines remontent à la surface, Jax doit découvrir la vérité : sera-t-elle la sauveuse de l’humanité ou l’instrument de sa destruction ?

La police recrute d'anciens sportifs de haut niveau. Autrefois acclamés comme héros, ces champions internationaux doivent affronter la dure réalité. Malgré les difficultés matérielles, les tragédies inattendues et le mépris de leurs collègues policiers, ils luttent désormais au sein d'une force spéciale contre la grande criminalité avec le courage qui les animait au temps de leur gloire.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E01 - Our Twisted Hero
1.plot: After causing trouble, Dong-ju is demoted to the Insung Metropolitan Police Agency, where he's treated like dead weight and his fellow world-class medalists also face discrimination and scorn. But when a major case erupts, it reignites the fire in their hearts.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E02 - Faster, Further, Stronger
1.plot: At Man-sik's suggestion, a special criminal investigation team is formed with the former world-class medalists. Ready for a fresh start, each member joins with their own hopes and goals, but behind the creation of this special team lurks a hidden agenda.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E03 - Million Dollar Baby
1.plot: Convinced that Ju-yeong is the hit-and-run driver, Dong-ju scrambles to find evidence. Meanwhile, Jong-hyeon heads to the Prosecutors' Office at Man-sik's request to investigate Gyeong-il's case, and Ju-yeong meets someone in the shadows.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E04 - Float Like a Butterfly
1.plot: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is now complete with Han-na's return and Jong-hyeon joining. They launch a full-scale investigation into Gyeong-il's death and Min Ju-yeong. As they split into teams and close in on their targets, Han-na receives her father's case files.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E05 - Punch-Drunk Love
1.plot: While investigating Ju-yeong, the Special Criminal Investigation Team is forced to hand him over to the prosecution after their sudden intervention. Dong-ju is hospitalized for tests following his car accident, and the team digs deeper into Ju-yeong's true identity and his connections to the prosecution.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E06 - Counterpunch
1.plot: Using Han-na's surprise kiss as an excuse, Dong-ju heads out alone with her on an investigation and discovers Ju-yeong's burner phone. Jong-hyeon finds himself growing uneasy as Dong-ju and Han-na get closer. Meanwhile, Drugmon, under surveillance in an apartment, begins plotting her escape.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E07 - Par Terre Par Terre
1.plot: Dong-ju's assault puts the Special Criminal Investigation Team in a major crisis. Man-sik fights to keep the team together, while the others continue investigating Ju-yeong, weighed down by uncertainty. Meanwhile, Ju-yeong leaves the hospital and heads to an unknown destination.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E08 - The Aimless Bullet
FR - BON GARÇON - S01E09 - Allez
1.plot: Han-na is kidnapped, and Dong-ju and Jong-hyeon rush to rescue her, only to find themselves trapped in a deadly crisis. Just when it seems there's no way out, an unexpected gunshot rings out. With an unforeseen sacrifice shaking the team, will they survive?

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E10 - Time-out
1.plot: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is disbanded in the end. Dong-ju quietly prepares revenge against Ju-yeong alone, but his reckless move only invites a greater crisis. Catching on to his plan, Ju-yeong launches a counterstrike.

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E11 - Countdown
1.plot: The Special Criminal Investigation Team reunites and uncovers Joo-young's big secret. Frightened by Dong-joo's countdown challenge, Joo-young takes desperate measures. So who will win in the end?

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E12 - Foul
1.plot: Falling into Ju-yeong's trap, Dong-ju suffers a critical injury and faces his greatest crisis yet. Will he push through or fall where he stands?

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E13 - Load, Start...Don't Stop
1.plot: With no way to retreat, Dong-joo and the team launch their final all-out attack on Joo-young. Moving in without hesitation, they soon face a fierce counterattack and unexpected difficulties. What is written in their fate?

1.title: FR - BON GARÇON - S01E14 - Kings Never Die
FR - BON GARÇON - S01E15 - On the Ropes
1.plot: The entire Inseong police force unites and launches a massive operation against Joo-young's gang. But just when they are close to victory, Joo-young's most devastating counterattack throws the entire city into chaos.

meta.plot: Laura intègre le lycée Ichio cours d’année. Elle y rencontre Julie, sa nouvelle meilleure amie et, surtout, une bande de cinq élèves très étranges, les Joyeux Loufoques, une brochette de cancres survoltés réunis par leur physique atypique et leurs multiples redoublements. Toujours prêts à distraire leurs camarades pendant les cours, les Joyeux Loufoques font le désespoir de leur professeur, mademoiselle Hilary. Celle-ci n'hésite pas à employer la manière forte pour les punir, mais c'est souvent peine perdue.

À la station de métro Shinjuku, il suffit d'inscrire « XYZ » sur le tableau d'information pour solliciter l'aide de City Hunter, une agence de détectives privés composée de Ryo Saeba (alias Nicky Larson en VF) et Kaori Makumura (Laura). Kaori n'est autre que la sœur de l'ancien partenaire de Ryo, qu'il s'est promis de protéger après la mort de celui-ci. Alors que Ryo Saeba est extravagant, pervers et exhibitionniste, Kaori est toujours là pour essayer de calmer ses ardeurs envers la gent féminine. Malgré ce comportement, Ryo Saeba traîne toujours sa réputation d'ancien mercenaire derrière lui…

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E01 - One Cool Sweeper: XYZ is a Dangerous Cocktail
1.plot: When there is a spate of random shootings in Shinjuku, a sister of one of the victims wants Ryo to catch the killer and bring him to justice.  But Ryo can tell that there is much more than justice that his client is interested in.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E02 - Please Kill Me: Crosshairs Don't Become a Pretty Girl
1.plot: Ryo's client is a daughter of a known scientist who developed a deadly microbe that could render humanity sterile.  His client wants him to protect her at all costs while she develops a vaccine, but should she be captured, she wants him to kill her before terrorists can extract the knowledge of the microbe from her.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E03 - Love Don't Leave Me: A Ten Count to Tomorrow
1.plot: A boxer is killed over a fight for a championship title, and Ryo must deal with the victim's rival obsessed with glory.  At the same time, he must deal with the boxer's girlfriend, whose pain is not only in her heart, but also in her body as well.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E04 - Lady Vanish: Boutique of the Shadows
1.plot: Ryo's partner Hideyuki is frantic over the disappearance of her sister Kaori as a spate of abductions of women have swept Shinjuku.  As he is trying to find his partner's sister, he comes across a man who is not who he seems to be.  Together, they must find the secret into the kidnappings.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E05 - Goodbye Makimura: A Tearful Birthday on a Rainy Night
1.plot: Hideyuki is killed on Kaori's birthday as he refuses to do a request for the head of a powerful crime syndicate.  Ryo must avenge his death.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E06 - No Romance for this Actress: The Last Shot for Hope
1.plot: As Kaori takes over as Ryo's new partner, Ryo is called upon to solve a string of incidents involving actress Yumiko Sato.  As he delves deep into the mystery, he comes across a powerful adversary, as well as a client who may have a deadly death wish.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E07 - A Gunshot to set the Heart Aflutter: Sad Lonely Girl
1.plot: Ryo's client is a man who wants to fake his own death to be free from a powerful politician so he could be reunited with his daughter.  The man admits to be spineless but he is more than meets the eye.  Ryo must masquerade as the hitman not only to save his client, but to ensure that the men working for the politician do not bother his client again.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E08 - A One-Hole-Shot to a Lovely: Hands Off My Lady Detective
1.plot: A Police detective named Saeko Nogami hires Ryo to obtain a crown containing a microchip which has stolen top secret plans inside.  While Ryo agrees to do his job, he awaits his ""payment"" which leaves Kaori confused as to how this payment would be applied.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E09 - The Gambling Queen: A Bet for Wonderful Love
1.plot: Ryo must protect a lovely casino dealer as she prepares for a showdown with a rival syndicate in order to win her freedom.  Meanwhile, Ryo is pitted against a powerful gambler who exploits Ryo's weaknesses to their fullest extent.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E10 - One Dangerous Tutor: Home-Cooking from the Heart for a Sukeban
1.plot: Ryo is tricked into doing bodyguard work for the daughter of a Yakuza Boss being stalked by a biker team.  Ryo realizes that the daughter is the leader of a female gang at her school, and finds there is much more than what the Yakuza boss is requesting.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E11 - That Pretty Girl in Tights Prefers the Tulips
1.plot: Ryo is requested to assist a female thief in stealing a black tulip from a fraudulent psychic.  Kaori finds out that the psychic's butler has a crush on her and decides he may be helpful in obtaining the plant.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E12 - Kids Get Special Treatment: A Beautiful Lady from a Dangerous Land
1.plot: Ryo must protect a woman and a young boy from another country from being abducted by foreign agents.  Kaori soon discovers that the young boy's actions and demeanor are exactly as Ryo's.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E13 - She's Getting Married at Age Sixteen: A Hot Kiss with a Pop Idol
1.plot: Ryo is assigned to protect young pop idol Nagisa from an unknown fanatic, however he is more interested in her female manager.  However, it turns out that Nagisa is very attracted to Ryo and Ryo decides to use this to his advantage to ensure her safety.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E14 - My Foe is a Beautiful Lady?: The Biggest Woman Trap in History
1.plot: Saeko enlists the help of Ryo to solve the dissappearances of beautiful women in Shinjuku.  The stakes are even higher when Kaori, mistaken for a beautiful woman, is also kidnapped.  Ryo encounters the mastermind of the scheme, a supposedly beautiful woman who may not be who she seems to be.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E15 - Ryo's an Instructor at a Women's School?: To Protect a Sweet Young Lady
1.plot: Ryo is requested to protect the daughter of a dead tycoon who claims that Ryo had saved her from kidnappers once before.  As Ryo tries to find out who is trying to kill her, her stepmother comes up as a very likely suspect, but is being controlled by someone else.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E16 - One Frisky Stewardess: Ryo - Self Defense Instructor
1.plot: An old friend of Kaori's is being stalked by strange characters who are after strange looking watches that were slipped into her bag.  Despite Kaori's efforts to keep her away from Ryo, Kaori is kidnapped by the men and Ryo and her friend must rescue her.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E17 - Summer's Lovely Designer: Ryo has a Thing for the Super-High-Leg Type
1.plot: Ryo is recruited by a famous fashion designer's assistant after her designs were stolen by her boss.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E18 - A Divine Prophecy on a Summer's Evening: Shrine Maiden gets first lesson in love
1.plot: Corrupt businessman, an incompetent assassin, and a old lady complicates Ryo's job to protect a beautiful psychic.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E19 - A Beach to Remember: An Audition full of Danger
1.plot: Ryo is asked to investigate threats made to women attending an audition for a film featuring a handsome actor. One of these ladies attending this audition is hoping to reunite with her long-lost father, the director of the movie.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E20 - Her Ladyship Leaves the Mountain: One Long Day for Ryo
1.plot: Ryo is hired to defend a jungle princess from members of her own tribe intent in breaking their isolation from the modern world.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E21 - Faceless Snipers: Ryo's and Saeko's Dangerous Game
1.plot: When Ryo finds himself in a hotel with Saeko, he is forced to accept a job to protect a former newspaper magnate from hitman that he hired himself.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E22 - Ryo Plays Cupid: Here's to Diamonds
1.plot: While snooping around a lingerie show, Ryo comes across a woman who stole a beautiful diamond necklace from a wealthy young man. The woman asks Ryo to be her lover, but Ryo is aware that there is more to her story than meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E23 - Buzz Buzz Buzz go the Killer Bees
1.plot: A bride literally falls into Ryo's lap and along with it, some goons hired by the jilted groom. While trying to sneak up on her during the middle of the night, Ryo gets stung by an experimental, but deadly bee. The bride does have the antidote, but as Kaori finds out, it has "terrible" side effects, most notably showing the feminine side of City Hunter.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E24 - A Rosy Hospital Stay?: An Angel in White in Danger
1.plot: In order to find out who is targeting a nurse who is due to be the recipient of a large inheritance, Ryo breaks his foot and ends up in the same hospital the nurse is staying. While Ryo must not tell the nurse that she is being targeted, he also finds out she does not have enough experience being a nurse.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E25 - An International Relationship of Love: My Counterpart is a Blonde Beauty
1.plot: Ryo teams up with a beautiful American agent to find out who is smuggling tanks from Japan.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E26 - What is Love?: Ryo's course in Proper Romance
1.plot: When a father requests the services of City Hunter to protect his daughter from someone stalking her at work, he finds out that the stalker IS City Hunter. The father then requests that City Hunter convince her daughter to quit her job as he feels that she may be in danger of other stalkers. Ryo realizes that the young woman has lived a sheltered life and decides to teach her a few lessons in love.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E27 - Ryo & Umibozu's Sweet Daddy Longlegs Story (Part 1)
1.plot: Umibozu returns to ask Ryo to help him protect Maki, the daughter of his old mentor. Ryo learns of the story of Daddy Longlegs and that Umibozu has been supporting her from a distance. Ryo pretends to take Umibozu's place and then tries many opportunities to sleep with Maki.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E28 - Ryo & Umibozu's Sweet Daddy Longlegs Story (Part 2)
1.plot: Umibozu reveals that the man after Maki is Snake, a former comrade who betrayed Umibozu and her father. The final showdown between Umibozu and Snake takes place in a theater where Maki is performing in her concert. Ryo reveals to Maki who her "Daddy Longlegs" really is.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E29 - A 500 Yen Job: A Cute Little Girl wins Ryo's Heart
1.plot: A young girl manages to convince Ryo to help her idol, a budding children's author, from corporate bullies representing a publishing firm. The price: 500 Yen.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E30 - Ryo's Rival In Love: Give Me Kaori
1.plot: A nephew of a missing wealthy explorer seeks Ryo's services to protect him from his aunt who seeks to obtain his uncle's fortune. However, the young nephew begins to have feelings of affection for Kaori. Kaori meanwhile, is using this opportunity to see how Ryo reacts to the presence of a "rival".

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E31 - Fast Paced Romance: A Girl's Love Closing in Fast
1.plot: Ryo and Kaori come across two opposing jobs involving the same people. Kaori is hired by a member of a Biker Gang who wants her to pretend to be his girlfriend in order to deflect attention from the daughter of a tycoon. And Ryo is hired by the daughter to convince the biker to leave his gang and live a normal life.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E32 - Don't Die Ryo: Hard Boiled Magnum
1.plot: When Ryo is hired by Saeko to bait a well known assassin, the assassin takes notice and issues a formal challenge to Ryo.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E33 - Go For It Umibozu: One, Hard-Boiled First Love Concerto
1.plot: Umibozu is injured while protecting a female pianist with whom he has affection for. He enlists the help of Ryo to help protect the girl from a corrupt politician involved in a bribery scandal and who is trying to report the story in honour of her dead fiance.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E34 - Shock! Ryo's a Papa Don't Wake that Sleeping Child
1.plot: A young girl comes up to Ryo claiming that he is her father. But this is all a ruse by a desperate mother to protect her from her late husband's father who intends to take her away from her mother. Ryo and Kaori both develop a bond with a little girl and Ryo realizes that the late husband's father is not as bad as portrayed.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E35 - A Vision Newscaster Ryo's Mokkori Scandal Report
1.plot: Ryo is assigned to protect a famous reporter as she tries to cover a report involving a corrupt politician and Yakuza.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E36 - A College Girl Plays Hardball for Love! Someone is Trying to Kill Me
1.plot: Ryo must try to ascertain whether or not the adopted daughter of a wealthy tycoon is trying to kill herself. The daughter, however, maintains that it is her adopted father who is trying to kill her. In fact, this is part of an extortion scheme from parties unknown.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E37 - Shinjuku Honor All the Way! The Kimono Beauty Wants To Be My Student (Part One)
1.plot: When Hoodlums try to harass the owner of Otora's cafe into selling her business, Ryo intervenes with the help of a young girl who claims to be a member of the Hanafubuki Gumi, a group representing honor and dignity. However, the hoodlums are members of the Hanafubuki Gumi themselves. When the daughter Kikunosuke asks Ryo to teach her about honor and the Japanese way, the Hanafubuki Gumi hoodlums return and kidnaps Otora. Ryo and Kikunosuke must rescue her and Ryo learns that Kikunosuke is the daughter of the leader of the Hanafubuki Gumi.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E38 - Shinjuku Honor All the Way! The Kimono Beauty Wants To Be My Student (Part Two)
1.plot: Cast away from the Hanafubuki Gumi, Kitoo and the other hoodlums plot to kill Kikunosuke's father and their former leader. Meanwhile, Kikunosuke, on orders from her father, boards with Ryo to learn more about dignity and honor. Kaori goes to Kikunosuke's father with a request to allow her daughter to live a normal life.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E39 - Princess from the Moon! Amnesia Gives Ryo Headaches
1.plot: Ryo runs into a woman who claims she has amnesia and gets notoriously drunk after one sip. Ryo deduces that the girl is not actually suffering from memory loss and is attempting to run away from an overwhelming fact.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E40 - One Sexy Partner! After Shower Compensation
1.plot: Ryo is hired by a female "sweeper" who works for the insurance industry. Their goal is to recover a very expensive diamond stolen from a business tycoon. Once recovered, however, the owner of the diamond double-crosses them and kidnaps Aya. Ryo must rescue her with Kaori's help.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E41 - Saeko's Little Sister is a Private Eye A Passionate Lady's Big Secret (Part One)
1.plot: A new private investigation agency opens next door and it is run by Reika Nogami, Saeko Nogami's younger sister. While Ryo makes constant advances towards her, he learns about Reika's blackmail tactics against Yakuza gangsters as well as the death of her former partner. He also learns that someone has ordered a hit on Reika herself.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E42 - Saeko's Little Sister is a Private Eye A Passionate Lady's Big Secret (Part Two)
1.plot: Reika explains to Ryo about how a corrupt police officer is interfering with narcotics investigations, and how her former partner was killed by the Yakuza and her desire to clear his name. This leads to a showdown against an expert marksman and also lands Ryo, Kaori, and Reika in Jail after being set up by the corrupt police officer.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E43 - Utako's Cookie Anniversary Moles on Her Chest and a Love Poem
1.plot: Ryo is requested to protect a famous poet from an increasing number of stalkers following her. When Ryo finds out that the men following her are not ordinary stalkers, he also finds out that his client is also not an ordinary girl.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E44 - We Asked One Hundred Kids, They said, "Ryo's Our Hero."
1.plot: Two brothers have a handful as they deal with a pervert supposedly after their sister who works as a hairstylist. But when they discover a hidden stash of cash stolen in a robbery at a construction site, their sister is kidnapped by the robbers and they must turn to City Hunter for assistance. What they don't realize that the man after their sister is none other than Ryo himself.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E45 - Three Sisters are Calling! Ryo's Skiing Heaven
1.plot: Ryo is requested to take care of three sisters at a ski resort.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E46 - Picking Pockets is a Thrill Pick Pockets for Tomorrow!
1.plot: Ryo and Kaori run into Mariko, an old friend of Kaori's and an aspiring pickpocket. Out of concern for her friend, Kaori asks Ryo to try to convince her to give up pickpocketing. Ryo then issues a challenge: if Mariko can steal Ryo's Wallet, then Mariko can continue as a pickpocket. Otherwise she must quit the profession. Little do the three of them know that Mariko has been targeted by Yakuza after stealing a piece of jewelry containing secret files from a daughter of a Yakuza boss.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E47 - Mokkori is the Best Medicine?! A Pool Shot to a Pretty Hustler's Heart
1.plot: Ryo is hired by Yuri, daughter of a famous pool player while she prepares for a match that may determine the fate of her father's pool club. Ryo discovers that Yuri is not a person who does well under pressure, and as such, tries to help her overcome this handicap during the match.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E48 - O Spring Come Soon to Love's Widow Take Off Those Clothes of Mourning
1.plot: A Job referral from Saeko has Ryo protect the widow of a dead tycoon from an unknown extortionist. At the same time, the butler realizes that only Ryo can help the widow from letting go of her tragic loss.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E49 - Sister in Doubt Mokkori is Her Guide to Love?
1.plot: Ryo runs into a young beautiful nun who has lost her cross after a night in the town.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E50 - The Deadliest Enemy! Ryo and Kaori's Final Match (Part One)
1.plot: Kaori has a recurring nightmare regarding Ryo's impending death. Meanwhile, Umibozu narrowly escapes death at the hands of three siblings who are powerful assassins hired by the Lodos Mafia. Badly shaken and wounded, Umibozu tries to find Ryo. At the same time, Saeko and Reika hire Ryo to help them bust a smuggling ring headed by the Lodos Mafia at a large masquerade. The three assassin siblings notice and decide to use this to their advantage. Their target: to kill Ryo by using Kaori Makimura as a hostage.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E51 - The Deadliest Enemy! Ryo and Kaori's Final Match (Part Two)
1.plot: With Kaori Kidnapped by the three assassin siblings, the Lodos Mafia issues a formal challenge to Ryo. Ryo, with the help of Umibozu, infiltrates the Lodos Mafia boat in search of Kaori. Kaori realizes that her nightmares foretelling Ryo's death may be true.

meta.plot: Quand un enquêteur incendie doit faire équipe avec une lieutenante, leur traque de deux pyromanes se transforme en jeu du chat et de la souris.

Pieter, 16 ans, tranquille et taciturne, vit une semaine sur deux chez sa mère policière, ce qu’elle ne sait pas c’est qu’il pratique en cachette le parkour. Un jour, par hasard, il se retrouve à jouer les justiciers. Il est alors repéré par une enquêtrice en herbe, qui, avec son meilleur ami et la cousine de celui-ci, vont bientôt devenir inséparables et membres de la même équipe de choc pour l’accompagner dans ses aventures acrobatiques et masquées.
