meta.plot: Pol Rubio commence à étudier la philosophie à l'Université de Barcelone tandis que la relation entre Bruno et lui commence à se renforcer. Pol va rencontrer de nouveaux amis, de nouveaux collègues et nouveaux enseignants, en plus d'avoir à faire face aux conflits dans sa nouvelle carrière comme étudiant, sa famille complexe et sa nouvelle relation avec Bruno jusqu'à devenir un maître de la philosophie.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E01 - Raised by Wolves
1.plot: After Earth is rendered uninhabitable, Androids Mother and Father start a new settlement and family with human embryos on the planet Kepler-22b. Twelve years later, only one child, Campion, remains, and the arrival of an Ark of surviving humans called the Mithraic presents a threat that Mother has no choice but to confront.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E02 - Pentagram
1.plot: After a confrontation with Marcus, Mother discovers and takes five Mithraic children (Hunter, Tempest, Paul, Holly and Vita) back to her settlement. While Mother, Father and Campion, adjust to living with a new group of Earth-born children, Marcus struggles to survive alone on Kepler-22b.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E03 - Virtual Faith
1.plot: After the Mithraic kids fall sick, Campion believes Mother is poisoning them and plans an escape. As Mother and Father attempt to prove otherwise, Marcus and Sue work to convince the other surviving Mithraic to mount a rescue of the children, desperate to get their son Paul back.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E04 - Nature's Course
1.plot: Father tries to teach the children how to hunt some of Kepler-22b’s mysterious creatures for food. Meanwhile, the Mithraic make a stunning discovery that potentially fulfills a Mithraic prophecy, and a debate about how to proceed ignites a conflict between Marcus and the Mithraic leader, Ambrose.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E05 - Infected Memory
1.plot: Marcus moves forward with a plan to rescue the Mithraic children, but first he has to find them. Back at the settlement, Campion and Paul bond while on a hunting expedition with Father, and Mother attempts to learn more about her origins.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E06 - Lost Paradise
1.plot: After rekindling her connection to her creator, Mother finds herself distracted by intense feelings she didn’t know she was capable of having, unaware that Marcus, Sue and the Mithraic are closing in on the settlement.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E07 - Faces
1.plot: Marcus’s decisions stress his relationship to his family as he struggles to maintain his clout as leader of the Mithraic. Mother is able to see Marcus for who he truly is, which threatens his power and puts Mother in a precarious situation she might not recover from. Meanwhile, Campion is faced with a choice that could result in dire consequences.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E08 - Mass
1.plot: As Marcus continues to embrace his Mithraic devotion, Sue worries he may no longer have her and Paul’s best interests at heart. Meanwhile, Mother experiences what she believes to be malfunctions, and Hunter works on a secret project with Father.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E09 - Umbilical
1.plot: Sue is determined to keep the children safe, and in doing so, struggles with whether or not she can trust Mother. Meanwhile, a new threat arises and an increasingly erratic Marcus causes the Mithraic to question their leader.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E10 - The Beginning
1.plot: Paul begins displaying troubling behavior not unlike that of Marcus, leading to a shocking discovery. Father struggles with human-like emotions. Mother and Father discover a startling secret about the planet they’re on, just as a new threat arrives on Kepler-22b.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E01 - The Collective
2.plot: While Mother, Father, and the children face hostility from their new atheist collective, Marcus sets out to fill the walls of an ancient church with Sol’s worshippers.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E02 - Seven
2.plot: While the collective is tasked with hunting down the serpent, Mother is left to reconcile complicated emotions. Convinced that it will aid his cause, Marcus sets out to find the creature before the atheists do.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E03 - Good Creatures
2.plot: Using his mysterious new powers, Marcus rescues a group of Mithraic prisoners, while Mother discovers the serpent is not a maneater but an herbivore. Father works through his frustration over Mother’s decision to spare the serpent’s life by engrossing himself in his work project, the regeneration of an ancient android.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E04 - Control
2.plot: After the Trust uses Paul to strike back against Marcus, Mother confronts the Trust and threatens a coup. Meanwhile, on the run from Mother, Marcus has to keep his followers from losing faith as his powers suddenly disappear.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E05 - King
2.plot: Mother struggles to keep the collective from falling apart as she struggles to lead while Sue resorts to prayer in her desperation to cure Paul. Meanwhile, Marcus and his followers are given new hope as they discover an ancient temple. But as Marcus investigates the temple’s secrets, Decima and the rest of his followers are made to answer for their sins.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E06 - The Tree
2.plot: As they try and fail to open the seed box, Sue and Paul realize they need Marcus’s help. Sue makes a plan to break Marcus out of the brig while Mother is distracted with the imminent birth of Tempest’s baby. But when Sue, Paul and Marcus finally open the seed box, they make a horrifying discovery.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E07 - Feeding
2.plot: A reeling Marcus and Paul join forces with Mother to disarm the newly weaponized serpent before it wreaks unimaginable havoc.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E08 - Happiness
2.plot: Grandmother reveals her own agenda, Marcus seeks revenge, and Mother sets out to neutralize the serpent – but is leveled by the fallout.

meta.plot: Alors que les êtres humains se déchirent, sur fond de guerres de religion, les robots apprennent qu'il est compliqué et dangereux de vouloir contrôler les croyances des humains. Pendant ce temps, deux androïdes tentent d'élever un enfant humain sur une planète vierge.
A compelling family drama and a timeless story told through the eyes of complicated and compromised chief of police Del Harris of a Pennsylvania Rust Belt town full of good people making bad choices.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E01 - The Mill
1.plot: In a small rust belt town in southwest Pennsylvania, Chief of Police Del Harris investigates after a dead body turns up in an abandoned steel mill. Series premiere.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E02 - Happy Returns
1.plot: Harris’ investigation continues. Isaac leaves town. Billy and Lee reunite as Buell celebrates a shotgun wedding.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E03 - Forgive Us Our Trespasses
1.plot: Grace enlists help in her effort to unionize the dressmakers. The sheriff gets an anonymous tip about the murder in the steel mill.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E04 - My Name Is Billy
1.plot: Isaac befriends someone who teaches him the rules of the road. The sheriff searches for evidence in Billy and Grace’s trailer. Billy tells Lee what happened in the steel mill.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E05 - Jojo Ameri-GO
1.plot: Harris races the clock in his search for the anonymous eyewitness. Lee seeks professional advice about whom to protect. Harris’ old Pittsburgh PD partner pays him a visit.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E06 - Debt Collection
1.plot: Alejandro learns of Lee’s history with Billy. Isaac turns his first trick solo. Harris travels back to Pittsburgh with his old partner to repay a debt.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E07 - Blue Mountains
1.plot: Billy gets in with a questionable crowd. Isaac travels alone. Harris’ investigation into the anonymous eyewitness continues as a high school football player ODs.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E08 - St. Sebastian
1.plot: Isaac is taken in by a kind stranger. Grace’s union drive is put to the test. Billy fires his public defender. Harris realizes what he has to do.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E09 - Denmark
1.plot: Harris finally finds the anonymous eyewitness. Lee decides not to return to New York. Billy is returned to the general prison population to face the consequences of his actions. The D.A. may be forced to drop the case. Season finale.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E01 - Homecoming
2.plot: Four months after the shoot-out in West Virginia, Del has returned to the Pittsburgh P.D. while the folks in Buell try to get their lives back on track.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E02 - The Golden Goose
2.plot: A new murder in Buell lights a fire in Steve as he doubles down on his suspicions of Grace and Del. Del continues to investigate the bombing in Pittsburgh while also becoming more enmeshed in the Brotherhood.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E03 - Iron Sky
2.plot: Del invites Vic out to his cabin for a male bonding weekend. Grace goes toe-to-toe with Sue at the District Attorney debate. The town of Buell is rocked by another murder of one of their own, while Steve’s suspicion of Grace grows.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E04 - The Hand You're Dealt
2.plot: Del and Vic grow closer during their weekend in Buell. Lee grows more suspicious of her law firm as her investigation leads her to surprising evidence. A job prospect presents itself to Grace, and Isaac and Russell bond after a harrowing experience. Steve’s suspicion of Grace and Del grows into an obsession.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E05 - Light Me Up
2.plot: Del feels pressure surrounding the Brotherhood as he looks into Vic's disappearance. Lee and Isaac argue about her feelings regarding her job. Isaac’s feelings are hurt when he crosses paths with someone from Russell’s life, while Billy's behavior grows more erratic and causes him to act out.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E06 - Daddy Issues
2.plot: Angela is brought into Del's secret plan. Grace receives a promising job offer, but remains worried about Billy’s behavior. Lee and Isaac have a memorial service for their father.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E07 - Tree
2.plot: Lee’s involvement in the Landwill case deepens. Isaac receives a surprise visit and Billy’s behavior ruins a dinner party. Del fears for Angela’s safety while Grace misses Del.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E08 - Ponderosa
2.plot: Billy has a new lease on life after finally confronting his past and makes strides to secure his future. Lee is in trouble as Rinna investigates the missing documents. Russell returns to Buell to find Isaac moving on. Angela and Del are wary of mysterious circumstances surrounding a death.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E09 - Fast Horses, Younger Women and More Money
2.plot: Cynthia becomes suspicious of everyone as she tries to figure out what happened to Vic. Angela and Del are surprised when they arrive at an urgent police call and things are not as they seem. Lee reconnects with Alejandro when she goes to New York to sign their divorce papers.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E10 - Confessions
2.plot: Fighting crippling pain, Del is determined to continue his investigation and turns to Steve for help. Billy leaves for basic training and finds comfort when he befriends a fellow traveler. The Landwill conflict comes to a head.

meta.plot: Deux familles du crime s'affrontent dans une lutte à mort qui menace de faire tomber des empires. Pris entre deux feux, Harry Da Souza, un " fixer ", connaît mieux que personne la valeur de la loyauté quand des forces opposées entre en collision.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E01 - Stick or Twist
1.plot: Harry Da Souza is called upon to make a problem disappear.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E02 - Jigsaw Puzzle
1.plot: Harry must deal with the aftermath of the Harrigan family meeting.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E03 - Plan B
1.plot: Richie makes his move, putting the Harrigans on high alert.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E04 - Rat Trap
1.plot: Conrad comes to Jan for a favor. Kevin makes a confession to Harry.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E05 - Funeral for a Friend
1.plot: Kevin and Harry assess scenarios in a search for insurance and an exit strategy.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E06 - Antwerp Blues
1.plot: Conrad twists the knife as Maeve gives Eddie a lesson in the art of chess.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E07 - The Crossroads
1.plot: O'Hara points out the elephant in the room. Harry takes extreme measures.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E08 - Helter Skelter
1.plot: Maeve extends an olive branch. Richie contemplates a new affiliation.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E09 - Beggars Banquet
1.plot: Tattersall gets Alice's tootsies tapping. Kevin confronts his past.

1.title: FR - MobLand [4K] - S01E10 - The Beast in Me
1.plot: Kevin takes care of a problem. Maeve spills the tea.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire suit Carlos Alcaraz dans sa quête d'équilibre entre une carrière de phénomène du tennis mondial et ses envies de jeune homme de 20 ans.

1.title: FR - Carlos Alcaraz: À ma façon - S01E01 - Finding Joy in the Pain
1.plot: After enjoying some precious family time in Murcia, Carlos Alcaraz faces the stress of an injury as his participation in Roland-Garros is on the line.

1.title: FR - Carlos Alcaraz: À ma façon - S01E02 - I'm Not Rafa
1.plot: The team remembers Carlos' early days before his first Grand Slam. As he prioritizes fun and well-being, doubts arise about a lasting, successful career.

1.title: FR - Carlos Alcaraz: À ma façon - S01E03 - My Way
1.plot: The pressure to win weighs on a burned-out Carlos after the Olympics. His circle tries to uplift him as Rafael Nadal's retirement ceremony approaches.

meta.plot: Après un crash d'avion, un groupe de survivants doit apprendre à vivre ensemble tout en faisant face à la nature qui les entoure, laissant derrière eux leur petit confort personnel.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E01 - All Is Not Lost
1.plot: A British ex-special forces agent leads a rescue mission after a commercial flight crashes on an uninhabited island. The survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E02 - Rest in Peace, Callaway Hinkle
1.plot: The survivors find a satellite phone, Danny confronts his past, Todd learns about the death of his child, and a discovery is made that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E03 - Always Meant to See That
1.plot: Pack, Emma, and Florence face a tough choice and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E04 - The Community Pile
1.plot: Pack goes on a vision quest, Danny helps Owen relax, Todd makes a power play to take control, and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E05 - Tubthumping
1.plot: The survivors hold an election, Danny and Todd face off, and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E06 - The Phantom
1.plot: Todd adjusts to a life of solitude, Pack finds other crash survivors, and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E07 - The Trial
1.plot: The survivors hold a trial after someone is seriously injured and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E08 - The Adventures of Beth and Lamar
1.plot: Danny and Owen start a new camp, two survivors try to escape the island, and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E09 - Javier and the Gang
1.plot: Owen has an encounter in the jungle. Todd, Florence, and Emma adjust to life off the island and the survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

1.title: FR - Wrecked - S01E10 - Cop Tricks
1.plot: The survivors make a discovery that could change everything.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E01 - Ransom
2.plot: The newly arrived pirates try to ransom Danny while marooning the others. Steve tries to make amends for murdering a survivor.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E02 - Poison
2.plot: After the pirates decide to stay on the island, Pack tries to negotiate a truce. Steve pitches Danny on a new business venture.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E03 - Caiman
2.plot: After something taints the water upstream, Florence and Karen hike into the jungle to find the source while the others debate whether they want the pirates to spoil “Game of Thrones.” Steve strikes up an unlikely romance.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E04 - Tony Pepperoni
2.plot: Owen and Florence deal with the return of a deadly foe. Todd makes a haunting discovery about his past after trying to fist fight Chet. I guess Owen is the captain now. Or maybe Florence again? Hard to say.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E05 - No One Rides for Free
2.plot: Jess & Todd attempt to buy passage on the pirate's ship through unconventional means. Owen starts to have feelings for Florence, as Steve grapples with his new love. Jess and Todd are both the captains now, like a sort of dual-captain scenario.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E06 - Sister Mercy
2.plot: After discovering the pirate's plan to harvest their organs, the survivors attempt to escape the island. Karen must make a difficult decision that echoes a moment from her past. Will the pirates remain the captains now?

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E07 - Cruise-ifornication
2.plot: After making it onto the pirate's ship (a Red Hot Chili Peppers tribute band cruise), the survivors divide after only some of them get showers. Pack and Bruce form an unlikely friendship.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E08 - Speed
2.plot: After Todd and Jess decide to get married, Florence and Owen struggle to define their new romance. Casey returns to officiate the wedding. Pack and Steve make a discovery that threatens to tear them apart.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E09 - The Setup
2.plot: Danny launches an investigation after the survivors discover someone has sabotaged the ship by blowing up the engine. Steve makes a shocking discovery at the bottom of the ship. Honestly, no one is the captain now.

2.title: FR - Wrecked - S02E10 - Nerd Speak
2.plot: As the ship sinks, the survivors attempt to escape. Will anyone be the captain now ever again?

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E01 - Bush Man
3.plot: After surviving the Cruisifornication explosion and washing ashore on a new island, the survivors uncover a menacing threat, begging the question -- wait, does anyone actually read these episode descriptions?

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E02 - Puke & Cigars
3.plot: After a charismatic millionaire rescues the survivors, Jess and Florence suspect he may not be what he seems, and set out to answer the question -- who is Declan Stanwick? And more importantly, who is reading this? Anyone?

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E03 - Six Feet
3.plot: After discovering Declan's sinister plot, Danny goes undercover with the rich, while Pack and Karen attempt to escape the compound. I wish we could escape writing these episode descriptions, am I right? No one actually reads these, right?

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E04 - A Game of Chest
3.plot: After Jess loses her recollection of the last decade, Todd attempts to spark her memory. Steve and Declan face off in a battle of wits.

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E05 - Last Meal
3.plot: On the eve of The Hunt, Martha offers to the survivors' one last meal of their choosing -- as long as they can all decide together.

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E06 - Hunt Day
3.plot: It's Hunt Day, and the survivors must face off against each other in a battle royale to the death.

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E07 - Ballers
3.plot: Attempting to hide from the others during The Hunt, Pack and Jess run into a new threat on the island.

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E08 - The Dark Prince Returns
3.plot: With Karen gravely injured, Owen and Danny must journey to the center of the island to defeat Chettywompwomp. Florence learns more about Karen's backstory. Pack, Todd and Jess face a futile task.

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E09 - Mrs. Stanwick
3.plot: The survivors attempt to turn the tables on the rich and lure them into a trap.

3.title: FR - Wrecked - S03E10 - The Island Family
3.plot: Barricaded in the mansion and surrounded by the rich, the survivors mount one last attempt to escape Declan's island.

1.title: FR - Chasing the Frozen Dream - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: David Beaucage puts together a hockey team of his comedian friends to try and win an amateur tournament in Niagara Falls.

1.title: FR - Chasing the Frozen Dream - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Training with the new coach is difficult for the team and exposes the players' weaknesses. Will he be able to up the level?

1.title: FR - Chasing the Frozen Dream - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Following the departure of Maxime Talbot as coach, the Loups-Phoques face their first real test: taking on a Midget AAA team.

1.title: FR - Chasing the Frozen Dream - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: It is finally time to set off for Niagara Falls. The team is well prepared, but they will still have to deal with an unexpected setback.

1.title: FR - Chasing the Frozen Dream - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The Loups-Phoques face off against the defending champions, who have no intention of letting our stars take the trophy.

1.title: FR - Chasing the Frozen Dream - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: It's time for the grand finale. Exhausted, the Loups-Phoques will have to dig deep to finish this great adventure.

meta.plot: À LA POURSUITE DU RÊVE GLACÉ suit une bande d’humoristes qui tentent de toucher à leur rêve de jeunesse : remporter un tournoi de hockey.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E01 - Nice Face
1.plot: MI5 security officer Eve Polastri is bored in her job and yearns for a more exciting life. When a Russian politician is murdered, Eve is tasked with protecting the only witness and soon finds herself on a collision course with a violent and extraordinary assassin, Villanelle.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E02 - I'll Deal With Him Later
1.plot: In the aftermath of her recent assignment, Villanelle is ordered to take a break. Never one to do as she's told, she goes ahead with her next mission regardless. Meanwhile, Eve is given a dream opportunity to join a secret MI6 unit tracking Villanelle and the shady organization she works for.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E03 - Don't I Know You?
1.plot: When Villanelle kills a Chinese colonel at a kink clinic in Berlin, Eve and Bill travel out to investigate. While Eve and Bill chase up a number of promising leads, Villanelle enjoys the cat-and-mouse of their proximity. But as they draw closer, Eve comes to realize that this is much more than a game.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E04 - Sorry Baby
1.plot: Intel from Berlin points to the existence of a mole, prompting Eve to undertake her first surveillance operation. Meanwhile, Villanelle is sent to England to eliminate a member of British Intelligence. Villanelle wonders, could it be Eve?

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E05 - I Have a Thing About Bathrooms
1.plot: Having survived a terrifying close call with Villanelle, Eve now has the mole ensconced in a safe house and is buzzing. They have an exciting opportunity to glean information and crack this thing open.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E06 - Take Me to the Hole!
1.plot: A female assassin is taken into custody in Russia, and Eve and Carolyn head out to Moscow to negotiate access. She could hold the key to the organization that runs Villanelle. Meanwhile, Villanelle is smuggled into the same Russian jail. It's a grim and brutal place, where not even Villanelle is safe.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E07 - I Don't Want To Be Free
1.plot: Tensions are running high as the situation in Moscow escalates, and Eve starts to question who she can trust. Despite the danger, with her sights firmly set on Villanelle, Eve goes rogue. With both women under pressure, the stakes are higher than ever.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E08 - God, I'm Tired
1.plot: Villanelle's mission is proving anything but straightforward, forcing her to take drastic measures. Meanwhile, Eve makes a shocking discovery, which leads her right to Villanelle and an electrifying confrontation from which neither will emerge unscathed.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E01 - Do You Know How to Dispose of a Body?
2.plot: Eve is reeling from her act of violence against Villanelle and doesn't know whether she is alive or dead. A paranoid and severely injured Villanelle manages to get herself to the hospital for treatment. Carolyn approaches Eve with an intriguing opportunity.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E02 - Nice and Neat
2.plot: Carolyn introduces Eve to her new team before Eve briefs them on the Villanelle case. Villanelle, needing to lie low while she recovers, finds a good Samaritan to take her in and care for her.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E03 - The Hungry Caterpillar
2.plot: Villanelle's new circumstances are looking bleak, while Eve makes a dangerous deal with an old acquaintance. Villanelle is surprised when she is approached by a figure from her past.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E04 - Desperate Times
2.plot: Villanelle decides to take matters into her own hands on a trip to Amsterdam. Carolyn is called in to face the music with her boss. After the discovery of another dead body, Eve and her new team make a break in their case.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E05 - Smell Ya Later
2.plot: The MI6 team make a pact with the devil in order to get information from The Ghost. A visitor from Broadmoor comes with a dire warning, while Eve and Villanelle find themselves closer than ever.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E06 - I Hope You Like Missionary!
2.plot: The point of no return: Villanelle uses her unrivaled infiltration skills to immerse herself in the world of a new target. Their relationship on the rocks, Eve and Niko confront each other about their future.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E07 - Wide Awake
2.plot: Villanelle dives deep into the dangerous world of her target under the guise of her newfound persona, Billie. Eve may have worrying competition for Villanelle's affections.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E08 - You're Mine
2.plot: Eve's mission is disastrously compromised. Carolyn briefs Eve on her current status as an employee of the British government and leaves Eve's future in her own hands. Villanelle does everything she can in order to get to her ultimate target.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E01 - Slowly Slowly Catchy Monkey
3.plot: Eve attempts to rebuild her life, having been shot and left for dead in Rome by Villanelle. Villanelle, believing Eve to be dead, is approached by an old foe who offers her a new opportunity.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E02 - Management Sucks
3.plot: Eve strikes up an unlikely alliance with Kenny’s colleagues at the Bitter Pill, and Villanelle finds that management is not all it is cracked up to be.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E03 - Meetings Have Biscuits
3.plot: Villanelle agrees to a job that will take her back to London. Carolyn’s Moscow contacts come in useful when Eve and the team uncover a potential lead.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E04 - Still Got It
3.plot: Eve tries to patch things up with Niko, and Villanelle receives good news about her upcoming promotion.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E05 - Are You from Pinner?
3.plot: Villanelle returns home to Mother Russia to try to find her family. Perhaps a new connection to her roots will give her back what has been missing in her life.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E06 - End of Game
3.plot: Carolyn finds out that information is being withheld by those close to her, and Eve finds a lead which might bring her closer to Villanelle.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E07 - Beautiful Monster
3.plot: Eve finds a clue to Villanelle's whereabouts in the most unlikely of places, Villanelle and Dasha work together on a kill, and the pressure is getting to Konstantin.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E08 - Are You Leading or Am I?
3.plot: Konstantin makes a break for it, while Eve and Villanelle try to work out what the future may hold for them - together or apart.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E01 - Just Dunk Me
4.plot: Eve sets out for her revenge against The Twelve, even if it kills her. Villanelle tries to reform.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E02 - Don't Get Eaten
4.plot: Eve confronts Helene and seeks her aid against The Twelve. Villanelle's attempts to reform continue.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E03 - A Rainbow in Beige Boots
4.plot: Eve finds the name of Helene's target. Villanelle forces an MI6 psychiatrist to give her therapy.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E04 - It's Agony and I'm Ravenous
4.plot: Eve establishes her boundaries with Villanelle. Helene sets a challenge for Eve.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E05 - Don't Get Attached
4.plot: Eve seeks out any information about The Twelve's origin, but uncovers more than she bargained for.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E06 - Oh Goodie, I'm The Winner
4.plot: Eve nurses Villanelle back to health, then heads to Berlin to try to take her revenge on Lars.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E07 - Making Dead Things Look Nice
4.plot: Eve begins to question her identity and her actions, and she rekindles a relationship with Gunn.

4.title: FR - Killing Eve - S04E08 - Hello, Losers

meta.plot: Cantonnée à un travail de bureau bien peu passionnant, l'agent du MI5 Eve Polastri est frustrée par une existence bien monotone. Jusqu'au jour où elle se retrouve à traquer une tueuse psychopathe surnommée Villanelle...
Témoignages personnels et images inédites retracent les attentats survenus dans les transports publics de Londres le 7 juillet 2005, et leurs conséquences dramatiques.

1.title: FR - Attentats de Londres : La terreur et la traque - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: On 7 July 2005, bombs go off at four separate sites across London, sparking untold devastation and the biggest manhunt the United Kingdom had ever seen.

1.title: FR - Attentats de Londres : La terreur et la traque - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The clues take the investigation from London, to Luton, to Leeds, where the community is left reeling at the news — and the backlash from the media.

1.title: FR - Attentats de Londres : La terreur et la traque - S01E03 - Episode 3

1.title: FR - Attentats de Londres : La terreur et la traque - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The police are desperate to find the bombers, but the trail is getting cold. Until a call from a member of the public turns the investigation around.
