meta.plot: Laurel Healy fait ses premiers pas à Washington dans le cabinet de son frère, sénateur au sein de l'administration américaine. Alors que le gouvernement est en crise, des insectes venus de l'espace se nourrissent peu à peu des cerveaux des membres du Congrès et des employés de la Maison Blanche, prenant le contrôle du pays. La jeune débutante va-t-elle parvenir à enrayer le problème et sauver la nation ?

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E01 - The Insanity Principle: How Extremism in Politics Is Threatening Democracy in the 21st Century
1.plot: When Laurel Healy returns home to Washington, D.C. to work for her brother, Senator Luke Healy, on Capitol Hill, she is caught in the midst of two huge problems: the government has stopped working due to budgetary disagreements, and mysterious bugs are eating the brains of a growing number of Congress members and Hill staffers.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E02 - Playing Politics: Living Life in the Shadow of the Budget Showdown -- A Critique
1.plot: Laurel continues to investigate the death of esteemed Dr. Daudier, while bugs infect more citizens of Washington, D.C. Rochelle Daudier, the deceased doctor’s daughter and Gustav Triplette, an eccentric genius, both encounter the bugs separately and begin to question exactly what is happening.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E03 - Goring Oxes: How You Can Survive the War on Government Through Five Easy Steps
1.plot: When a bizarre and deadly incident takes place on live television, Agent Onofrio's investigation into it causes Laurel, Gustav and Rochelle to dig deeper into the bug mystery. Luke attempts to cover up his affair with his Chief of Staff, Scarlett, before his opponent for the minority whip position, Senator Ella Poundstone, can make it public.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E04 - Wake Up Grassroots: The Nine Virtues of Participatory Democracy, and How We Can Keep America Great by Encouraging an Informed Electorate
1.plot: Laurel and Rochelle try to persuade Laurel’s friend Abby to get an MRI so they can uncover the real cause of the strange behavior taking over Washington, D.C. Luke attempts to reopen the government through a secret deal with the Republicans

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E05 - Back to Work: A Behind-the-Scenes Look at Congress and How It Gets Things Done (and Often Doesn't)
1.plot: Laurel asks her brother, Luke, for his help to get the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to investigate the bugs, but he insists she first consult Dr. Joanne Alaimo, a leading entomologist, for her perspective on the invasion. Laurel’s relationship with Anthony takes a drastic turn.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E06 - Past as Prologue: Notes Toward a Post-Reagan Theory of Party Alliance, Tribalist, and Loyalty
1.plot: When Laurel is infected by the bugs, Gustav and Rochelle work quickly to figure out if there is any way to save her. When the Centers for Disease Control has its funding temporarily cut, Luke attempts to reach a compromise to have the money reinstated, but Red’s political machinations undermine him at every turn.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E07 - The Power of Euphemism: How Torture Became a Matter of Debate in American Politics
1.plot: Laurel comes under investigation about her potential involvement with the bug infestation. Also, Gustav and Rochelle discover a unique way to communicate with those infected by the bugs.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E08 - The Path to War Part One: The Gathering Political Storm
1.plot: Rochelle and Gustav capture and question a man they suspect is infected by the bugs. Also, Luke and Red face off in a Senate Intelligence meeting about a potential war.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E09 - Taking on Water: How Leaks in D.C. are Discovered and Patched
1.plot: Senator Red Wheatus hires a special investigator to dig into the Healy family’s financial and personal history. Also, when Gareth learns some sordid details about Laurel’s romantic past, it puts a strain on their budding relationship.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E10 - The Path to War Part Two: The Impact of Propaganda on Congressional War Votes
1.plot: Laurel must work alongside an old boyfriend, Ben Valderrama, when Luke enlists her help in putting together a political documentary to support his anti-war initiative. Also, Laurel worries about the health of Luke and Germaine’s baby.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E11 - Six Points on the New Congressional Budget: The False Dichotomy of Austerity vs. Expansionary Policies
1.plot: Luke and Laurel rush to uncover Red's secret agenda, which is buried in a massive new budget bill. Also, Gareth inadvertently witnesses an unsettling bug encounter in Red's office.

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E12 - Talking Points Toward a Wholistic View of Activism in Government: Can the Top Rebel?
1.plot: When Laurel discovers that a senate bill is not what it appears, she implores Luke to help, leading to a dramatic Senate sit-in. Also, Red and Ella battle for control of the bug agenda, and Laurel questions whether or not she should leave Washington, D.C. for good

1.title: FR - BrainDead - S01E13 - The End of All We Hold Dear: What Happens When Democracies Fail: A Brief Synopsis
1.plot: Laurel discovers the secret to driving the bugs out of a person's brain and tests the tactic on her father. Armed with new knowledge, Laurel and Gareth attempt to expel the Queen bug out of Red's head once and for all. Laurel and Gareth progress in their romantic relationship.

1.title: FR - Calls - S01E01 - The End
1.plot: "There’s someone outside. / What? / He's in the backyard...This is so scary."

1.title: FR - Calls - S01E02 - The Beginning
1.plot: "What day? / The day you screwed up your life, Mark"

1.plot: "Long story short, he asked me to pick up a bag from his house. / Who asks for that?"

1.title: FR - Calls - S01E04 - It's All in Your Head
1.plot: "This is gonna sound weird but my arms are stretching and they're getting longer."

1.title: FR - Calls - S01E05 - Me, Myself, and Darlene
1.plot: "I just shot her. And I'm calling to turn myself in, so if you wanna send someone down here, I'll wait."

1.title: FR - Calls - S01E06 - The Universe Did It
1.plot: "Last time I saw you, you said you loved me since the 8th grade and you knew you always would."

1.plot: "...And then you'll connect with someone in the future. / Or in the past, hopefully the past."

meta.plot: Racontée à travers une série de conversations téléphoniques interconnectées, cette série inédite raconte l'histoire mystérieuse d'un groupe d'étrangers dont la vie est bouleversée à l'approche d'un événement apocalyptique.

La série est à forte dimension musicale et raconte l'histoire d'une famille de gardiens qui vit et travaille à Central Park, et qui fait tout son possible afin de sauver le parc d'un projet d'une riche héritière de chaîne d'hôtel souhaitant transformer Central Park en complexe immobilier.

1.title: FR - Central Park - S01E02 - Skater’s Circle
1.plot: Bitsy pitches her plan to buy the park. Owen deals with a mini-mugging in Skater’s Circle.

1.title: FR - Central Park - S01E06 - Rival Busker
1.plot: Birdieʼs job is threatened by a rival busker, Bitsy hosts a wedding, and Paige spends the night at The Brandenham.

1.title: FR - Central Park - S01E07 - Squirrel, Interrupted
1.plot: Cole and Owen do a scavenger hunt in Central Park. Paige discovers Molly is a great chess player.

1.title: FR - Central Park - S01E08 - Hot Oven
1.plot: Molly introduces Brendan to the family. Helen stumbles upon a new way to get Shampagne out of her life.

1.title: FR - Central Park - S01E09 - Live it Up Tonight
1.plot: Molly and Cole go on a special park tour as Owen and Paige try to have a date night.

1.title: FR - Central Park - S01E10 - A Fish Called Snakehead
1.plot: Season finale. Owen and his family search for a snakehead fish that might be in the Harlem Meer. Bitsy works with a likability consultant.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E01 - Central Dark
2.plot: A tristate blackout leaves Bitsy and Helen trapped in New Jersey—and forces the Tillerman family to see each other in a new light.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E02 - Mother's Daze
2.plot: Owen and the kids go all out for Paige on Mother’s Day. Bitsy has to handle things on her own when Helen takes a day off.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E03 - Fista Puffs Mets Out Justice
2.plot: As a test to see if she's worthy of joining an elite girl group, Fista Puffs battles a monster in the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E04 - Of Course You Realize This Means Ward
2.plot: Owen oversees a kids' field trip in the park, while Molly and Cole help Brendan with his indoor kite competition. Bitsy and her brother write memoirs.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E05 - Down to the Underwire
2.plot: When Molly needs a new bra, Owen takes her shopping. Helen finds a key that could finally reveal whether she's in Bitsy’s will.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E06 - The Shadow
2.plot: The Brandenham is robbed by a jewel thief, reminding Bitsy of a criminal who terrorized the hotel over 50 years ago.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E07 - A Decent Proposal
2.plot: Owen does damage control after accidentally ruining a marriage proposal. Molly attends Bitsy’s birthday party with Brendan.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E08 - Sir Bricks-A-Lot
2.plot: When Owen considers a new job in Connecticut, the family uses Cole’s toys to imagine what their lives would be like if they moved out of the park.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E09 - A Boat-iful Mind
2.plot: Cole finds an escape from his homework in model sail-boating. Molly becomes a published artist in the school newspaper but isn’t proud of her work.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E10 - Bee Is for Brandenham
2.plot: Owen is called to the Brandenham to help Bitsy deal with a swarm of bees, while Paige and the kids attempt to care for her boss’ cat.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E11 - The PAIGE-riarchy!
2.plot: Paige tries to convince Molly that her period is a blessing. Bitsy is desperate to get back on a prestigious list of rich women over 50.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E12 - Castle Sweet Castle
2.plot: Owen and Paige set out to make the castle everything they dreamed it would be—if they can get the approval.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E13 - Celeste We Forget
2.plot: Owen’s mom derails a trip to the botanical garden when she makes a surprise visit. Paige chases a lead while writing a fluff piece on gifting suites.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E14 - The Ballad of Johnnie Lee
2.plot: After an embarrassing moment at school, Cole wants to change his name and identity. Owen, Paige, and Molly tell stories to help him cope.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E15 - Where There’s Smoke
2.plot: In search of evidence for a story, Paige brings the family to a wake. Bitsy and Helen try to convince a big investor to join them in buying Central Park.

2.title: FR - Central Park - S02E16 - The Lyin’ in Winter
2.plot: Bitsy and Helen get stranded during a blizzard. The family finds out that the deal to sell Central Park is happening today. Season finale.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E01 - A Star Is Owen
3.plot: The Tillerman family welcomes spring as an episode of a hit crime show films in the park.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E02 - Paige’s Next Chapter
3.plot: As Paige prepares for a big meeting with a book publisher, she welcomes her sister Abby to New York City.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E03 - Ice Ice Not Baby
3.plot: Molly and Brendan get into their first big fight, while Abby gets her first big commercial audition for a local deli.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E05 - Golden Owen: Manager Damager
3.plot: In order to get his “I Heart the Park” campaign proposal approved, Owen has to repair old friendships at the Park Managers’ Conference.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E06 - A Matter of Life and Boeuf
3.plot: When the Tillermans visit Abby at her new job as waitress, a precious item goes missing—and everyone in the restaurant is a suspect.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E07 - Slumber-Dog-Molly-An-Aire
3.plot: Molly hosts her first teenage slumber party, which creates a rift between her and Paige.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E08 - Lunar Palaver
3.plot: On the day of the Lunar Palaver—a big Squirrel Quarrels event—Cole has a run-in with a racist lady in the park.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E09 - A Killer Deadline
3.plot: Paige checks into a hotel to focus on two writing deadlines. Owen volunteers for a school kickball tournament that Molly is trying to avoid.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E10 - Money Candy
3.plot: Owen and Paige set out to buy tickets to a K-pop boy band’s concert for the kids. Bitsy looks into cloning her dog.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E11 - The Puffs Go Poof
3.plot: Fista Puffs considers straightening her hair.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E12 - A Hot Dog to Remember
3.plot: When a beloved hot dog vendor has to take a rare morning off, Owen and Cole volunteer to help set up his cart so he can break a park record.

3.title: FR - Central Park - S03E13 - The Brandenpire Strikes Back
3.plot: Owen’s “I Heart the Park” campaign is in full swing with all hands on deck. Bitsy schemes to cement her political influence. Season finale.

meta.plot: Les frères et sœurs Karl, Addy et Michael ont un voisin très spécial: un panda sage nommé Stillwater. Son amitié et ses histoires leur donnent de nouvelles perspectives sur le monde, sur eux-mêmes et les uns sur les autres.

1.plot: Addy gets frustrated with Karl for not sharing a game. Karl receives a toy robot that isn't what he expected.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E03 - Soaked / A Perfect Fit
1.plot: Karl and Michael feel badly after accidentally soaking Addy with water balloons. When Michael and Addy build a go-kart, Karl feels left out.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E04 - Downward Dog / The Sleeping Moon
1.plot: Michael is hired to pet-sit a neighbor's dog for the weekend. Things don't go as planned when the kids try to watch a lunar eclipse.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E05 - The Race / Dressed Up
1.plot: Addy feels sad after losing a cross-country race. Karl is unwilling to give up his favorite shirt, even though he's outgrown it.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E06 - The Haircut / Paper Wings
1.plot: Karl is afraid to visit a barber for the first time. Michael becomes determined to make the perfect paper airplane.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E07 - Loud Colors / Tied up in Knots
1.plot: Addy looks forward to a peaceful painting session with Stillwater. Karl finally ties his shoes by himself but worries he won't be able to do it again.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E08 - Crossing Over / Kind of Blue
1.plot: Karl faces his fear of crossing a creek in the woods. Michael sees that Addy looks sad and wants to cheer her up.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E09 - Out on a Limb / Sandcastles
1.plot: Karl accidentally breaks a branch on Stillwater's cherry tree. The kids try to protect their sandcastle from being washed away.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E10 - The Unexpected Gift / Celebration Song
1.plot: The kids think it's Stillwater's birthday and plan a surprise party. Addy is disappointed about not getting a lead role in the school play.

1.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S01E11 - The Trade / Winter Wonder
1.plot: Michael is upset when Karl trades a rare game card. A homemade snow scooter leaves Michael feeling frustrated.

2.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S02E01 - The Visit / Showtime
2.plot: The arrival of Stillwater's niece Koo has Karl feeling a bit unseen. Addy puts on a show with her brothers but needs to learn to collaborate.

2.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S02E02 - Karl's Museum / The Helper
2.plot: Karl is disappointed his gem museum doesn't attract more visitors. Addy's time with her classmates gets disrupted by Karl's antics.

2.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S02E03 - Band Aid / The Good Morning
2.plot: Addy forms a band with her friends and discovers playing together is harder than she expected. Michael's day gets off to a rough start.

2.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S02E04 - Building Big / Falling Leaves
2.plot: Michael feels overwhelmed by how long it'll take to build his dream treehouse. Karl copes with the loss of his favorite climbing tree.

2.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S02E05 - Stitch Marks / Friends Forever
2.plot: Karl is upset that MuMu, his favorite stuffed toy, is “broken.” Addy feels betrayed when her best friend spends time with someone else.

2.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S02E06 - Hide and Seek / The Trip
2.plot: Karl and Koo think of ways to make their playdate last forever. Stillwater is anxious about everything he has to do before his trip.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E01 - Waiting / Bake Sale
3.plot: Karl's excitement for Stillwater's return makes the wait that much harder. Addy takes on too many requests for the school's bake sale.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E02 - Captain Koo / Digging Deeper
3.plot: Koo is caught off guard when Karl introduces her to his friends. Maya and Addy show Tommy kindness as he deals with the loss of a loved one.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E03 - Tons of Fun / Apologies
3.plot: Michael plans a fun day for Karl and Koo, but he wants them to play his way. Karl and Koo lose Michael's autographed baseball.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E04 - Sounds Like Poetry / Birdwatching
3.plot: Addy is offended when Michael doesn't like her poem. Michael buries his nose in a book during a group hike with Stillwater.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E05 - New Neighbors / Koo's Gift
3.plot: Michael is nervous about meeting the new kids across the street. Koo attends her first birthday party and is concerned about her gift.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E06 - Friendly Wishes / Growing Together
3.plot: With Addy home sick, Michael finds it difficult to enjoy a beach trip with Stillwater. A critter causes trouble in Addy and Maya's garden.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E07 - The Catio / Campout
3.plot: Michael, Molly, and Leo build Jasper a hideout, but he doesn't seem interested in it. Karl and Koo set off on a daring overnight adventure.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E08 - Book Club / Treasure Hunt
3.plot: Addy worries her new book club will find her favorite book too childish. Karl spends a day at the beach looking for buried treasure.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E09 - The Catch / Missing Out
3.plot: Michael gives himself a hard time for missing the game-winning catch. Addy feels left out when she isn't invited to a birthday dinner.

3.title: FR - Eau-Paisible - S03E10 - I'm Bored / Art Fair
3.plot: A bored Karl takes out his frustrations on everyone around him. Michael struggles to finish an art project for an upcoming fair.

meta.plot: Imaginez un monde dans lequel la course à l'espace n'aurait jamais pris fin. Le programme spatial de la NASA est resté au cœur de la culture américaine et au plus proche des espoirs et des rêves de tout un chacun. Les astronautes de la NASA, véritables héros et rock-stars de leur époque, doivent gérer la pression qui pèsent sur leurs épaules, tout en gérant la vie de leurs familles.

4.plot: Tensions on Earth and Mars come to a head.

Alors qu’il doit user de toute son ingéniosité pour sauver la vie des passagers, sa stratégie très risquée pourrait bien le mener à sa perte.

meta.plot:
Dans cette compétition de téléréalité, quatre équipes de passionnés des océans et des requins sillonnent les océans dans une course autour du monde pour identifier, filmer et recenser les requins les plus rares et remporter un prix de 50 000 dollars destiné à une organisation engagée dans la protection des océans.

Des eaux du Japon, des Maldives, d’Afrique du Sud, d’Australie, des Bahamas et des îles Galapagos à la recherche de requins, des Caraïbes au Pacifique, les participants cherchent à localiser des espèces aussi menacées qu’exceptionnelles, comme le grand requin-marteau ou le requin-chabot ocellé. Une compétition de téléréalité haletante entre science, écologie et aventure.

Alliant aventure, sensibilisation et compétition, c'est une série éducative et visuellement impressionnante, qui met en lumière la beauté et la vulnérabilité du monde sous-marin.

Une série pour les passionnés de nature et de défis.

Un hommage visuel aux requins et à leur écosystème.

meta.plot: Quatre flics du SDPJ des Hauts-de-Seine, Eddy Caplan, Walter Morlighem, Théo Wachevski et Roxane Delgado voient leur vie basculer lorsque leur chef, Rossi, se suicide, suite à une affaire où il est injustement mis en cause. Ils franchissent alors la "ligne jaune", n'hésitant pas à contourner la loi pour parvenir à leurs fins afin de laver leur honneur et celui de leur chef.

Dans un royaume où les chevaliers s'affrontent pour ravir le titre de Premier Chevalier, et pas toujours en respectant le code de l'honneur, le chevalier Henri peut compter sur le soutien de son fils, Jimmy, un écuyer enthousiaste, et de Cat, princesse féministe et intrépide. Nos trois héros affrontent ensemble sorcières maléfiques, rats voleurs, gros dragons et cyclopes géants

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E01 - How to Save a Princess
1.plot: Bored by centuries of knighthood tradition. young Jimmy shows off at an exercise about 'how to save a princess' from a tower. Unfortunately his friend Cat gets kidnapped by the big dragon Bad Jack. Jimmy and his dad Henri of Orange go after Bad Jack to show they can save a princess for real.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E02 - The Cat and the Swan
1.plot: Jimmy and Henri and kidnapped by a dragon for a end of the dragon year sacrifice; Cat and her mother the queen team up to rescue them.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E03 - Witch Hunters
1.plot: All the knights in the kingdom save Henri are turned into frogs by the evil witch, leaving Jimmy, Henri and Cat to trick the witch and rescue all the frog-knights.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E04 - Bad Bad Mandolin
1.plot: Jimmy accidentally drops his dad's mandolin off a cliff, so he and Cat visit the witch to get a new one, only to learn it was cursed so the witch can take over the kingdom.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E05 - Epic Ballroom

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E06 - Fashion Victims
1.plot: White knight sells tons of BWK merchandise that get the whole kingdom hooked on, only to leave them vulnerable to the witch's cyclops' attack.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E07 - Attack of the 50ft. Squire
1.plot: Jimmy learns he is too small to complete a squire competition in gym class, and drinks a growing potion to fix the problem.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E08 - The Helmet of Epic
1.plot: When Jimmy gets helmet that will make him a super warrior, it turns out to be cursed.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E09 - The Challenge
1.plot: After a foolhardy challenge causes Jimmy and Lance to be captured by Bad Jack, Henri and Wilfried must team up to save their squires.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E10 - Queen's Guard

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E11 - The Road Knight
1.plot: When the Black Rats are attacking all convoys supplying the kingdom, Henri is sent with a supercarriage to defeat them.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E12 - Epic Traffic
1.plot: When Jimmy pushes his dad into ‘good-deed overdrive’ to be First Knight, Henri goes too far and gets busted down to ‘Horse traffic duty.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E13 - The Stinky Swamp Witch
1.plot: When Jimmy and Cat find a witch’s broom, they can’t resist taking it for a spin, but the fun quickly ends, as they inflame the rage of every witch.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E14 - The Harvest Festival
1.plot: Jimmy and Cat scheme to stop Jack so he can't ruin the Harvest Festival because the Queen refused to do anything to stop him.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E15 - Treasure Trap
1.plot: Henri and Bad Jack race to find an extremely rare treasure; Jimmy lies to Bjorn, and must try to fix their friendship.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E16 - Guess Who's Coming for Dinner

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E17 - Fearless Colbert
1.plot: Jimmy and Cat learn that Colbert never completed his field exam, and he must go on a field mission with Henri to keep his job.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E18 - Cat's in the Bag
1.plot: Cat's feeling down about her prospects of becoming a knight, and Henri tries to save her with a song, which sends her on a solo quest.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E19 - Talent Show
1.plot: Henri offers to help Jimmy win the talent show, but a witch has disguised herself as a judge.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E20 - The Good Jack
1.plot: After Bad Jack is banished from the kingdom, and replaced with his brother, Jimmy joins forces with Jack to oust Jeff.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E21 - Henri the Felon
1.plot: When the Queen is kidnapped by a witch, Wilfried becomes regent, and arrests Henri for breaking his new laws.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E22 - Epically Small
1.plot: The Queen begins to shrink after eating a lollipop, and Jimmy and Henri must capture a witch to get the antidote.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E23 - Ronny and the Rock Monster
1.plot: Jimmy convinces Ronny Flash to interview a rock monster, and then must accompany him into the Dark Lands.

1.title: FR - Mon chevalier et moi - S01E24 - The Dragon Rider
1.plot: To impress the other squires, Jimmy pretends that Bjorn is his pet and Bad Jack threatens to burn Epic to the ground.

FR - Breakout Kings - S01E01 - Pilot (There are Rules)
1.plot: When convicted murderer August Tillman escapes from prison, Veteran U.S. Marshals Charlie DuChamp and Ray Zancanelli decide to take an unorthodox approach to fugitive apprehension by forming a special task force comprised of the three most elusive fugitives they have ever captured. Convicts Lloyd Lowery, Philomena Rotchcliffer and Shea Daniels agree to assist in the case in exchange for time off their sentences.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E02 - Collected
1.plot: Xavier Price escapes from prison in the midst of a candlelight vigil outside the penitentiary. The Breakout Kings are immediately brought on the case to try and track him down. It turns out this violent criminal is a "collector," and has a history of kidnapping women, torturing them, and holding them captive in basements. Once the team learns he currently has a woman hidden away somewhere, the race is on to the find her before Virgil can harm her.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E03 - The Bag Man
1.plot: Theodore 'T-Bag' Bagwell, a sociopath with a prosthetic hand and a mean streak to go with it, makes a bloody escape from prison and sets out on a path of vengeance.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E04 - Out of the Mouths of Babes
1.plot: Joe, a convicted pedophile, disguises himself as a crewmember on a film shoot and makes a break for it. The team must not only catch him, but must be sure he doesn't commit any more crimes while on the loose. Their first lead sends them to the school where Joe worked as a counselor and where the six children are who he as accused of molesting. They also manage to track down Joe's estranged wife and children, whose lives have been seemingly destroyed by Joe's life-sentence in prison. Meanwhile, Erica is determined to see her six-year-old daughter on her birthday and Charlie's wife urges him to take her on a much-needed vacation.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E05 - Queen of Hearts
1.plot: The team tries to catch a ruthless woman convicted of murdering her husband by stabbing him 48 times, who escaped from prison on a school bus. It turns out the woman was tricking men into thinking she really cared for them so they would do what she wanted and help her escape. Charlie and Ray's special task force must catch her before she hurts more people -- and also make sure her 14-year-old son stays safe. Meanwhile, Lloyd's gambling debt increases and a scary Born Again inmate threatens his life if he doesn't come up with the money right away.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E06 - Like Father, Like Son
1.plot: An escaped convict is out to bring down the prison system, all the pillars of organized government that he detests, and even a member of the team assigned to bring him to justice; Lloyd faces some difficult questions about where he came from.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E07 - Fun with Chemistry
1.plot: The race is on for the team to catch a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde after a cop is killed during a crime and killing spree following their escape: if the law enforcement agencies catch them first the Kings don't get a reduction in their sentences. Meanwhile, Julianne thinks about getting romantic with one of the Kings.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E08 - Steaks
1.plot: An oversized inmate is poisoned and his coffin is used as a “Trojan Horse” for two inmates to escape the Cayuga Correctional Facility. One prisoner, out for revenge, brutally murders a prison guard, causing friction with the other prisoner, who only wants a big payday and to live in luxury. The murder also increases the urgency to catch the cons. Meanwhile, Ray dangles a tantalizing carrot in front of the team: between Erica, Shea, and Lloyd, whoever proves to be the most useful on this case will be the proud recipient of a tasty steak dinner.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E09 - One for the Money
1.plot: A handsome, rich, and cunning jewel thief, Andre, escapes from prison leaving all the prison guards scratching their heads and he breaks out just in time to make the biggest score of his career. It’s up to the Breakout Kings to track him down and figure out just what he’s been plotting and stop him before its too late. Meanwhile, Shea and Erica plead with Ray to allow them to have conjugal visits.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E10 - Paid in Full
1.plot: A notorious contract killer escapes from the prison to carry out some unfinished business. As he is offing people left and right, the Breakout Kings must try to figure out the connection between his victims, catch him and lock him back up before he can kill again. The common thread between all of his victims was involvement in a tragic story involving the rape of a young female college student 5 years earlier, who’s father happens to be a guard at the prison from where he escaped.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E11 - Off the Beaten Path
1.plot: A violent schizophrenic with the skills of an outdoor survivalist and a history of ritualistic killing is off his meds and on the hunt. His prey, Debbie Myers, is a beautiful, young television host. After killing an orderly, he escapes and the one thing on his mind is finding Debbie, taking her to a special place in the Adirondack Mountains and consummating their “love” through a bizarre and violent ceremony which will surely end up with Debbie being killed.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E12 - There are Rules
1.plot: A shocking scene at a prison erupts when an 18 wheeler crashes into the prison wall and an armored car escapes from the back of the truck, with several convicted felons hiding inside. Our rag-tag team is quick to begin the hunt for the fugitives and they learn the escapees are being lead by Ronald Barnes, a Madoff-like man who is hated by all. The follow Barnes’ trail and eventually realize that his plans of helping his fellow cons reach freedom along with him were all a ruse to distract the authorities from tracking down Barnes himself. Barnes will kill anyone that gets in his way and the Breakout Kings must outsmart him before it’s too late.

1.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S01E13 - Where in the World is Carmen Vega
1.plot: Carmen Vega, the ruthless queen pin of a drug cartel, pulls off a violent and deadly escape while attending the funeral of her slain son. Her plan, get the family business back in order and hand over the keys to the kingdom to the heir apparent, her son Cesar. Carmen will stop at nothing, including killing a member of her team and even her own family, to put Cesar on the throne. The Breakout Kings seem to be one step behind Carmen at every turn and they smell a rat. Is there an informant within the team? Not only do the Breakout Kings need to catch Carmen to their month off, they also need Carmen to give up the location of where Shea’s girlfriend is being held hostage to save her life. Find the rat, catch Carmen and save a loved one, the Breakout Kings have their work cut out for them. In the end, they realize they really are a team and there’s no going back.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E01 - An Unjust Death
2.plot: In the second-season opener, the team hunt a merciless serial killer whom Lloyd's testimony helped convict. Meanwhile, Charlie gets offered a promotion, putting the fate of the program in jeopardy.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E02 - Round Two
2.plot: A gang of vicious criminals escape prison via an underground tunnel. The Breakout Kings find themselves cooperating with the FBI after learning one of the gang members is actually an undercover agent. When it starts to look like the undercover agent may have been turned, the pressure is on for the Kings to hunt them down and discover the truth. All the while, the team must struggle with the loss of one of their own.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E03 - Double Down
2.plot: Travis Muncey, actor and stool pigeon, escapes from prison. The Breakout Kings quickly find and snatch him back, only to discover that Travis is the key to capturing an even bigger fish. Things get serious when one of the team is kidnapped, and no holds are barred to make the team whole again.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E04 - Cruz Control
2.plot: Following a very clever breakout from the motor pool, the escapee takes off on a killing spree with reckless abandon until Lloyd realizes that, driven by his own fatal diagnosis, he is checking off a killing bucket list. He thinks of himself as an avenging angel, and it's up to the team to stop him and put an end to the violence.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E05 - Self Help
2.plot: The Breakout Kings are back on the job, charged with answering the perplexing question: Why does a convict escape from prison without ever leaving the prison? To commit the perfect crime. How does he do it? That's up to the team to find out.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E06 - I Smell Emmy
2.plot: A female prison volunteer is attacked by a rough female inmate. On the way to the court hearing that is a result of that attack, the inmate takes ill at a very precise time. The transport is forced to turn into a rest stop, where the inmate escapes. When the inmate shows up at the home of the volunteer and stabs her husband it appears tragic, until it's learned the volunteer and inmate had been working together. The Breakout Kings are in hot pursuit of this "Thelma and Louise-like" duo as they make a run for it.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E07 - Ain't Love (50) Grand
2.plot: A convict on cleanup duty is harassed day after day by one of the guards--until the day he can't take it anymore. The convict kills the guard and escapes to go find the love of his life. He loves her so much in fact, that he killed her abusive stepfather. That's how he ended up in prison. The girl, our Juliet, has led Romeo to believe that she is waiting for him and loves him eternally. However, believing him to be serving a lifelong prison sentence, she has moved on and has loved him in name only, so to speak. Enraged, Romeo kidnaps Juliet. It's up the Breakout Kings to save them both.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E08 - SEALd Fate
2.plot: Ex-Navy SEAL Jonah Whitman makes a gruesome escape from prison. His mental health is in question and he’s considered to be armed and extremely dangerous. Rather than run, though, Jonah proceeds to exact revenge from his former employers at ALASTOR, a government contractor that sets conspiracy theorists buzzing. The Breakout Kings track Jonah and attempt to bring him in, while uncovering the truth behind his paranoia.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E09 - Freakshow
2.plot: Max Doyle was an orphan raised in the circus with an ax to grind. All his life Max has felt a lack of belonging, a feeling that was only partially assuaged by turning himself into a premiere escape artist. It's that talent that the Breakout Kings are up against as they track Max. Meanwhile, not all of the Kings are on the case, at least one stays back to follow a clue left by their nemesis Damien Fontleroy - with disastrous consequences.

2.title: FR - Breakout Kings - S02E10 - Served Cold
2.plot: The conflict between Damian Fontleroy and the Breakout Kings comes to a head when Damian abducts Ray's daughter.

meta.plot: En échange d'une remise de peine, des détenus spécialistes de l'évasion aident des U.S. Marshals à retrouver des évadés. Ils gagnent un peu de réduction de peine à chaque évadé repris. En revanche, si l'un d'entre eux tente de s'enfuir, tous retournent en prison et leur peine sera doublée.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E01 - Opening Moves
1.plot: Balagan's first case is launched when Danni pleads with him to find a missing boy and, in a race against time, he enlists Sam and Alcina to help.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E02 - Turkish Hold'em
1.plot: A daring robbery during a high-stakes poker game forces Hugo to ask Balagan for help, prompting the chess master to create his own complex plot to trap the culprit.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E03 - The Caffeine Hit
1.plot: A well-dressed man wakes up on the sidewalk with no shoes, no wallet, and no memory. The only thing in his pocket is a receipt that leads him to the Huxley Hotel. Remembering nothing but how much he loves his wife, the man hires Balagan to find her and to help him rediscover his identity. While uncovering the truth of the amnesiac’s complicated life, Balagan battles with Pippa over the investigation into Rosemary’s murder.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E04 - The Other Side of Summer
1.plot: Swallowing his pride, Hugo asks Balagan for help. Walt, Hugo’s police mentor, is retiring, but one unsolved case still haunts him. Twenty years ago, a teen girl disappeared and Walt is convinced her ex-boyfriend, Stephen, killed her. But because the girl’s body was never found, Walt could never charge Stephen. Now with Balagan’s help, Hugo hopes to find the one piece of evidence that will put Stephen behind bars before Walt takes matters into his own hands. Pippa comes to Balagan with some startling news in Rosemary’s case: the police have finally arrested a suspect.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E05 - I Killed Her
1.plot: A mysterious doctor tells Balagan that he is responsible for the murder of a woman found in the hotel pool during a Psychiatric Conference, drawing Balagan into a complex and dangerous game.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E06 - Fearful Symmetry
1.plot: Enlisted by a terrified family to help solve the inexplicable bombing of their car, Balagan is sidetracked by an unexpected match with a 16-year-old world chess champion.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E07 - Gorillas in our Midst
1.plot: Smitten by a beautiful Chinese cryptologist, Sam convinces Balagan to try to solve an intricate puzzle involving a vital secret and an attractive, conniving female journalist.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E08 - The White Queen
1.plot: When the imperious heiress of the Huxley Hotel empire descends for an inspection, she coerces Balagan into helping her find her son, who has mysteriously disappeared.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E09 - Huxley, We Have a Problem
1.plot: When Balagan’s oldest friend, the larger than life Russian cosmonaut Oleg Olesky, comes to the Huxley, he brings more than the party. About to pilot the first private space tourism rocket ship, Oleg is there with Chase Galactic as they announce their maiden launch. When the head engineer, Randall, falls from the roof of the hotel, Oleg is the prime suspect. With his only alibi being the fact he was with his boss’s wife, which she denies, Oleg pleads for Balagan’s help. Balagan eventually figures out the true motive for Randall’s murder – and the real murderer.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E10 - Bless This Union
1.plot: When the hotel safe is robbed during an extravagant Indian wedding celebration, the distraught couple asks Balagan to help recover their stolen gifts- but is it an inside job or the work of professionals?

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E11 - Mr Black
1.plot: Balagan is forced to match his chess skills against a computer when his anonymous online opponent reveals that he is playing for lethally high stakes - the lives of a group of innocent hostages.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E12 - Polar Opposites
1.plot: A rock star rock star hires Balagan to find $200,000 stolen from him - a mystery that also involves colourful groupies, a missing polar bear, and the kidnapped grandmother of Danni's estranged husband.

1.title: FR - Endgame - S01E13 - Deadman Talking
1.plot: After Balagan investigates the sudden death of a hotel security guard, he is forced to face his worst nightmare.

meta.plot: Depuis qu'il a été témoin du meurtre de sa fiancée, l'ancien champion d'échecs Arkady Balagan vit cloitré dans sa chambre d'hôtel, terrorisé à l'idée de se mélanger à la foule. Comme il faut bien payer ses factures, le russe s'improvise enquêteur, aidant la police à résoudre des affaires délicates. Sans même se déplacer sur les lieux du crime, Balagan use de son esprit analytique et stratégique pour élucider les enquêtes en fonction des éléments rapportés par la police et son entourage qu'il n'hésite pas à envoyer sur la terrain à sa place. Véritable génie, il imagine dans sa tête les différents scénarios avec l'aide de son pouvoir de déduction.

meta.plot: Après la disparition en mer de Lucien Bartoli, propriétaire d’un 4 étoiles, sa fille aînée Louise a repris l’hôtel aidée par son fils Gabriel, en lésant son frère Tarek et sa sœur Audrey. Cette dernière a mis de la distance alors qu’un lourd secret gangrène depuis des années les relations de la fratrie. Alors que Théa, la fille d’Audrey, revient à l’hôtel, un étrange corbeau cible le domaine...

Suivez le parcours de Baylen Dupree, une jeune femme atteinte du syndrome de la Tourette. Malgré ses difficultés quotidiennes, Baylen, sa famille et son petit ami de longue date n'ont pas peur de rire et d'accepter le chaos qui rend leur vie quotidienne unique.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E01 - I Have Tourette's Stupid!
1.plot: Baylen Dupree is a young adult living with Tourette Syndrome and it impacts every aspect of her life and the lives of her parents and five siblings. Ready to be an independent adult, Baylen tries to navigate a world full of triggers and danger, but a phone call from her boyfriend during her brother’s birthday might turn her whole world upside down.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E02 - The Airport is a Tic Disaster
1.plot: Baylen learns what Colin's work relocation could mean for their relationship. Baylen is invited to be a guest panelist at a Tourette's Convention in Dallas but airports and flying can be a recipe for disaster.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E03 - We All Have Tourette's
1.plot: Baylen travels to Texas for a Tourette convention, but her tics threaten to overpower her big moment. After connecting with new friends and a doctor who suggests a radical treatment, it all proves too much for Baylen when she suffers a severe tic attack.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E04 - Going For Narnia!
1.plot: After suffering a terrifying tic attack, questions are raised about Baylen's ability to live on her own. Baylen and Colin decide to take a big step in their relationship, but the excitement is short-lived as they begin sharing the news with their families.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E05 - It Was Him, Chainsaws, Me
1.plot: Baylen and Colin are excited to live together but they need an approval from Colin's very conservative parents first. Allen, still uneasy about their decision, talks man to man with Colin. Baylen tries Botox to help with her tics. Colin drops a life changing bomb.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E06 - I Have News
1.plot: After an eventful apartment hunting adventure, Baylen and Colin move in together, but outside forces bring everything to a halt. At Baylen's birthday party, tension is in the air as Colin's birthday surprise royally backfires, leaving Baylen wondering if they're on the same page.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E07 - What If My Dad Says No?
1.plot: After a huge fight at Baylen's birthday party, Colin works on rebuilding trust with her family. Allen and Julie worry Baylen's tics are getting worse and wonder if Deep Brain Stimulation could be an option. Colin breaks the news to Julie and Allen about his true intentions with Baylen.

1.title: FR - Baylen Out Loud - S01E08 - You Don't Have To Stare Into My Soul
1.plot: Colin seeks Baylen's parents' blessing to propose to her during their family vacation. Baylen and her parents meet with a neurologist to discuss Deep Brain Stimulation. Colin realizes its going to be an uphill battle after a secret meeting with Allen.

meta.plot: Josh Corman aurait pu être une rock star s’il avait eu un peu plus de chance et de discernement. À la place, il est devenu enseignant, et même s’il aime ses élèves, il a du mal à trouver sens et bonheur dans un monde qui semble manquer des deux.

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E01 - Good Luck
1.plot: Josh has a lot to be grateful for. It just doesn't always feel that way.

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E02 - Don't Panic
1.plot: Josh's breathing is fine, thank you so much.

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E04 - Mr. Morales

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E05 - Action Adventure
1.plot: Josh enters the toxic realm of dudes who struck out but don't want to go home.

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E07 - Many Worlds
1.plot: With different luck, different choices, Josh's life could have gone many different ways.

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E08 - Hope You Feel Better
1.plot: Josh retreats in the face of his exact nightmare.

1.title: FR - Mr. Corman - S01E09 - Mr. Corman

meta.plot: Découvrez l’équipe qui est à l’origine du plus grand jeu vidéo multijoueur de tous les temps. Mais au sein de cette entreprise dédiée à la création de mondes et de légendes, les batailles les plus féroces ne sont pas virtuelles.

1.title: FR - Mythic Quest : Le festin du corbeau - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: As the hit video game Mythic Quest prepares to launch its newest update, creator Ian Grimm obsesses over a seemingly minor detail.

1.title: FR - Mythic Quest : Le festin du corbeau - S01E02 - The Casino
1.plot: Brad takes the day off to prove a point, leaving Poppy and David to keep the game afloat. Dana and Rachel have a girls' night in.

1.title: FR - Mythic Quest : Le festin du corbeau - S01E03 - Dinner Party
1.plot: The development team must take decisive action when the internet discovers a dark group of gamers congregating in Mythic Quest.

3.title: FR - Ted Lasso - S03E09 - La Locker Room Aux Folles

3.title: FR - Ted Lasso - S03E10 - International Break

3.title: FR - Ted Lasso - S03E11 - Mom City
3.plot: An unexpected guest has Ted on edge. When Richmond travel to Manchester for a big match, Roy and Keeley become concerned about Jamie.

3.title: FR - Ted Lasso - S03E12 - So Long, Farewell

4.title: FR - Ted Lasso - S04E02 - Curiouser and Curiouser
4.plot: Ted returns to Richmond to meet the Lady Greyhounds, but not everyone is glad to see him.

4.title: FR - Ted Lasso - S04E03 - Richmond's Got Talent

meta.plot: Grâce à ce docu-série raconté par Tom Hiddleston, plongez dans la vie nocturne des animaux à travers six continents, en haute définition et en couleurs, et levez le mystère sur un monde jusqu’ici inexploré.

1.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S01E01 - Lion Grasslands
1.plot: After dark on Kenya's Maasai Mara grasslands, a lioness won't rest until she finds the young cubs she's lost.

1.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S01E02 - Tarsier Forest
1.plot: As darkness falls, a family of tiny primates in Sulawesi ventures into the jungle to find food while protecting their babies.

1.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S01E03 - Jaguar Jungle
1.plot: A jaguar fights to keep his river home in Brazil as the night brings both challenges and opportunities to hunt.

1.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S01E04 - Bear Woodlands
1.plot: In the boreal forests of Europe, a young brown bear clashes with wolves—and tries to find a mate beneath the stars.

1.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S01E05 - Wild Cities
1.plot: When Los Angeles, Chicago, and Toronto light up at nightfall, they create worlds of opportunities for the cleverest animals willing to take the risk.

2.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S02E02 - Puma Mountain

2.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S02E04 - Coral Reef

2.title: FR - Terre : les couleurs nocturnes - S02E05 - Seal Coast

1.plot: Julia, a 14-year old orphan, is placed in the care of foster parent Mr. Leopold and joins his other charges, Johnny, Tabby and Finn, on a 2,000-acre farm; when an Alien's ship crashes into their barn, they learn Julia is not the only new arrival.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E02 - The End is the Beginning (Part 2)
1.plot: The escaped endlings on the Leopold farm put the family at odds, leaving Julia's future there in question. But after one of the creatures allows Julia to relive her past, it's up to her to decide whether or not she'll let her past control her future.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E03 - The Elephant in the Room
1.plot: Another endling's escape wakes the injured Alien. With the police and a mysterious guest on their way, Tabby and Julia argue over what to do with their now-awake visitor, while Johnny worries about another run-in with law enforcement.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E04 - The Enemy of My Enemy
1.plot: With Julia and Finn on the run with the Alien, it’s up to Johnny, Mr. Leopold and a reluctant Tabby to find them. What they don’t know is that while Julia is trying to get away from the farm, a subterranean creature is being lured there.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E05 - Curiosity
1.plot: After Tuko's caretaker Abiona takes revenge on the Alien, Julia must find a way to convince her to help. Unfortunately, the Alien isn't the only being who needs saving as Johnny, Tabby and Finn deal with a new endling, this one from earth's own history.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E06 - Surprise
1.plot: The pursuit of a mysterious new creature catches the attention of the local police. After a particularly close encounter, Mr. Leopold forbids Johnny from continuing the chase, causing a rift between foster father and son.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E07 - Home
1.plot: Tabby has a disappointing visit with her estranged mother while Julia, Johnny and Finn try to save an adorable endling. When Tabby falls in love with the new creature and tries to hide it, her feelings threaten the safety of her foster family.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E08 - Found and Lost
1.plot: Abiona joins Johnny and Julia’s search for a new sightless endling, while back at the farm Tabby tries to keep Finn and Mr. Leopold from discovering the creature she’s hiding in the house.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E09 - Are You Afraid of the Light?
1.plot: While Mr. Leopold confronts his past, Johnny, Julia, Tabby, and Finn must trap a recently released endling before it traps them.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E10 - Invisible
1.plot: With the recently named Alien on the mend Julia, Johnny, Tabby and Finn turn their attention to helping a new endling that can’t survive in the cold. But the creature’s unique ability to hide makes saving it nearly impossible.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E11 - Extinction
1.plot: While pursuing an elusive endling, Julia, Johnny, Tabby and Finn come across a menacing trap and realize they’re not the only ones trying to capture the creature.

1.title: FR - Endlings - S01E12 - The End Is the Beginning Is the End
1.plot: Tabby, Johnny, Julia and Finn race to save a trapped endling while a seemingly endless stream of drones try to capture it. Unhappy with her drones’ progress, Hewes and her team arrive to finish the mission themselves.

2.plot: When Julia is forced to face a familiar enemy alone, all of the endlings are caught in the balance. To save their mission and her new family, Julia must finally face her greatest hurt.

2.plot: Finn accidentally releases an electrifying new endling as Tabby struggles with an impending reunion. Meanwhile a sighting of a recently extinct animal leads Mitra and Lopez back to Hewes.
