meta.plot: Que renferme les mines du Roi Salomon ? La tombe légendaire existe-t-elle vraiment ? Nul ne peut le dire, car ceux qui sont partis à sa recherche n'en sont jamais revenus. L'aventurier, Allan Quartermain, a été engagé par la belle anglaise, Elizabeth Andersen, pour l'aider à retrouver son père, explorateur perdu en Afrique, aperçu pour la dernière fois près du site mythique, et pour mettre à jour ce fameux mystère.
Après avoir perdu la mémoire dans un étrange accident où presque tous ses camarades ont péri, Alma tente de comprendre ce qui s'est passé et de retrouver son identité.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E01 - Fog
1.plot: A high school class attends a retreat on a mountain, but on the way home, a horrific accident occurs with both fatal and inexplicable consequences.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E02 - Secrets
1.plot: Upon her return, Alma struggles to recover her memories, and she's intrigued by what feels familiar. Tom bids farewell to a friend.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E03 - Searching
1.plot: Diana implores Bruno to help her find her brother. Alma spends time with Tom in the hope of finding answers. A survivor discovers that he has powers.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E04 - Shadows
1.plot: Rumors about Carlos and pills continue to spread. Alma sorts through Deva's secret box. Bruno and company are shocked by visitors.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E05 - Lara
1.plot: Tom walks Alma through his final memories with Lara and their group of friends and details their search for the supernatural Hexaspeculum.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E06 - Revelations
1.plot: Alma insists that she and Tom see the Hexaspeculum in person. Nearby, Martín, Bruno and Diana puzzle over the implications of the prophecy.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E07 - Thresholds
1.plot: Alma starts piecing together what happened the day of the bus accident and remembers important moments of her life.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E08 - Deva
1.plot: Martín and Diana learn more about their family's history. Berta makes a startling discovery about Roque while Deva's mom gets an unsettling visit.

1.title: FR - Alma - S01E09 - Return
1.plot: Tom pays tribute to his classmates and then makes a decision about his future. Alma struggles with saying goodbye. Martín attempts to move forward.

meta.plot: Dans un futur proche, la police de Los Angeles emploie des androïdes à la plastique semblable aux humains. John Kennex perd un de ses collègues et sa jambe lors d'une mission piège tendue par la mystérieuse organisation, le Syndicat. Après dix-sept mois de coma, le policier s'efforce de rassembler ces souvenirs dans l'espoir de pouvoir venger son ami et retrouver sa bien-aimée disparue. Entre temps, il lui faut reprendre du service. Son retour est d'autant plus difficile qu'il lui faut faire équipe avec un de ces robots très attachés au règlement. Lui est alors exceptionnellement assigné un ancien modèle, retiré du service après quelques quelques défaillances...

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: In the year 2048, an unprecedented increase in the crime rate has made being a cop only more dangerous than it is today, necessitating that every police officer partner with an android. John Kennex, a detective and sole survivor of a devastating police ambush, and his robot partner, Dorian, solve cases and fight to keep the lid on dangerously evolved criminals in this futuristic landscape.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E02 - Skin
1.plot: Detective John Kennex and Dorian are dispatched to investigate a murder and high-profile missing persons case that lead them into the highly profitable world of IRCs – Intimate Robot Companions – also known as sexbots. Meanwhile, Kennex looks to reconcile a part of his troubled past.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E03 - Are You Receiving?
1.plot: The thrilling action continues in another all-new, adrenaline-fueled episode. Detective Kennex and Dorian battle an intense and futuristic hostage situation, while Captain Maldonado (Lili Taylor) attempts to meet the terrorist’s demands, hoping to protect innocent people.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E04 - The Bends
1.plot: An old cop friend of Detective Kennex's goes undercover, posing as a "cook" of a highly addictive street drug called "The Bends." But his cover is blown. As the scope of the intense drug investigation unfolds, a determined Kennex and Dorian call on Rudy Lom for assistance.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E05 - Blood Brothers
1.plot: Kennex and Dorian must protect a witness in a major murder trial; Capt. Maldonado butts heads with a defendant.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E06 - Arrhythmia
1.plot: Detective John Kennex and Dorian respond to a suspicious death at a hospital where - before having a fatal cardiac arrest - a man claimed someone was trying to kill him, and inexplicably knew his exact time of death. As the investigation unfolds, a black market for vital organs is uncovered in which bio-mechanical hearts can be resold and remotely "shut off." As the team fights to find the pulse of this 2048 tech-centric crime, Dorian reconnects with a decommissioned DRN

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E07 - Simon Says
1.plot: Det. Kennex and Dorian investigate Simon, a psychopathic killer who is strapping bombs to his victims' neck and broadcasting their final moments over the internet. When Simon targets Kennex, the team is in a nail-biting race against time to save his life. Meanwhile, a power deficiency affects Dorian's energy level, causing him to have unexpected outbursts

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E08 - You Are Here
1.plot: Det. Kennex and Dorian investigate a crime scene involving a self-guided bullet that can track, target and kill specific people at any moment. Meanwhile, Maldonado revisits the deadly ambush that almost killed Kennex.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E09 - Unbound
1.plot: A refurbished, advanced DRN (Gina Carano) that operates like a soldier goes on a rampage, resulting in casualties; Dorian and Kennex ask a genius roboticist and DRN creator for help.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E10 - Perception
1.plot: When Det. Kennex and Dorian investigate the simultaneous and sudden deaths of two genetically-enhanced - or "chrome" - children, a fatal dose of the perfect designer drug appears to be the cause. As the investigation unfolds and a recent drowning victim is mysteriously connected, the case takes an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Kennex endures painful flashes from the past and pays a visit to the recollectionist

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E11 - Disrupt
1.plot: Kennex and Dorian investigate when a smart home turns on its occupants.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E12 - Beholder
1.plot: When Det. Kennex and Dorian investigate the murder of a "chrome," there are no signs of trauma, other than a very small pinprick on the back of his neck. As the investigation unfolds, it’s revealed that the murder suspect is tapping into the DNA of his victims in pursuit of perfection.

1.title: FR - Almost Human - S01E13 - Straw Man
1.plot: A series of murders are committed by someone copying a serial killer who was put in jail by Kennex's father.

1.title: FR - Chosen - S01E01 - The Fact That Meteors Are Made of Glass Is Pretty Crazy!
1.plot: After losing her job at a local tourist attraction, Emma teams up with a group of teens investigating the secrets behind a meteor crash 17 years ago.

1.title: FR - Chosen - S01E02 - Just Think of Queen Margrethe
1.plot: Despite her mother's objection, Emma visits her biology teacher and meets an ominous figure. Marie and Frederik keep an eye on Hans.

1.title: FR - Chosen - S01E03 - Have You Heard?
1.plot: Still reeling from the attack, Emma searches for evidence to prove she isn't lying. Marie and Elvis find a mysterious plant in Hans' basement.

1.title: FR - Chosen - S01E04 - Call Mads
1.plot: The team follows a strange signal to an abandoned sawmill outside of town. Mads drives a wedge between Emma, Marie and Frederik.

1.title: FR - Chosen - S01E05 - You Hold It with Your Fingers. You Eat It with Your Mouth
1.plot: Emma and Lukas work together to track down a man from the sawmill. Mads confronts the CEO of Astraeus about his suspicions.

1.title: FR - Chosen - S01E06 - You Still Want Everything to Be About You
1.plot: Emma comes to terms with her parentage. While Mads helps Astraeus search for Emma and Lukas, Frederik and Marie have to choose sides.

meta.plot: Une ado danoise voit son univers basculer quand elle découvre la troublante vérité qui se cache dans sa petite ville sans histoire.

1.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Top cop John Major is killed after a failed operation. But then the Met brings him back - as an AI prototype.

1.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Major screws up during an investigation and Carver wonders whether to turn him in. But when he learns of the consequences, he decides to cover for him.

1.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: After he and Carver are given a new assignment by Dennett, a suspicious Major prefers to stake out Kelly's work as he has a hunch she's been seeing someone else.

1.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The pressure is on in the latest assignment and failure could mean it's shutdown for Major once and for all...

1.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: To Carver's bewilderment, Major reveals that he is going to move back in with Kelly. Parfit discovers disturbing information in the AI Ethics files.

1.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: With Major's AI finally living up to the hype, Carver and Kelly come clean about their relationship. The team lies in wait to catch The Juggler.

2.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Major, Carver and Kelly have gone their separate ways. Things are looking up for the AI-enhanced Major, whilst Carver is gunning for a promotion and is knee deep in a new case.

2.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Carver and Major receive new information on the Chelsea Bridge Case – a £50 million robbery committed twenty years ago by a gang who seemed to vanish into thin air.

2.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: DCS Dennett officially reopens the Chelsea Bridge case, reuniting Major with his absent father, Clifford, who failed to solve the case 20 years earlier. As Major's AI becomes increasingly unstable, Dr. Parfit and Carver clash over the solution.

2.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Major's glitchy AI seriously impacts his police work. Dr. Parfitt's solution to Major's problems lead to a troubling realisation for Dennett.

2.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Carver deals with an unstable Major, and Dennett calls in a favour from Millikan Biotech. When the detective inspectors are assigned to a witness protection case with some familiar faces, Carver learns shocking truths and confronts Major.

2.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: When Carver and Kelly find a collapsed Major with just three hours left to live, they try to get him to accept the truth. Major is determined to solve the Chelsea Bridge case and exonerate his dad before his AI shuts down.

3.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Major and Carver reunite, but tensions remain high. When a police officer is murdered, Carver becomes hell-bent on solving the case, Major has an epiphany and resolves to become a better man, and both detective inspectors are out to prove themselves.

3.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: With a serial killer at large, Major and Carver call on the help of forensic psychologist Professor McAllister. Parfit worries about Major's AI updates.

3.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Major faces an outside threat to his AI, and Carver contends with a serial killer's twisted games.

3.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Major and Carver begin to close the net on the killer when a witness provides a shocking revelation.

3.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Chalmers, the former police commissioner who has plagued Major since the day he was reanimated, faces trial. With Major busy testifying, Carver is running out of time to decipher the latest clue and save the killer's next target.

3.title: FR - Code 404 [VOSTFR] - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: With time running out and suspicions running wild within SIU, Carver must clear Major's name and thwart the killer's final revenge.

meta.plot: Dans un futur proche, les détectives John Major et Roy Carver sont des références en matière de lutte contre la criminalité. Au cours d'une enquête où les deux détectives sont infiltrés, John Major est abattu. Une intelligence artificielle est alors créée et implantée dans le corps du défunt.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The city of Los Angeles has been occupied by an unknown force. Former FBI agent Will Bowman and his wife Katie are separated from their son during the invasion, and are willing to do anything to be reunited with him. When they are offered a chance to get their son back by collaborating with the occupational government, Will and Katie find themselves faced with the toughest decision of their lives.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E02 - A Brave New World
1.plot: Will faces unforeseen challenges on his first day at his new job. Katie receives her first assignment. Maddie reconnects with an old acquaintance. Carlos pays the price for Will's collaboration.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E03 - 98 Seconds
1.plot: Katie's first mission forces her to question her commitment to the cause. Will's search for Geronimo doesn't sit well with the resistance. Bram's girlfriend shares a secret with him.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E04 - Blind Spot
1.plot: Will continues to earn the respect of his new colleagues, but when his home comes under an attack, everyone is a suspect- even those closest to him. Meanwhile, Maddie finds a way in to the upper echelon.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E05 - Geronimo
1.plot: Geronimo's identity is revealed. Will begins to question Katie's loyalties. Bram finds his way into a secret world. Snyder sees an opportunity to improve his standing.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E06 - Yoknapatawpha
1.plot: A resistance operation traps Will, Katie and Snyder in the Yonk and tests their allegiances.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E07 - Broussard
1.plot: Will hunts the resistance, bringing him closer to learning his wife's secret. Katie feels cut off from her family and her cell. Maddie is caught up in Green Zone intrigue.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E08 - In from the Cold
1.plot: A high-ranking Resistance member is ready to cut a deal. Katie receives a second chance. Bram proposes a risky journey outside the colony walls.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E09 - Zero Day
1.plot: Will wants his family out from under the occupation. Katie and Broussard plot a major operation. Snyder tries to protect his office. Maddie makes a bold political move.

1.title: FR - Colony - S01E10 - Gateway
1.plot: The Resistance kidnaps a high-value target. The L.A. bloc is placed on lockdown.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E01 - Eleven.Thirteen
2.plot: The second season opener has Will and Katie trying to keep their family together in the changing city.  Broussard returns home while Snyder receives a job offer from a mysterious organization.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E02 - Somewhere Out There
2.plot: Will decides to trust an old friend. Jennifer visits Katie while Bram meets the camp commandant.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E03 - Sublimation
2.plot: Will, Devon, and Charlie try to journey home. Katie, who fears the worst, says goodbye to her daughter. Bram makes friends at camp; and Maddie finds a new project.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E04 - Panopticon
2.plot: Jennifer keeps an eye on the Bowman house. The family encounters unexpected challenges when Charlie returns home.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E05 - Company Man
2.plot: Will returns to an unfamiliar workplace; Katie is on her best behavior; Broussard and his cell make a discovery about the Wall.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E06 - Fallout
2.plot: The Resistance reaches out to Katie; Will wants to help his wife bury her past; Maddie and Nolan visit the labor camp.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E07 - Free Radicals
2.plot: Bram embarks on a risky sabotage mission with his friends; Will faces the new Resistance; Kate learns a dark truth about the bloc.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E08 - Good Intentions
2.plot: Will and Katie must save a fugitive from the occupation; at the camp, Snyder hides evidence; Broussard's cell is threatened by one of their own.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E09 - Tamam Shud
2.plot: Will and Katie attempt to make contact with a new arrival in the bloc; Bob has some questions for the Bowman family.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E10 - The Garden of Beasts
2.plot: Will, Katie and Broussard search for a way out of the colony.  Maddie gets some visitors in the Green Zone.  Bram looks for closure.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E11 - Lost Boy
2.plot: Five different points of view show the attack on the Green Zone.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E12 - Seppuku
2.plot: Will, Katie, and Broussard battle the Red Hand for control of the RAP gauntlet; Snyder helps Helena regain control over the Los Angeles bloc.

2.title: FR - Colony - S02E13 - Ronin
2.plot: In the second season finale, the Bowman family must make an impossible choice following a revelation about the fate of the colony.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E01 - Maquis
3.plot: Six months after escaping Los Angeles, the Bowmans and Snyder enjoy a simple life in the mountains-until a sudden arrival changes everything.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E02 - Puzzle Man
3.plot: Will and Katie put themselves at risk to make contact with the Resistance. Broussard pieces together IGA secrets left behind in LA.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E03 - Sierra Maestra
3.plot: Will assesses the Resistance Camp's safety. Katie tries to get more involved. Broussard and Amy encounter survivors outside the walls.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E04 - Hospitium
3.plot: Will and Katie fear they might be in danger when the Resistance camp is put in lockdown. A risky plan makes Broussard question Amy's intentions.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E05 - End of the Road
3.plot: Will, Katie, and Snyder struggle to protect their secrets while under interrogation.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E06 - The Emerald City
3.plot: The Bowman family encounters danger on the road to a possible new home. After getting a hero's welcome at IGA headquarters, Snyder settles into retirement.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E07 - A Clean, Well-Lighted Place
3.plot: Will follows clues that may expose a dangerous secret about the Seattle Colony. Katie helps a refugee family. Bram steps in as a parent to Gracie.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E08 - Lazarus
3.plot: Katie suspects there might be a dark side to her refugee case work. Will helps Broussard and Amy with a Resistance operation. Snyder goes back to work for the IGA. Bram starts a new job.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E09 - The Big Empty
3.plot: Will, Broussard, Amy, and Bram work together to kidnap a high-ranking IGA officer.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E10 - Sea Spray
3.plot: Will and Katie question whether their family is safe in Seattle. Snyder digs up dirt on Everett Kynes. Amy parts ways with Broussard.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E11 - Disposable Heroes
3.plot: Will, Broussard, Katie, and Amy help the Outliers deal with an emergency. Snyder makes his play to take over Seattle. Kynes runs damage control.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E12 - Bonzo
3.plot: Will and the Outliers fight to save Kynes from Snyder's IGA army.

3.title: FR - Colony - S03E13 - What Goes Around
3.plot: Will makes a sacrifice to protect his family. Katie races to save refugees outside the walls. Snyder struggles to control a Colony amidst the chaos of war. Bram and Gracie make a big decision.

meta.plot: Dans un futur proche, les extraterrestes ont colonisé la Terre. Et pourtant, la plupart des humains ne savent pas à quoi ces aliens ressemblent, les personnes chargées de faire régner l'ordre étant des collaborateurs. À Los Angeles, les Bowman vivent comme beaucoup d'autres sous une menace constante. Lorsque le passé de Will, le père de la tribu, remonte à la surface, le gouverneur du secteur offre à cet ancien du FBI de mettre ses compétences à profit pour étouffer la progression de la résistance. Alléchés par la possibilité de retrouver leur fils cadet disparu depuis le jour de l'occupation, Will et son épouse Katie vont devoir prendre la plus difficile décision de leur existence. Choisiront-ils de collaborer... ou de résister ?

Passionné d'art, l'inspecteur Mick Palmer, enquête - épaulé de l'agent Shazia Malik - sur des meurtres liés au monde de l'art et des antiquités, des peintures de maîtres anciens au street art de Banksy, en passant par les manuscrits médiévaux et les vinyles de collection.

1.title: FR - Art Detectives [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Pictures at an Exhibition
1.plot: When an art historian is found murdered in his home, DI Mick Palmer and DC Shazia Malik are sent to investigate. As they dig into the case, they uncover a vandalized painting, sabotaged security footage, and a dark family secret.

3.plot: Katie suspects there might be a dark side to her refugee case work. Will helps Broussard and Amy with a Resistance operation. Snyder goes back to work for the IGA. Bram starts a new job.

3.title: FR - Colony [VOSTFR] - S03E09 - The Big Empty
3.plot: Will, Broussard, Amy, and Bram work together to kidnap a high-ranking IGA officer.

3.title: FR - Colony [VOSTFR] - S03E10 - Sea Spray
3.plot: Will and Katie question whether their family is safe in Seattle. Snyder digs up dirt on Everett Kynes. Amy parts ways with Broussard.

3.title: FR - Colony [VOSTFR] - S03E11 - Disposable Heroes
3.plot: Will, Broussard, Katie, and Amy help the Outliers deal with an emergency. Snyder makes his play to take over Seattle. Kynes runs damage control.

3.title: FR - Colony [VOSTFR] - S03E12 - Bonzo
3.plot: Will and the Outliers fight to save Kynes from Snyder's IGA army.

3.title: FR - Colony [VOSTFR] - S03E13 - What Goes Around
3.plot: Will makes a sacrifice to protect his family. Katie races to save refugees outside the walls. Snyder struggles to control a Colony amidst the chaos of war. Bram and Gracie make a big decision.

meta.plot: La République n'est plus, et le chaos est la seule règle régissant l'Univers ! Après s'être réveillé d'un sommeil de plus de 300 ans, Dylan Hunt, le Capitaine du croiseur Andromeda Ascendant, et son équipage tentent de rétablir l'équilibre dans la galaxie.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E01 - Under the Night (1)
1.plot:
It's the start of the war between the Systems Commonwealth and the Nietzschean fleets.  Captain Dylan Hunt and his ship the Andromeda Ascendant try to flee the first Nietzschean attack to warn the Commonwealth. In his attempt to escape, the Andromeda and Captain Hunt are caught in the event horizon of a black hole and frozen in time for 300 years.

The crew of the Eureka Maru with Captain Beka Valentine try to salvage the Andromeda to sell for a Nightsider's ransom.  After the Andromeda is pulled free, Hunt is unfrozen and forced to defend his ship against the salvagers and the Nietzschean mercenaries lead by Tyr Anasazi.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E02 - An Affirming Flame (2)
1.plot: Dylan and the crew of the Eureka Maru agree to join forces and become one team aboard the Andromeda Ascendant as they set forth on his mission to restore the Systems Commonwealth.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E03 - To Loose the Fateful Lightning
1.plot: Dylan inadvertently gives a group of child warriors power to destroy a solar system.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E04 - D Minus Zero
1.plot: Beka and Tyr square off against Dylan for leadership of Andromeda during a dangerous face-off with an unknown enemy.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E05 - Double Helix
1.plot: Captain Dylan Hunt must save the Andromeda from the Nietzscheans, who are trying to persuade Tyr to help them destroy the ship and rebuild his Nietzschean life. His new life would include a wife to carry on his lineage.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E06 - Angel Dark, Demon Bright
1.plot: Dylan is faced with a difficult decision when Andromeda slipstreams back in time -- days before the climactic battle of the Nietzschean Revolution where the Commonwealth was defeated and the Nietzschean Alliance was destroyed.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E07 - The Ties That Blind
1.plot: Beka's con-artist brother unexpectedly shows up claiming to be a devout Wayist making the Andromeda a prime target for Restorian attack.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E08 - The Banks of the Lethe
1.plot: Finally, after 300 years and a black hole keeping them apart, Captain Dylan Hunt reunites with his true love, Sara.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E09 - A Rose in the Ashes
1.plot: With their communication with the crew of the Eureka Maru completely cut off, Dylan and Rommie are forced into exile on a prison planet and must befriend fellow inmates to attempt any escape.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E10 - All Great Neptune's Ocean
1.plot: Tyr and Rommie are framed for the assassination of the Castalian president.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E11 - The Pearls That Were His Eyes
1.plot: Beka Valentine receives a distress call from her beloved Uncle Sid , but to her disdain realizes that he has become Sam Profit, a big business tycoon.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E12 - The Mathematics of Tears
1.plot: Andromeda encounters her damaged sister ship, the Pax Magellanic, that leads the crew of the Andromeda Ascendant on an eerie mission.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E13 - Music of a Distant Drum
1.plot: A crash landing on a strange planet leaves Tyr with a complete loss of memory and a mystery crate to protect from not-so-brotherly Nietzcheans.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E14 - Harper 2.0
1.plot: Harper finds himself overloaded with information when a dying Perseid transfers data into his brain.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E15 - Forced Perspective
1.plot: Dylan is taken captive and forced to admit that he killed the Mobius leader and overthrew the Mobius government more than 300 years ago.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E16 - The Sum of Its Parts
1.plot: A humanoid robot visits the Andromeda crew, helps them fight off a culture of organized machines and learns what it means to be a living being.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E17 - Fear and Loathing in the Milky Way
1.plot: Trance, Harper and their former employer Gerentex are unwilling partners on a wild ride to find a valuable artifact.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E18 - The Devil Take the Hindmost
1.plot: Rev Bem gets a call from a Wayist friend in need of his help to save the Hajira and its settlement, Serendipity, from being taken over by slavers.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E19 - The Honey Offering
1.plot: An arranged marriage between two rival Nietzschean Prides puts the Andromeda Ascendant in danger when Captain Dylan Hunt agrees to transport the bride to the wedding.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E20 - Star-Crossed
1.plot: Rommie falls in love with a surviving android (Michael Shanks) of a destroyed ship, only to be betrayed as he turns out to be the ultimate enemy.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E21 - It Makes a Lovely Light
1.plot: Beka jeopardizes the crew when she takes a mind-altering drug while attempting an exhaustive piloting mission that could bring Dylan to his long-lost home planet.

1.title: FR - Andromeda - S01E22 - Its Hour Come 'Round at Last (1)
1.plot: When Harper accidentally overrides Andromeda's personality with an older version, she hunts down the crew and goes on an old mission in which her former crew was slaughtered.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E01 - The Widening Gyre (2)
2.plot: Trance gets Beka and Dylan to medbay, while Rev goes to see a man about his god and Tyr and Harper are injected with Magog eggs and tied up. Dylan and the Andromeda avatar go down to get Tyr and Harper, leaving Beka behind with orders to use a nova bomb to detonate the "bound" planets' sun in three hours. Meanwhile Rev meets with Bloodmist, and begins to give into his bestial nature. The two of them confront the Magog "god", which seems to convince Rev to kill his friends. Bloodmist takes him to Tyr and Harper, but its a trick and Rev kills Bloodmist. Dylan and Andromeda are overwhelmed when Beka launches the nova bomb, but the Magog "god" manages to absorb all the energy. The distraction gives them time to free Tyr and Harper and get out of there. Trance manages to remove Tyr's spider eggs, but the procedure would kill Harper. He has to take medication to keep them in check, but the medicine won't work forever. Meanwhile, they've figured out that the Magog travelling "bound planets" w

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E02 - Exit Strategies
2.plot: Dylan, Beka, Rev Bem and Tyr pursued by a gang of Neitzscheans, are forced to make a crash landing on an icy planet.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E03 - A Heart for Falsehood Framed
2.plot: The crew of the Andromeda replaces a sacred relic with a fake, attempting to negotiate peace between two battling parties.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E04 - Pitiless as the Sun
2.plot: Trance is held captive, while Dylan and the rest of the crew try to uncover the source behind mysterious attacks on cargo ships.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E05 - Last Call at the Broken Hammer
2.plot: Hunting for the woman who set up the only major interstellar alliance since the Fall, Dylan finds himself in a bar at the edge of a desert wasteland, trying to fend of a Kalderan attack.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E06 - All Too Human
2.plot: Rommie sets out to extract an informant, but winds up stuck on a planet with a strong hatred and fear of Androids.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E07 - Una Salus Victus
2.plot: After discovering Tyr has hidden the remains of Drago Musevini on board the Andromeda, Dylan questions Tyr's loyalty.  Beka and a Nietzchean both race to repair their ships before the other destroys them, and Harper is left in command of the Andromeda, and must decide whether or not to protect a convoy and risk losing the Andromeda.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E08 - Home Fires
2.plot: A stranger gives Dylan a message from his dead fiancée leading him to an untouched world with descendants of his former crew and friends, including the descendant of his treachorous former best friend.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E09 - Into the Labyrinth
2.plot: A Commonwealth conference becomes a backdrop for Magog espionage, while Harper tries to discover how one of their spies managed to remove some of his Magog larvae.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E10 - The Prince
2.plot: Teen royalty is the key to the crew quelling an alien uprising, as Dylan and Tyr become co-regents to a recently orphaned young prince.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E11 - Bunker Hill
2.plot: The crew returns for the first time to Earth, where Harper and his cousin try to save the homeworld from Nietzschean occupation.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E12 - Ouroboros
2.plot: The crew watches Rev Bem's fairwell message, not sure whether or not to pursue him, or let him leave.  Dylan says that they should respect Rev's decision to leave, but Harper snaps at Dylan and storms out.  He is upset because Rev had promised to remove the Magog larvae from his gut.  He writhes in pain, but when he tries to take his medication, it has no effect, as the larvae have grown immune to it, as Trance and Rev had warned him they would.  Soon after, Harper enlists in Chief Technical Director Hohne's help, as well as the other Persieds.  Harper plans to build a machine that will fold space to remove the eggs, but it's affecting time, as well.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E13 - Lava and Rockets
2.plot: Dylan hijacks a starship to lose the Ogami.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E14 - Be All My Sins Remembered
2.plot: As an old friend of Beka's has died, she tells the crew about her past.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E15 - Dance of the Mayflies
2.plot: The crew of Andromed encounter plague victims infected by a hostile, nanobot-based lifeform out to take over the ship.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E16 - In Heaven Now Are Three
2.plot: Beka, Dylan and Trance attempt to find the Engine of Creation, an artifact able to rearrange space and time.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E17 - The Things We Cannot Change
2.plot: Dylan runs into a problem while analysing a black hole and imagines what his life would be like with a family before the common wealth fell.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E18 - The Fair Unknown
2.plot: The crew encounter the Vedrans the long-lost founders of the Commonwealth.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E19 - Belly of the Beast
2.plot: The Andromeda is swallowed by a space creature.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E20 - The Knight, Death, and the Devil
2.plot: The crew encounter a POW camp full of captured High Guard starships and their AI avatars.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E21 - Immaculate Perception
2.plot: Tyr learns that he is a father.

2.title: FR - Andromeda - S02E22 - Tunnel at the End of the Light (1)
2.plot: The crew of the Andromeda meet an alien race they were destined to face.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E01 - If the Wheel Is Fixed (2)
3.plot: The Andromeda is on the edge of a dimensional portal searching for Beka and Tyr, but when they return things may not be as they seem.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E02 - The Shards of Rimni
3.plot: Dylan receives a mysterious package, but is then framed for the murder of its sender so Dylan and Harper go on a mission to clear his name.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E03 - Mad To Be Saved
3.plot: The Andromeda picks up a group of refugees who have been subjected to psychological and physical torture.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E04 - Cui Bono
3.plot: Beka's Uncle Sid returns, as a candidate for a leader of the Commonwealth.  He plans to use the Andromeda to help his chances, but an assassin has other plans for him.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E05 - The Lone and Level Sands
3.plot: As Dylan, Rommie, Tyr and Harper flee from the Ogami, they encounter a ship sent from Earth to explore space over 3000 years ago.  As the ship is a giant engine, it travels so fast that the crew never age.  As the Maru has no slipstream engine, Dylan is faced with a decision that could change the future of the commonwealth.  Can the Andromeda come to the rescue?

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E06 - Slipfighter the Dogs of War
3.plot: After finding out that a planet is developing nova bombs and testing them on nearby star and planet, Dylan takes it upon himself to disarm them.  The commonwealth refuses to help so its a mission for the Andromeda and her crew!

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E07 - The Leper's Kiss
3.plot: Dylan sets out to find an assassin known as The Leper who is trying to kill his good friend.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E08 - For Whom the Bell Tolls
3.plot: After rescuing some people from a storm, a 'maggot' is brought onto Andromeda.  This maggot chews through the systems and activations an old hologram of a crew member.  This member had sealed himself in one of the hidden decks before the event horizon and had some through it.  Believing that Dylan has betrayed the Commonwealth, an avatar and android of the crew man takes over the ship to bring Dylan to justice...

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E09 - And Your Heart Will Fly Away
3.plot:
Tyr receives a communication from a human on an abandoned planet and leaves to meet her.  As he does, a mad scientist boards the Andromeda using dark matter ninjas.  After beating them, the man introduces himself.  He loves the woman Tyr is with and wants to kill her, if he cant have her, nobody can.  After saving her, he forgives her and lets her live.

The episode ends with Tyr revealing that she is actually a Neitzian, the last female from Codiac, Tyrs pride.  He says that he wants them to start a new Codiac pride but she refuses and Tyr leaves.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E10 - The Unconquerable Man
3.plot: Gaheris Rhade sets out to reshape the universe according to his will and restore order amid the chaos

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E11 - Delenda Est
3.plot: The Andromeda tries to stop mysterious attacks occurring on nearby planets and outposts.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E12 - The Dark Backward
3.plot:
"Okay, that did not work," Trance says. "Let's try again."

Trance tries to figure out how to help the crew survive a deadly intruder.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E13 - The Risk-All Point
3.plot: When Dylan is invited to the launch of the first Commonwealth ship made in 307 years, you can tell something will go wrong.  As the ship explodes sabotage is suspected.  As Dylan and the crew try to find the culprit, they encounter many different suspects while being attacked a violent pride.  Can Dylan find the culprit before the Maru is next?

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E14 - The Right Horse
3.plot: When an old flame of Beka's is arrested on a planet where only the truth is told, its up to the Andromeda and her crew to save the day.  After repeatedly lying, Beka gets no-where so she breaks the suspect out in flees to the Andromeda.  As the story unravels, it seems that all is not as it seems.....

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E15 - What Happens to a Rev Deferred?
3.plot: As the Andromeda responds to a distress call from a planet on the brink of destruction, the crew intercept a transmission from a ship returning to the surface.   After seeing the message from Rev Bem the crew loads up to save him from the planet.  As Rev is following the path of the Divine flashbacks occur of the Andromeda crew to help him on his way.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E16 - Point of the Spear
3.plot:
When the Andromeda responds to a request to destroy atmosphere generators on Samsarra, they encounter a battle group of Pyrians and stand off until the Commonwealth fleet arrives.  in a revelation from Trance, Dylan finds out that Trances people believe the Pyrian fleet stronger and better equipped to handle the forthcoming war.  With this information, she tells Dylan to pull out and let the Pyrians win so that they can take on the Magog World Ship instead of the renewed Commonwealth.

Dylan sees that the only way to stop them is to destroy the planet that he is trying so hard to save....

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E17 - Vault of the Heavens
3.plot:
After receiving a message from an unknown planet 3 days in Slipstream away, the crew of the Andromeda take it upon themselves to save the people.  The strange thing is that the message is a woman and it is going directly into Dylans head and no-one else can hear it.

As they enter the ice moon of one of the planets, they come upon the Vault of the Heavens.  A large palace made of ice.  in discovering this the comm is cut and on Dylan's orders, Try destroys an energy cloud above the planet.  After discovering that the aliens mean no harm, Dylan finds out that they need the cloud, or the entire species will die!

Will they be able to return the cloud before the time runs out?

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E18 - Deep Midnight's Voice
3.plot: Dylan and the crew search for a Nietzschean slip-scout carrying a probe that enables one to map every meter of the slipstream

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E19 - The Illusion of Majesty
3.plot: The Andromeda end up in the Prolon System where they discover a hibernation capsule occupied by a woman impersonating a dead princess.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E20 - Twilight of the Idols
3.plot: The Andromeda crew search for a colony that disappeared.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E21 - Day of Judgement, Day of Wrath
3.plot: When the crew prepares for the launch of The Resolution of Hector, they soon discover that Rommie has had a change of mind and is now working against the crew.  Knowing that this is not normal, Dylan sets out to reclaim the ship, and find out what is controlling his friend.

3.title: FR - Andromeda - S03E22 - Shadows Cast by a Final Salute (1)
3.plot: When the Andromeda is attacked by the Dragons to receive the bones of Drago Mussevni something seems array.  Dylan then discovers that Tyr has united all of the Neitzian people under his son, the genetic reincarnation of Drago Mussevni.  Will Tyr make the right decision and help the crew of the Andromeda or lead his new people into battle?

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E01 - Answers Given to Questions Never Asked (2)
4.plot: A seemingly psychotic "Collector" simultaneously takes credit and blames Dylan for the fall of the Commonwealth.  He also claims to be hosting (or holding captive?) the Triumvir Tri-Jema.  The crew must decide whether to accompany Dylan on yet another odds-defying journey to save the Universe or to retire in relative safety.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E02 - Pieces of Eight
4.plot: A power-hungry citizen seeks to manipulate the Commonwealth for his own gain. Dylan receives an unsettling view of his future from a prophetic alien.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E03 - Waking the Tyrant's Device
4.plot: Dylan and an old friend try to prevent the maker of the Magog Worldship from deploying an army of androids.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E04 - Double or Nothingness
4.plot: Dylan plays a dangerous game against two gamblers, but not everything is as real as it seems.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E05 - Harper/Delete
4.plot: The ultimate weapon falls into the hands of a Nietzschean pirate. Can Harper disarm it before the Magog arrive?

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E06 - Soon the Nearing Vortex (1)
4.plot: The reappearance of Tyr Anasazi and Telemachus Rhade leads to a race to obtain the Route of Ages, which will direct the owner to the location of the Abyss itself.  Dylan and the crew plan to use it as a weapon, while Tyr plans on bargaining with the Abyss in hopes of it sparing his empire.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E07 - The World Turns All Around Her (2)
4.plot: In a race against Tyr to control the Route of Ages, the crew find themselves in another universe. To save them, Trance finally reveals who and what she really is.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E08 - Conduit to Destiny
4.plot: The crew assists in the search for escaped prisoners on a new Commonwealth member world. Dylan finds himself playing a role in an ancient prophecy.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E09 - Machinery of the Mind
4.plot: Harper attends a conference of the Commonwealth's greatest minds. Unfortunately, a mysterious assassin has plans for that collected brilliance. Meanwhile, Dylan is being escorted to meet with Tri-Lorn... or is he?

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E10 - Exalted Reason, Resplendent Daughter
4.plot: The crew searches for a princess abducted by a ruthless pirate. As usual, nothing is as it seems. Along the way, a secret from Beka's past is revealed.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E11 - The Torment, the Release
4.plot: Dylan is put on trial for high crimes against the Commonwealth.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E12 - The Spider's Stratagem
4.plot: The crew intercepts a mysterious cargo en route to a war zone.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E13 - The Warmth of an Invisible Light
4.plot: One of Harper's experiments goes awry, and Dylan ends up in an alternate reality.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E14 - The Others
4.plot: The crew rescues two people from a spaceship, the leaders of opposing sides in a long civil war on a nearby planet.  The two warring sides have built an immense wall separating the northern and southern halves of the planet, and the Northerners are suffering from a plague that is blamed on the Southerners.  After Dylan contracts the plague, the crew try to assist in settling the dispute and find a cure for the plague, but nothing goes as planned.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E15 - Fear Burns Down to Ashes
4.plot: The Collectors have been using a drug to modify people's behavior, discovering their fears in efforts to control or break them.  This is their solution for dealing with Dylan.  Led by a message from Rev Bem, claiming to have a weapon that can defeat the oncoming darkness, Dylan lands on a drug-trafficking planet and is soon taken captive by the Collectors.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E16 - Lost in a Space that Isn't There
4.plot: After being repeatedly attacked by bounty hunters after several evasive slipstream jumps, Dylan determines that there must be a mole on board.  After analyzing data recordings, he discovers that Beka has been infected by The Abyss and has unknowingly been giving away Andromeda's position. Dylan and the crew have to come up with a way to rid Beka of The Abyss -- without killing her.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E17 - Abridging the Devil's Divide
4.plot: While on a mission on the Maru, Dylan, Rhade and Harper (and the Maru) are captured by the Templars.  The Patriarch of the Templars presses Harper to help him build a bridge -- a time bridge to 210 years in the future.  However, sometimes even the future is unpredictable. Meanwhile, Beka, Trance and Rommie chase down smuggler ships.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E18 - Trusting the Gordian Maze
4.plot: While the Andromeda is confronted by the Commonwealth fleet and Tri-Jema, Dylan must decide whether or not he can entrust the Route of Ages to them.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E19 - A Symmetry of Imperfection
4.plot: Rommie's emotions cause one of Harpers fail-safes to cut in, cutting her off from her core AI and shutting down all the ships systems. This creates problems, especially when a satellite ship from the Magog world ship could come out of slipstream at any moment!

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E20 - Time out of Mind
4.plot: The death of a man from Beka's past named Weslow, sends the crew in search of an archive that can let Beka relive some of her childhood experiences so that she may make sense of Weslow's dying words.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E21 - The Dissonant Interval (1)
4.plot: The Andromeda encounters the Arkology, a society that they believe is the closest to perfection humanity will ever achieve.  But the Magog are close, and Dylan and the crew must convince the utopia that peace is not the answer.  Conflict arises in the core crew when the leaders of Arkology do not wish to leave.  Dylan wants to defend them, and Beka warns him that she's not going to stay and die defending an idea of peace.

4.title: FR - Andromeda - S04E22 - The Dissonant Interval (2)
4.plot: Beka decides to leave the crew to fight for themselves, but after all of the promises that everyone will be reunited, Trance tells them that they will never be as they are again.  When the Magog Worldship finally re-encounters the Andromeda after two years, Rommie and Harper race to take the Arkology to slipstream, Rhade must teach the inhabitants to defend themselves, and Dylan and Trance fight off the invading Magog.  But as the Andromeda becomes covered in swarmships, Trance tells Dylan that he--and only he--may escape this alive.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E01 - The Weight (1)
5.plot: Dylan finds himself on Seefra-1, one of nine identical planets orbiting two suns.  He soon encounters Rhade, who has abandoned all hope.  Rhade hates Dylan for the hope he has brought, and when someone asks Dylan be killed, Rhade agrees to do it.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E02 - The Weight (2)
5.plot: Dylan and Rhade receive a month-old distress signal from Beka.  After following the coordinates she left, they find the Andromeda dead in space.  On board, he finds Darregacorp engineers trying to salvage it, led by Jonah Derrega, and Beka Valentine.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E03 - Phear Phactor Phenom
5.plot: When a valuable painting gets stolen after Beka, Rhade, and everyone else in the bar inhales a mysterious mist, Dylan jumps at the opportunity to win the reward for reclaiming it so the Andromeda can be repaired.  After tracing the nanobots in the mist, they encounter Harper who is accompanied by a beautiful woman named Doyle.  But Harper is caught up in the plans of Marika, who wants him to genetically engineer Vedrans, as well as to take over the Seefra system.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E04 - Decay of the Angel
5.plot: When a slipstream event is detected in the Seefra system, Dylan, Rhade, and Beka try to find it, and their way out.  Meanwhile, a man claiming to be from the future approaches Doyle, addressing her as Andromeda.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E05 - The Eschatology of Our Present
5.plot: Beka learns she has existed in more than one place at one time when she meets a man who she knows is her father.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E06 - When Goes Around...
5.plot: Dylan encounters Celine, a woman from his past and is trapped in time loops.  The two are happy to see each other, but Dylan knows he may have to choose between Celine and the survival of Seefra.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E07 - Attempting Screed
5.plot: The unexpected return of Flavin takes Dylan on a journey through time, revealing mysteries surrounding Tarn Vedra, the Paradine, the battle with the Worldship, and Trance.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E08 - So Burn the Untamed Lands
5.plot: Dylan and Rhade attempt to infiltrate a mining camp where crystals are extracted, which contain the power needed to restore the Andromeda and leave the Seefra system.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E09 - What Will Be Was Not
5.plot: When Trance believes Rhade and the crew blame her for their situation, she runs off into Seefra-1's underground tunnels.  As Dylan and Doyle pursue her, they discover the use of ancient Vedran technology.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E10 - The Test
5.plot: The crew is tormented by a mysterious stranger who accuses them of murder.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E11 - Through a Glass Darkly
5.plot: An old friend who Harper thought was dead returns to help the crew in a battle for Seefra-5.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E12 - Pride Before the Fall
5.plot: A deadly enemy from the past returns with plans to create an elite warrior race.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E13 - Moonlight Becomes You
5.plot: When Trance becomes attracted to a mysterious young man from her past, the reunion causes her to begin regaining her memories.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E14 - Past Is Prolix
5.plot: The arrival of Trance's sun threatens to destroy all the planets except Seefra-1 unless the system problem is fixed.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E15 - The Opposites of Attraction
5.plot: The avatar of the black hole, that trapped Dylan after the Nietzschean ambush, returns to get him back.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E16 - Saving Light From a Black Sun
5.plot: The crew travels to the core of Seefra's sun Methus-2 to repair it.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E17 - Totaled Recall
5.plot: An explosion sends Dylan into an inter-dimensional loop, with a man named Elysian telling him to decipher a riddle.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E18 - Quantum Tractate Delirium
5.plot: As Trance's sun closes on Seefra-9, Rommie is rebuilt by Doyle to help evacuate the planet.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E19 - One More Day's Light (1)
5.plot: The evacuation of Seefra-5 is at risk when a religious sect decides to stay on the planet.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E20 - Chaos and the Stillness of It (2)
5.plot: As General Burma arrives on Andromeda, with Harper in tow, Dylan and Rhade head for Methis 2, about to be crushed by Trance's sun, leaving Doyle, Rommie, and Beka to face Burma, and the forgotten enemy he brings with him.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E21 - The Heart of the Journey (1)
5.plot: With the help of the avatars of the nebula, the Andromeda goes through the Route of Ages, back to the Known Worlds, and the Commonwealth.

5.title: FR - Andromeda - S05E22 - The Heart of the Journey (2)
5.plot: As the Nietzschean fleet approaches, the Andromeda prepares for the final battle.

meta.plot: Divers personnages, connus et inconnus, doivent faire face à la résurgence du mal en Terre du Milieu. Des profondeurs des Montagnes de Brume aux forêts majestueuses du Lindon, de l'île des Rois de Númenor aux contrées les plus éloignées du monde, ces royaumes et personnages vont forger un héritage qui demeurera bien après leur disparition.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E01 - A Shadow of the Past
1.plot: Galadriel is disturbed by signs of an ancient evil’s return; Arondir makes an unsettling discovery; Elrond is presented with an intriguing new venture; Nori breaks the Harfoot community’s most deeply-held rule.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E02 - Adrift
1.plot: Galadriel finds a new ally; Elrond faces a cold reception from an old friend; Nori endeavors to help a Stranger; Arondir searches for answers while Bronwyn warns her people of a threat.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E03 - Adar
1.plot: Arondir finds himself a captive. Galadriel and Halbrand explore a legendary kingdom. Elendil is given a new assignment. Nori faces the consequences.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E04 - The Great Wave
1.plot: Queen Regent Míriel’s faith is tested. Isildur finds himself at a crossroads. Elrond uncovers a secret. Arondir is given an ultimatum. Theo disobeys Bronwyn.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E05 - Partings
1.plot: Nori questions her instincts. Elrond struggles to stay true to his oath. Halbrand weighs his destiny. The Southlanders brace for attack.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E06 - Udûn
1.plot: Adar and his army march on Ostirith.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E07 - The Eye
1.plot: Survivors of a cataclysm try to find safety. The Harfoots confront evil. Durin is torn between friendship and duty. Adar considers a new name.

1.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S01E08 - Alloyed
1.plot: New alliances are forged.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E01 - Elven Kings Under the Sky
2.plot: Sauron bargains with Adar. The Stranger and Nori venture into new lands. The Three Elven Rings face judgment.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E02 - Where the Stars Are Strange
2.plot: Darkness falls over Khazad-dûm. Sauron and Galadriel each seek new allies. The Stranger and Harfoots encounter a growing threat.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E03 - The Eagle and the Sceptre
2.plot: Isildur and an old friend reunite. Arondir grapples with change. Míriel faces rising opposition. Annatar counsels Celebrimbor.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E04 - Eldest
2.plot: The Stranger finds what he's been searching for. Arondir and Isildur search for Theo. Galadriel and Elrond walk into a trap.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E05 - Halls of Stone
2.plot: When Durin grows suspicious of the Dwarven Rings, Celebrimbor must reassess his priorities. Amidst Númenor's shifting currents, Elendil searches for hope.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E06 - Where Is He?
2.plot: Galadriel considers a proposition. Elendil faces judgment. The Stranger finds himself at a crossroads. Sauron's plans bear fruit.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E07 - Doomed to Die
2.plot: Eregion's fate is decided.

2.title: FR - Le Seigneur des anneaux : Les Anneaux de pouvoir [4K] - S02E08 - Shadow and Flame
2.plot: The free peoples of Middle-earth struggle against the forces of darkness.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E01 - Snow White and the Seven Bears / The Seven Bears Not Dwarfs
1.plot: Snow White has moved in — and she won't budge until the bears help her reclaim her magic boots. The bears think their brother has transformed into a fly.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E02 - The Dancing Potion / The Potato Touch
1.plot: The bears use magic to get the Prince grooving at the King's Ball. The Witch grants one bear the power to turn anything — or anyone — into a potato.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E03 - Stumblebumpskin / The Perfect Toast
1.plot: The bears meet a naughty gnome who challenges them to a butt-kicking contest. A search for the perfect slice of toast puts Snow White in danger.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E04 - Bearpunzel / Princilocks and the Seven Bears
1.plot: A bear's wish for a big, bouncy butt lands him in a tight spot. The brothers help Prince Charmless win the King's approval with a royal manners makeover.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E05 - Bearsel & Gretel / Jack & the Bearstalk
1.plot: The bears hear a rumor that makes them worry the Witch wants to eat them. One bear gets the King's attention after eating magic beans.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E06 - The Big, Bad Favor / Basket Case
1.plot: The bears protect three pigs — and a huge potato stash — from a hungry wolf. Red Riding Hood drags the brothers into her battle with the Big Bad... Jerry?

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E07 - The Pied Butt Scratcher / Princess & the Pea-tato
1.plot: Armed with a magic flute, the bears try to rid the land of itchy butt bugs. A tiny potato hidden under a mattress gives the bears a sleepless night.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E08 - Bears Vs. Dwarfs / The Bear in the Magic Lamp
1.plot: Snow White helps the Seven Dwarfs take over the bears' mine. While helping kind storyteller Scheherazade, the brothers get sucked into her magic lamp.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E09 - The Bear Prince / The Ugly Guardling
1.plot: Prince Charming mistakes one of the brothers for his favorite teddy bear. After bumping his head, a bear thinks he's a member of the King's royal guard.

1.title: FR - Les 7 Ours - S01E10 - Cinderella's Quiceanbeara / Puss' N Bears
1.plot: Fairy asks the bears to host Cinderella's 15th birthday party. Then, Puss in Boots helps the brothers track down the mythical, magical... Crystal Potato!

meta.plot: Oubliez les Sept Nains : voici les 7 Ours ! Cette adorable bande de boules de poils imprime sa patte sur les contes de fées que tout le monde croit connaître.
Dans les vastes étendues du parc national de Yosemite, la mort d'une inconnue entraîne un agent fédéral sur un terrain de non-droit, où la nature n'obéit qu'à ses propres règles.

1.title: FR - Une nature sauvage - S01E01 - A Celestial Event
1.plot: When a woman fatally falls from El Capitan, special agent Kyle Turner suspects it wasn't an accident — and that the truth may lie deep within Yosemite.

1.title: FR - Une nature sauvage - S01E02 - Jane Doe
1.plot: The mystery around Jane Doe deepens as Turner and Vasquez investigate a strange symbol and visit a remote encampment in the woods.

1.title: FR - Une nature sauvage - S01E03 - El-o'-win
1.plot: Jane Doe's identity raises new questions about the life she left behind — and connects to an old case that has haunted Turner for years.

1.title: FR - Une nature sauvage - S01E04 - Gold Rush
1.plot: A grim discovery in the mines makes Turner question the squatters' role in the case. Vasquez fights to protect her son when his father reappears.

1.title: FR - Une nature sauvage - S01E05 - Terces
1.plot: Turner takes the investigation to new extremes — with serious repercussions. Jill gets caught up in Vasquez's conflict with her ex.

1.title: FR - Une nature sauvage - S01E06 - All Trails Lead Here
1.plot: As the investigation comes to a close, Turner discovers the truth about Lucy's death — and the long-buried secrets that set it in motion.

meta.plot: Un veuf accro au travail essaie tant bien que mal de s'occuper de ses enfants, guidé par les conseils éducatifs publiés en ligne par sa défunte épouse. Va-t-il y arriver ?

meta.plot: Située dans le milieu déjanté de la télévision du début des années 2000, cette série recrée comme jamais la vie de l'icône pop Tamara et sa métamorphose en Yurena.

À la suite d’une rupture aussi soudaine qu’imprévue avec leurs conjoints respectifs, Mathieu invite Joëlle, sa meilleure amie depuis toujours, à vivre le temps de quelques mois, un road trip en Gaspésie inoubliable. Ce qui au départ s’annonce comme un voyage initiatique, dérape rapidement, lorsque le duo fait la rencontre de Robin, un être aussi charismatique que dangereux, qui repousse les limites de la liberté, mettant en danger pour une première fois l’amitié qui unie Mathieu et Joëlle.
