2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E02 - Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
2.plot: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E03 - Chapter Three: The Pollywog
2.plot: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E04 - Chapter Four: Will the Wise
2.plot: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E05 - Chapter Five: Dig Dug
2.plot: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E06 - Chapter Six: The Spy
2.plot: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E07 - Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
2.plot: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E08 - Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
2.plot: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

2.title: FR - Stranger Things - S02E09 - Chapter Nine: The Gate
2.plot: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E01 - Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
3.plot: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E02 - Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
3.plot: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E03 - Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
3.plot: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E04 - Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
3.plot: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E05 - Chapter Five: The Flayed
3.plot: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E06 - Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
3.plot: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E07 - Chapter Seven: The Bite
3.plot: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

3.title: FR - Stranger Things - S03E08 - Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
3.plot: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E01 - Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
4.plot: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E02 - Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
4.plot: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E03 - Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
4.plot: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E04 - Chapter Four: Dear Billy
4.plot: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E05 - Chapter Five: The Nina Project
4.plot: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E06 - Chapter Six: The Dive
4.plot: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E07 - Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
4.plot: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E08 - Chapter Eight: Papa
4.plot: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

4.title: FR - Stranger Things - S04E09 - Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
4.plot: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E01 - Chapter One: The Crawl
5.plot: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E02 - Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
5.plot: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E03 - Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
5.plot: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E04 - Chapter Four: Sorcerer
5.plot: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E05 - Chapter Five: Shock Jock
5.plot: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E06 - Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
5.plot: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E07 - Chapter Seven: The Bridge
5.plot: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

5.title: FR - Stranger Things - S05E08 - Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
5.plot: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E01 - María
1.plot: As a serial killer targeting women terrorizes the city, María, Valentina, Gabina, and Ángeles join the first female police force.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E02 - Paola
1.plot: María and the other Azules stumble upon a new victim of the Undresser and watch as a man they believe is innocent gets arrested.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E03 - Norma
1.plot: Dissatisfied with the detectives' conclusions, the Azules conduct their own investigation off the books.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E04 - Alma
1.plot: Another Undresser victim is found, confirming the Azules' suspicions. Their investigation points detectives to a new suspect.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E05 - Ángeles
1.plot: Romandía gets pulled into the investigation as the Azules uncover a clue that may reveal the Undresser's identity.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E06 - Laura
1.plot: The detectives take drastic measures to find answers. María seeks the help of someone who can offer new insight: a convicted serial killer.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E07 - Dora
1.plot: The Azules turn their attention to unsolved murders, hoping to find a connection to the Undresser.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E08 - Rosa
1.plot: María and Ángeles interview the adopted son of a woman named Rosa, who the Azules believe may have been the Undresser's first victim.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E09 - Gabina
1.plot: The Azules work with the detectives to stage a trap for the man they think is the Undresser—but things don't go as planned.

1.title: FR - Las azules [4K] - S01E10 - Valentina
1.plot: The Azules pull their resources together to try and save one of their own, putting the future of the female police force at risk.

meta.plot: En 1971, quatre femmes défient les lois ultraconservatrices et rejoignent les premières forces de police féminines du Mexique. Elles comprennent alors qu’il s’agit d’un simple coup de pub pour détourner l’attention d’un tueur en série. Alors que le nombre de victimes augmente, elles font le serment de traduire le coupable en justice.

Dans le sud de la France, la cheffe d’une communauté gitane et ses deux fils luttent pour sauver leur clan menacé d’expulsion par la montée des eaux. Pour survivre, ils devront franchir les limites de la légalité et se battre au sein d’un univers sombre et dangereux… tout en dissimulant l’inavouable secret qui hante leur famille depuis sept ans.

1.title: FR - Malditos [4K] - S01E01 - Water
1.plot: After her family's community is served an eviction notice, Sara forms a dangerous alliance with her missing husband Miguel's sworn enemy.

1.title: FR - Malditos [4K] - S01E02 - The Curse
1.plot: Family secrets threatened, tensions rise. Tony and Jo go deep into the Camargue underworld, ready to do anything to protect their past.

1.title: FR - Malditos [4K] - S01E03 - The Fracture
1.plot: The two brothers set out on the trail of their father's dark past. Tony takes more and more risks, while Jo tries to protect him.

1.title: FR - Malditos [4K] - S01E04 - The Powder
1.plot: The secret threatens to burst. Sara and Tony sink deeper into the lie, while Jo begins to doubt the meaning of his commitment.

meta.plot: Diego de la Vega revient en Californie pour venger le meurtre de son père. Après avoir pris le titre de Zorro, il affronte le gouverneur, le chef malveillant de la communauté chinoise et une société secrète, en plaçant le bien commun au-dessus de tout.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E01 - The Chosen One
1.plot: Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father’s murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he initiates his struggle against Nah-Lin, a Native American who he believes has stolen his inheritance. Diego will confront the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all. In doing so, he will sacrifice his love for Lola.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E02 - Inheritance
1.plot: To attract Zorro's attention, Diego and Lolita are held hostage in a robbery at the loan office. Lolita gets injured and Diego questions whether he is up to the task of wearing the mask.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E03 - The Bet
1.plot: A woman is missing in Chinatown, calling Zorro to take action. Matters get worse with the unfortunate explosion at the Ramirez mine. Additionally, Diego learns the painful news of the murder of his father.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E04 - Revenge
1.plot: Zorro is instilling fear in an open war against the governor. Lolita is torn by her emotions for Diego while Monasterio unveils something about Zorro that is going to change everything.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E05 - The Execution
1.plot: Monasterio suspects that Zorro is not what the governor claims him to be. Diego and Nah-Lin feel forced to leave behind their differences and strike a truce to free the captured indigenous people. Diego uncovers a crucial clue to find his father’s murderers.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E06 - Mask Games
1.plot: The auction for Ramirez’s lands seems to have a pre-fixed winner: The Russo-American company. Right after attempting to avoid Andreyévich from making the auction, Diego is surprised by the visit of the Bear Clan. Lolita is confused with her feelings for Diego and her engagement with Monasterio.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E07 - The Myth
1.plot: Accounts of Zorro appear in The Californian, which helps Ivanova find the missing piece to her plans. Diego gets a final warning from one of Nah-Lin's men that puts at risk his secret identity.

1.title: FR - Zorro [4K] - S01E08 - The Wedding
1.plot: Nah-Lin discovers that Lolita is Diego’s weakness, so she threatens to kill her on her weeding day if he doesn’t give up being Zorro.

meta.plot: Far West, dans les années 1860 - 1870. Hanté par le meurtre de sa famille huit ans plus tôt, Django continue de chercher sa fille, s’accrochant à l’espoir qu'elle ait pu survivre au massacre. Il est abasourdi de la retrouver à New Babylon, sur le point d'épouser John. Convaincu que la ville est menacée, Django est inflexible : il ne prendra pas le risque de perdre sa fille une nouvelle fois.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E01 - New Babylon
1.plot: In Texas, in 1872, John Ellis, a former slave, and Sarah, a young orphan, founded New Babylon, a city of outcasts. Django arrives in the city on a search for the murderer of his family. There he finds his daughter Sarah, the sole survivor of the massacre.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E02 - The Lady
1.plot: Sarah makes a life-saving discovery for the finances of New Babylon: the city's basements are full of oil. With John, she pushes the door of the bank of Elmdale to finance a drill. They incur the wrath of Elizabeth Thurmann, the local potentate, who is preparing an ambush.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E03 - Nagadoches
1.plot: John, his sons, Django and Sarah travel to Nagadoches, where an old friend of John's might sell them a drill; alerted by Aaron, her protégé who infiltrated New Babylon, Elizabeth organises an attack.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E04 - Fountainhead
1.plot: Django and Seymour go on a mission to sell oil; Seymour is captured, and Django, Sarah and John must find a way to save him.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E05 - Chambersburg
1.plot: Django uses a ruse to find out if Seymour is a traitor. He is supposed to accompany a bogus oil shipment to the north while another shipment is made to the south.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E06 - The Trial
1.plot: With a lawsuit, Elizabeth tries to take the country from her opponent John. When John is arrested by Sheriff Boone, Django wants to help his friend and clear up the injustice.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E07 - The Giant
1.plot: John orders weapons to defend the city and demands that the people of New Babylon use them. Sarah does not agree with his decision and an argument ensues.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E08 - Tobacco Tin
1.plot: The revenge campaign against John continues; Elizabeth hires Leonard to kidnap Sarah; when Django finds out, he steps in and proposes a deal to Leonard.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E09 - Masquerade
1.plot: John throws a big festival in New Babylon. Elizabeth wants to use this opportunity to sneak into town with her people without being recognised.

1.title: FR - Django - S01E10 - The Western Sea
1.plot: Wanting revenge on Elizabeth, Kevin rides to Elmdale; Elizabeth uses the brutal escalation to turn the townsfolk against the people of New Babylon.

meta.plot: Dans un monde empreint de folklore et de mysticisme, les chemins d'un esprit vengeur et d'un pieu shaman se croisent, les menant dans un voyage d'amour et de rédemption.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E01 - A Talented Woman
1.plot: Yeo Ri tries to escape the shadow of Kang Cheol, the dragon deity who ruined her past. A request from Yun Gap leads her onto a dangerous path where he is lethally ambushed by political foes, giving Kang Cheol the perfect chance to possess his body. Now, her greatest enemy is closer than ever within the form of her trusted, dying friend.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E02 - Where Gang-Chul Walks, Autumn Turns to Spring
1.plot: Yeo Ri wakes up at the palace. She finds out that Kang Cheol wasn’t the one who attacked Yun Gap. However, she’s still suspicious about Kang Cheol since he possessed Yun Gap’s body. She looks for Yun Gap’s spirit, but she runs into something else instead. Meanwhile, Kang Cheol who is in Yun Gap’s body is fascinated by the human senses. It feels awkward, but he starts to enjoy being human.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E03 - The Eight-feet Spirit
1.plot: Yeo Ri tries to find Yun Gap, thinking his soul is trapped somewhere in the palace. Kang Cheol tells her that Yun Gap is already taken by the Eight-feet spirit, but Yeo Ri can’t give up on him. She decides to lure the Eight-feet spirit by becoming the bait to save Yun Gap. When she was about to trap the Eight-feet spirit, the king and his men appeared.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E04 - The Shining Gem of the Night
1.plot: The king is possessed by the Eight-feet Spirit, but Yeo Ri and Kang Cheol manage to get rid of it. Kang Cheol wants to leave the capital to stay away from the Eight-feet Spirit, but Yeo Ri asks him to help her get rid of the spirit and save Yun Gap. However, the king banishes the two from the capital for breaking the law, which is doing a ritual in the capital. Meanwhile, the Eight-feet Spirit finds another target.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E05 - There Is Someone Helping Eight-Feet Spirit
1.plot: Cheol asks Monk Ga Seop if he could perform gubyeongsisik and drive the Eight-Feet Spirit out of the world. The monk tells him that they need to deplete the energy of the glowing pearl within his body to settle the resentment of the evil spirit. After Prince Yeong In’s passing, Cheol finds out someone in the Palace is aiding the Eight-Feet Spirit.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E06 - The Skull in the Pillow
1.plot: Pung San is pleased to find out that the Queen is pregnant with the King’s child, giving the General of Heaven and Earth another child to feed on. Cheol learns from Bi Bi that he needs to kill the body of Gap to get out of his body. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri finds a skull with a talisman hidden in the Queen’s pillow that causes the Queen to have nightmares.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E07 - A Deadly Spell
1.plot: The water spirit attacks Yeo Ri with a deadly spell. She slowly shows the same symptoms as the Queen, who is bedridden due to an unknown illness. Kang Cheol suggests that the King become bait to catch the water spirit, as it wants the royal blood. Yeo Ri hears the news and rushes to the river where Kang Cheol and the King are waiting for the water spirit to emerge.

1.title: FR - Le Palais Hanté - S01E08 - Aguji
1.plot: Yeo Ri and Kang Cheol grant the water spirit’s wish and bring his remains to his daughter. In return, the water spirit confesses that Aguji was behind the attacks on the Queen. The King locks up all the blind shamans from the Bureau of the Blind and interrogates them to find who Aguji is. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri finds out that the Eight-feet Spirit killed her grandmother.

FR - Necaxa - S01E01 - Welcome to Necaxa
1.plot: Club Necaxa fights to reclaim greatness and win the hearts of Aguascalientes. Investor Eva "La Patrona" Longoria calls in support of fellow owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds as "Los Rayos" future hangs in the balance.

1.title: FR - Necaxa - S01E02 - Anxiety
1.plot: When a major injury threatens the season, Eva Longoria struggles to rebuild Club Necaxa's fractured fanbase. Sports Director José "Pepe" Hanan and Coach Fentanes guide "Los Rayos" through the Leagues Cup.

meta.plot: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.
Annalise Keating, brillante avocate et professeur de droit, se retrouve impliquée dans une affaire de meurtre avec cinq de ses étudiants.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A ruthless defense attorney and no-nonsense law professor at a Philadelphia university selects a group of her best students to work at her firm.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E02 - It's All Her Fault
1.plot: Annalise takes on a new client, Max St. Vincent, an eccentric millionaire who is the key suspect in his wife's brutal murder. All the clues point to St. Vincent as the killer, but Annalise challenges her students to prove he's innocent - whether that's the truth or not. Meanwhile, Annalise deals with issues in her own home when her growing suspicions that Sam is somehow involved in Lila's disappearance start to affect their marriage. In flash forwards, we go back to the night of the murder and learn that Wes might be hiding a few secrets of his own.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E03 - Smile, or Go to Jail
1.plot: Annalise helps Paula Murphy, a suburban soccer mom, get released from jail after she was arrested for a misdemeanor, but just as she’s about to walk free, she’s arrested again by the FBI in connection for felony murder. Annalise and her students are tasked with proving her innocence which will depend on the testimony from another suspect in the case. Meanwhile, the Middleton University president asks Annalise to represent Griffin O’ Reilly, the star quarterback who has also been linked to Lila’s disappearance but she’s unable to make a decision until she knows that Sam wasn’t involved in the case. In flash forwards, more clues are revealed and we discover someone else was also there besides the students during the night of the murder.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E04 - Let’s Get to Scooping
1.plot: Annalise and her students uncover a shocking truth while investigating the case of Marren Trudeau, founder and CEO of a major brokerage firm, who has recently been arrested for insider trading. Meanwhile, Wes discovers a cell phone hidden by Rebecca whose contents reveal an unsettling clue in the Lila Stangard murder case.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E05 - We're Not Friends
1.plot: Annalise takes on a tough case defending a minor who fatally shoots his police officer father. Meanwhile, Annalise and Sam continue to argue over his relationship with Lila, and Wes and Rebecca begin to question Annalise’s motives. In flash-forwards, we learn more about Laurel’s relationship with Frank and why he was calling her the night of Sam’s death.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E06 - Freakin’ Whack-a-Mole
1.plot: A case gets personal for Annalise and the team when their client is a man from the projects who was sentenced to death by Asher’s father several years ago. Meanwhile, Wes is still angry at Annalise for hiding information about Lila’s case, so Annalise must convince him to get back in line. In flash-forwards, we find out exactly where Asher was on the night of the murder.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E07 - He Deserved to Die
1.plot: Annalise and the team are focused on Rebecca’s case, but when the judge enforces a gag order, Rebecca takes things into her own hands. Meanwhile, Michaela is surprised by a pre-nup, sparks fly between Laurel and Frank, and in flash-forwards, we find out more about Wes and Rebecca’s relationship.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E08 - He Has a Wife
1.plot: The team represents a mother who's on trial for killing her family's nanny while on heavy medication. Meanwhile, a shocking discovery is revealed in Lila's case that could change everything for Rebecca and Bonnie's loyalty to Annalise. In flashbacks, we learn more about Lila and Sam's relationship.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E09 - Kill Me, Kill Me, Kill Me
1.plot: It’s the evening of the bonfire and we finally see what exactly happened on the night of Sam’s death.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E10 - Hello Raskolnikov
1.plot: It’s the day after Sam’s murder and the students are called in to help Annalise find her missing husband, but just how much does Annalise know? And when a surprise visitor shows up in town, getting away with this murder might not be as easy as the students had hoped.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E11 - Best Christmas Ever
1.plot: School is back in session after the holiday break and the entire university is talking about Annalise's missing husband. The Keating Five continue to be questioned by the police and we find out exactly how they've been dealing with the guilt of killing Sam. Sam's sister Hannah shows up and has started her own investigation of what happened to Sam.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E12 - She’s a Murderer
1.plot: A stunning discovery in Sam's murder case leads to changes for Annalise and the students. Meanwhile, Annalise tries to keep things business as usual by taking on a new client who is in the mob, but Hannah continues to pressure her for answers.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E13 - Mama's Here Now
1.plot: Annalise is wracked with guilt and turns to an unlikely source for help. Meanwhile, Bonnie must step up and represent a new client accused of rape.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E14 - The Night Lila Died
1.plot: In flashbacks, we start to piece together what really happened the night of Lila's murder. In present day, Annalise takes on a priest who is accused of murdering another priest. Meanwhile, Connor and Oliver take things to a new level in their relationship, and Wes and Rebecca continue to grow suspicious of each other.

1.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S01E15 - It's All My Fault
1.plot: Wes, Connor, Michaela and Laurel may have dug themselves in too deep a hole for Annalise to save them, and the shocking truth about Lila's murder is finally revealed.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E01 - It's Time to Move On
2.plot: Annalise and her students must move on with their lives as though nothing has happened, but the students are still reeling over Rebecca’s disappearance. Only Annalise and Frank know that Rebecca was murdered and the two are determined to find out who killed her. Meanwhile, Annalise decides she wants to take on a new client, a brother and sister who are accused of killing their parents. And an old friend surprises Annalise at home and teaches her a valuable lesson.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E02 - She's Dying
2.plot: Annalise and her team are blindsided when investigators try to pin a new charge on the wealthy siblings she's been hired to represent. Meanwhile, things for Annalise become even more difficult when she's brutally cross-examined on the witness stand during Nate's preliminary hearing.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E03 - It’s Called the Octopus
2.plot: When Annalise takes on a new client, the team must investigate a very high end sex club to get answers. Meanwhile, Annalise is still representing the siblings accused of killing their parents, but the case takes a turn for the worse when a new motive surfaces, and Wes teams up with an unexpected ally.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E04 - Skanks Get Shanked
2.plot: When a teenager is found murdered in the woods, Annalise and her team is hired to represent an unlikely suspect named in the case. Meanwhile, Asher comes across a shocking confession, and Wes learns new information about Rebecca’s disappearance.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E05 - Meet Bonnie
2.plot: Asher discovers not everything is what it seems when you work for Annalise. Meanwhile, Frank is presented with a situation that hits close to home, and Wes’ search to find out more about Rebecca’s disappearance culminates into an explosive confrontation.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E06 - Two Birds, One Millstone
2.plot: Annalise takes on a new client, a transgender professor accused of killing her husband. Meanwhile, the Keating 5 are left to handle the Hapstall case and they discover a shocking new suspect.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E07 - I Want You to Die
2.plot: Annalise and the team are hired to represent a client accused of badgering somebody to the point of suicide. Meanwhile, Eve returns to defend Nate after ADA Sinclair serves him for a possible new murder charge, and Bonnie learns about what happened at Trotter Lake.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E08 - Hi, I'm Philip
2.plot: Philip makes a threatening move and ADA Sinclair may have figured out a way to take down Annalise. Meanwhile, Catherine and Caleb are forced to make a life changing decision.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E09 - What Did We Do?
2.plot: ADA Sinclair discovers a break in her favor in the Hapstall case, but her actions result in a deadly outcome as details are revealed about the night Annalise was shot, including the person responsible for pulling the trigger.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E10 - What Happened to You, Annalise?
2.plot: A few weeks have passed since Wes shot Annalise. Wes and The Keating 5 deal with the fallout from that night, as Annalise is faced with a complicated road to recovery.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E11 - She Hates Us
2.plot: Tensions in the Keating household run high, as each student struggles in their own way trying to return to normalcy. In a flashback, we’ll learn new details about Annalise’s past.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E13 - Something Bad Happened
2.plot: Annalise moves forward with a plan to protect the team from Philip but the risk involved may prove to be too dangerous. Meanwhile, Wes continues to search for new information regarding his mother’s death. In flashback, the Mahoney case takes a drastic turn for Annalise’s client.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E14 - There’s My Baby
2.plot: The Keating 5 are called into questioning by A.D.A Denver about the night Emily Sinclair was murdered. Meanwhile, Caleb goes missing as the manhunt for Philip intensifies. In flashback, Annalise’s tactics in the Mahoney case leads to a devastating result.

2.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S02E15 - Anna Mae
2.plot: Annalise begins to crack under pressure and wants to leave. Frank has to try and accept the things he has done.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E01 - We're Good People Now
3.plot: With Wallace Mahoney’s murder unsolved and Frank’s whereabouts unknown, the "Keating 5" struggle to move on with their lives as they enter into their second year of law school. Meanwhile, Annalise’s reputation at Middleton University is on the line, so she creates a criminal law clinic where the students will compete to try their own pro bono cases. Annalise also wrestles with a decision involving Frank that could change everything.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E02 - There Are Worse Things Than Murder
3.plot: With her job on the line, Annalise fights back against the Middleton University Board. Meanwhile, secrets are exposed as the Keating 5 compete to take on the case of a battered woman accused of murdering her husband.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E03 - Always Bet Black
3.plot: Annalise presents her class with a high-profile murder case that pushes even the Keating 5’s morals, while Laurel makes a shocking discovery through an unlikely source.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E04 - Don't Tell Annalise
3.plot: The fate of a young client is jeopardized after the Philadelphia Bar Association disciplinary board discovers damaging information about Annalise. Meanwhile, Frank commits a shocking act that someone close to him must deal with.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E05 - It’s About Frank
3.plot: The mystery behind the Annalise “killer” flyers takes a surprising twist. Meanwhile, Frank’s troubled past is exposed and a shocking new discovery changes everything about the night of the fire.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E06 - Is Someone Really Dead?
3.plot: A revelation in the Wallace Mahoney murder rattles Annalise and the Keating 5, as the team takes on the case of a veteran facing assault charges.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E07 - Call It Mother’s Intuition
3.plot: Annalise and her students take on a case defending siblings who have been charged with conspiracy to commit murder against their mother. Meanwhile, Frank’s actions lead to a painful consequence.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E08 - No More Blood
3.plot: Annalise and Bonnie turn to an unlikely source for help, bringing the tension among the Keating 5 to a head. Meanwhile, Annalise takes on a surprising client.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E09 - Who's Dead?
3.plot: Annalise receives a tip about A.D.A. Atwood that leads to a heated confrontation with Nate. Meanwhile, the deadly events leading up to Annalise’s house fire reveal who’s under the sheet.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E10 - We're Bad People
3.plot: With Annalise in jail facing arson and first-degree murder charges, the D.A.’s office continues to build their case against her, and the police investigate what happened to Wes on the night of the house fire. Meanwhile, the Keating 4 try to cope with the devastating realization that one of their own is dead.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E11 - Not Everything's About Annalise
3.plot: Annalise reaches her breaking point as she struggles to adapt to her new reality behind bars, but a surprise confession to Wes’ murder could change everything. Meanwhile, the K4 find their own freedom at risk as they discover the D.A.’s investigation is much bigger than they imagined.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E12 - Go Cry Somewhere Else
3.plot: Tensions in the courtroom run high, as the prosecution seeks to bring forth a new charge against Annalise. Meanwhile, Nate uncovers a crucial piece of information that could threaten his own innocence, as detectives call Oliver in for questioning.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E13 - It's War
3.plot: After being robbed of her power, Annalise makes it her mission to take down DA Denver and ADA Atwood. Meanwhile, Asher, Connor, Michaela, Laurel and Oliver continue to wrestle with the weight of Wes’ unsolved murder, and Nate makes a shocking discovery.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E14 - He Made a Terrible Mistake
3.plot: Annalise tries to ward off a surprising new angle in the D.A.’s case. Meanwhile, alliances shift amongst the Keating 4, as they discover crucial information about the circumstances surrounding Wes’s death.

3.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S03E15 - Wes
3.plot: Annalise and the Keating 4 test the limits of how far they’ll go to save themselves while the chilling details from the night of the fire reveal who killed Wes.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E01 - I'm Going Away
4.plot: In the wake of Wes’ tragic death, Annalise returns to her family home to pick up the pieces of her shattered life, and realizes that, in order to rebuild, she must make a tough and shocking decision. Meanwhile, “the Keating 4” all face an uncertain future while Laurel becomes obsessed with finding out what actually happened to Wes the night he died. In a flash-forward, a terrifying crime is committed and everyone is a suspect.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E02 - I'm Not Her
4.plot: While Annalise reconnects with an important client from her past, she continues to struggle to move forward in her personal life. Meanwhile, the “Keating 4” find it difficult to move past their tarnished reputations; and in a flash-forward, details to a tragic crime begin to unfold on.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E03 - It's for the Greater Good
4.plot: Annalise takes on a case for the greater good and quickly realizes the stakes are much higher than she originally thought. Meanwhile, Laurel asks Michaela to help get information regarding Wes’ death and Connor makes a major life decision that is not supported by the group. In a flash-forward, a surprising confrontation during the night of the crime is revealed.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E04 - Was She Ever Good at Her Job?
4.plot: Feeling like she’s found her purpose again, Annalise focuses on developing her big case and Bonnie grows suspicious. Meanwhile, Connor gets a surprise visit from his dad, and Laurel turns to an old friend to relieve some stress.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E05 - I Love Her
4.plot: Bonnie’s suspicions about Annalise’s big case drive her to surprising lengths to get answers, while flashbacks reveal the genesis of the two women’s long and complicated history; and the flash forward reveals the shocking whereabouts of one of the Keating 4.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E06 - Stay Strong, Mama
4.plot: A former colleague helps Annalise with her class action lawsuit; Laurel continues to investigate her father's company; Asher confronts Michaela about her odd behavior; details about Isaac's past are revealed.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E07 - Nobody Roots for Goliath
4.plot: When Annalise’s resolve to certify her class action lawsuit is tested, a surprising ally comes to her aid. Meanwhile, Laurel and Michaela hit a roadblock after someone discovers their plans to take down Laurel’s father.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E08 - Live. Live. Live.
4.plot: Annalise is confronted with disturbing news involving one of Isaac's patients. The investigation into Wes' murder comes to a head and details of the whereabouts of Laurel's baby are revealed.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E09 - He's Dead
4.plot: The group deals with more obstacles as police investigate the accidental shooting of Simon; Laurel and her baby cling to life.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E10 - Everything We Did Was for Nothing
4.plot: As Laurel struggles to come to terms with what happened on that tragic night, Annalise and Frank work together to do what they believe is best for the group. Meanwhile, details involving a past murder come to light as Annalise continues to build her class action.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E11 - He's a Bad Father
4.plot: An important person in Laurel’s life comes to town to help her as private details regarding her past are revealed. Meanwhile, Annalise encounters an obstacle involving a potential plaintiff for her class action.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E12 - Ask Him About Stella
4.plot: Annalise deals with an unforeseen issue after damaging details about a key witness are exposed in her case to help Laurel. Meanwhile, the “K4” continue their efforts to help build a case for Annalise’s class action lawsuit.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E13 - Lahey v. Commonwealth of Pennsylvania (II)
4.plot:
The events of Annalise’s class-action case hang in the balance after a meeting with Olivia proves to be crucial in getting the opportunity to argue Annalise’s case in the nation’s highest court. Meanwhile, Bonnie discovers concerning information pertaining to Simon that threatens to expose what really happened during night he was shot.

The crossover starts on Scandal S7E12 Allow Me to Reintroduce Myself (I).

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E14 - The Day Before He Died
4.plot: Annalise helps the “Keating 4” concoct a plan to prepare for another round of questioning after detectives get a break involving Simon’s case. Meanwhile, Laurel discovers new details about the night Wes was killed which lead to a surprising confrontation.

4.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S04E15 - Nobody Else Is Dying
4.plot: Annalise and her inner circle deal with the aftermath of a suspicious death that culminates with a shocking arrest; a new development involving one of their own changes everything.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E01 - Your Funeral
5.plot: Annalise selects students for her new legal clinic at Middleton and juggles job offers from competing firms, all while the Keating 4 attempt to move on from last semester’s turmoil. And in a startling flash-forward, a new mystery is introduced and it shakes things up for everyone.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E02 - Whose Blood Is That?
5.plot: Annalise preps to defend her first class action plaintiff and adjusts to the politics of the new job. Meanwhile, Frank is suspicious of Gabriel and does some investigating of his own, and Asher complicates Bonnie’s new life away from Annalise.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E03 - The Baby Was Never Dead
5.plot: Annalise and Emmett defend a wealthy CEO accused of killing his business partner, while the governor goes after Annalise and puts her new caseload and legal clinic in jeopardy. Bonnie struggles to accept her budding romance, and Asher tries to outmaneuver his old mentor.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E04 - It's Her Kid
5.plot: Annalise and Nate look to get Nate’s dad a psych evaluation so that they can have his murder case retried under an insanity plea. Meanwhile, Michaela works overtime to convince Tegan to give her a chance to earn her trust back, and Bonnie gets an offer she mulls over.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E05 - It Was the Worst Day of My Life
5.plot: After Annalise chooses Gabriel as her second chair, the unexpected duo puts all of their efforts into Nate Sr.’s murder re-trial as they try to convince a jury to grant an insanity plea. Meanwhile, Bonnie struggles to rebound after a dark part of her past resurfaces.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E06 - We Can Find Him
5.plot: Annalise receives a call from Governor Birkhead, and she’s forced to weigh an interesting offer, while Bonnie reunites with her sister looking for answers from what happened years ago. Connor and Oliver try to keep their cool while their mothers are in town helping with wedding plans, and Tegan surprisingly enlists Laurel’s help on a big case at the firm.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E07 - I Got Played
5.plot: Connor and Oliver attempt to secure a church for their wedding to appease their moms; Annalise and Nate continue their quest for justice in the face of endless obstacles; Annalise begins to doubt the governor's dedication to her cause.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E08 - I Want to Love You Until the Day I Die
5.plot: From the warden's phone records, Nate identifies the person responsible for his dad's death. Frank tells Annalise about Gabriel at the wedding.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E09 - He Betrayed Us Both
5.plot: Now that Connor and Oliver have tied the knot, the crew must deal with the consequences of the wedding night’s murder; and Annalise is forced to reckon with secrets from her past.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E10 - Don't Go Dark on Me
5.plot: As the investigation into Miller’s murder intensifies, Bonnie and Nate formulate their alibis while Annalise devises a plan to ensure Gabriel never learns the truth about his father.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E11 - Be the Martyr
5.plot: Nate is on a mission to prove he was right about the culprit in his father’s murder, while Bonnie begins to doubt herself; and Annalise turns the tables in the courtroom.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E12 - We Know Everything
5.plot: Nate and Annalise both need to keep Gabriel close to ensure their secrets stay hidden.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E13 - Where Are Your Parents?
5.plot: Annalise gathers everyone together for the holidays while she wrestles over a difficult decision about her future, and the investigation into Miller’s murder starts to widen.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E14 - Make Me the Enemy
5.plot: Annalise is determined to get to the truth about Nate Sr.’s murder and will stop at nothing until she does.

5.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S05E15 - Please Say No One Else Is Dead
5.plot: Annalise and her team need to get to the truth before the truth gets them.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E01 - Say Goodbye
6.plot: Annalise struggles with the personal toll that Laurel and Christopher’s disappearance has taken on everyone. Meanwhile, the remaining Keating 4, Oliver, Frank and Bonnie disagree on the possible reasons behind Laurel’s disappearance. Tegan handles the aftermath of Emmett’s apparent poisoning, and Gabriel wants to take his budding relationship with Michaela to the next level.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E02 - Vivian's Here
6.plot: As Michaela, Asher and Connor gear up for their last semester of law school, they take on a weighty case involving an illegal immigrant who wants asylum. Meanwhile, Michaela boycotts going to class after a blowup with Annalise about her father. Elsewhere, in an unexpected confrontation, Annalise learns a shocking truth that makes her question everything she thought she knew.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E03 - Do You Think I'm a Bad Man?
6.plot: After Michaela’s courtroom tactics do more harm than help, Annalise draws on memories of Sam to guide Michaela back to the winning path. Meanwhile, Connor bites off more than he can chew in his effort to reunite a family, forcing Tegan to call in a favor and fix his mess. Frank enlists Oliver’s help to follow a lead on Laurel; and Gabriel learns new information about Michaela’s birth father.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E04 - I Hate the World
6.plot: The FBI continues to interrogate Conner which leads him to panic under the pressure. Meanwhile, Annalise, Tegan and the students defend a woman accused of violating a disabled man’s civil rights for developing a dating app that discriminates against him. Elsewhere, Bonnie helps Nate get more intel on Tegan while Michaela and Gabriel travel to New York to track down her father.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E05 - We're All Gonna Die
6.plot: During therapy, a young Annalise is forced to acknowledge a very emotional and pivotal reality that makes her admit a hard truth. Meanwhile, Frank’s recent peril leads to a new secret revealed about Laurel’s disappearance. Elsewhere in an attempt to get to know her father, Michaela accepts an offer to work alongside him but quickly learns that it’s not all that it’s cracked up to be.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E06 - Family Sucks
6.plot: Annalise intervenes in Michaela’s relationship with her father and asks for his help in return. Because Nate still doesn’t trust Tegan, he attempts to get in good with someone who was once close to her. After Asher reunites and has an unpleasant conversation with his estranged mother, he shares a meaningful moment with Michaela. Elsewhere, Connor finally learns why he was originally picked for the Keating 5.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E07 - I'm the Murderer
6.plot: Gabriel is first chair on a case defending a teacher involved in a school shooting, and this case hits particularly close to home for both Gabriel and Annalise. Elsewhere, Annalise attempts to discourage Tegan from her new quest to right a wrong, all while Oliver makes a shocking confession.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E08 - I Want to Be Free
6.plot: After taking the stand during Nate Senior’s murder trial, Bonnie’s world is turned upside down when a mysterious accident leads her to a hard realization. Meanwhile, the students compete for a large cash bonus during the final exam where they must come up with the best defense for a conspiracy-to-murder charge.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E09 - Are You the Mole?
6.plot: On the eve of graduation, Oliver gifts Connor, Michaela and Asher something unexpected. At the dean’s cocktail party, Annalise learns disturbing news. Later, Michaela receives a surprise phone call, and the FBI informant is finally revealed.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E10 - We're Not Getting Away With It
6.plot: Annalise’s disappearance is uncovered, and the fallout affects everyone. Following Asher’s death, Michaela and Connor are booked on murder charges and forced to make the most difficult decision of their lives. Bonnie reveals a secret about Tegan, and Gabriel becomes a potential murder suspect.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E11 - The Reckoning
6.plot: Annalise’s disappearance leads to panic and paranoia as Michaela and Connor consider taking a deal in their cases. All the while anxious, everyone mourns Asher’s death as Gabriel holds on to key details about his murder

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E12 - Let's Hurt Him
6.plot: Annalise is forced to fight for her life while Gabriel approaches Michaela, Connor and Oliver with a theory about Sam’s murder. Frank and Bonnie have a heart-to-heart.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E13 - What If Sam Wasn't the Bad Guy This Whole Time?
6.plot: Annalise learns unexpected and shocking details about Sam’s past. Meanwhile, Connor and Michaela feel the pressure when the FBI learns there is new evidence in the case; and Frank and Bonnie’s history is explored, revealing what originally fractured their relationship.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E14 - Annalise Keating Is Dead
6.plot: Annalise’s murder trial has arrived, but Tegan’s history complicates her role as counsel. While Nate visits Jorge Castillo in prison with a proposition, news breaks about Xavier. Bonnie works to help Annalise use Hannah Keating’s past as blackmail.

6.title: FR - How to Get Away with Murder - S06E15 - Stay
6.plot: Annalise discovers there’s a surprise witness that threatens her case. Meanwhile, Connor tries to persuade the K3 to go along with a new plan. Elsewhere, a lie between Frank and Bonnie threatens their relationship as Annalise’s killer is finally revealed.

Une enquête d’autant plus compliquée que les deux agents cachent la bavure qu’ils ont commise en provoquant, malgré eux, la mort accidentelle de leur premier suspect. Ce qui ne manque pas d’éveiller les soupçons de Jessica Carson, leur jeune rivale au FBI…

D'après le film "Mais qui a tué Pamela Rose ?" (2003), d'Eric Latigau.

1.plot: Despite a rocky start at Yullim Law Firm, Kang Hyo-min joins Yoon Seok-hoon's team — and impresses him when she finds a discrepancy in their first case.

1.title: FR - La Voie du droit (VOSTFR) - S01E02 - Hot Water Is the Test for Tea and Love
1.plot: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min take on a case involving a man who broke into a fertility clinic — earning trust in a tangled battle of love, health and injustice.

1.title: FR - La Voie du droit (VOSTFR) - S01E03 - Butterfly Chrysalis
1.plot: A complex no-contact car accident involving a child sends Seok-hoon and Hyo-min digging for clues. Seok-hoon receives a bold offer from Yullim's founder.

1.title: FR - La Voie du droit (VOSTFR) - S01E04 - Lex Talionis
1.plot: While defending a CEO accused of child abuse, Hyo-min and Seok-hoon clash over their morals. Soon, Seok-hoon's sudden disappearance worries her.

1.title: FR - La Voie du droit (VOSTFR) - S01E05 - Salieri's Monologue
1.plot: Hyo-min takes on her first solo case over a painting's copyright, leaning on Seok-hoon for mentorship — until a mid-trial revelation shakes her stride.

meta.plot: Une jeune avocate dotée d'un sens aigu de la justice rejoint un cabinet de premier plan pour tracer sa voie dans un monde complexe sous la houlette d'un mentor froid et exigeant.
Des camps d’internement aux sectes exploitant la foi, des survivants brisent le silence et révèlent des tragédies glaçantes que personne ne pensait voir un jour en Corée.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E01 - Brothers' Home — The Truth About Vanishing Children
1.plot: Survivors of Brothers' Home reveal childhood atrocities — including assault, sexual abuse and forced labor — at a center disguised as rehab for vagrants.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E02 - Brothers' Home — I Was Treated No Better Than a Pig
1.plot: The end of Brothers' Home wasn't the end of the ordeal. Survivors keep fighting for justice, meeting their abusers face-to-face to demand answers.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E03 - JMS — Messiah and the Real Power Behind the Throne
1.plot: Maple's fight isn't over as the probe into Jeong Myeong-seok's sexual abuse widens — now facing fierce resistance from his confidante, Jeong Jo-eun.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E04 - JMS — Blind Defenders of the Messiah
1.plot: Maple's testimony puts Jeong Myeong-seok back in legal danger, but his cult's power runs deep — spanning police and officials. Can justice break through?

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E05 - Chijon Family — Nine Days in Hell
1.plot: Kidnapped at 27 and forced to commit unthinkable acts, a Chijon family survivor recounts the terror and lasting scars left by the notorious gang.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E06 - Chijon Family — I'm a Survivor Who Took a Life to Save My Own
1.plot: Given a miraculous chance to escape, the Chijon family survivor helps bring down the gang with police — exposing the twisted beliefs behind their crimes.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E07 - Sampoong Department Store — The Collapse
1.plot: Almost 30 years after the collapse of Sampoong Department Store, survivors and witnesses recall the chaos, disorganization and gruesome recovery efforts.

1.title: FR - J'ai survécu : Tragédies coréennes - S01E08 - Sampoong Department Store — The Building Built on Greed
1.plot: As rescue efforts continue at the collapsed Sampoong Department Store, the cause — from construction flaws to crookedness — slowly comes to light.

1.title: FR - The Kingdom - S01E01 - Family Business
1.plot: Behind Patrick Mahomes, whose journey from son of a baseball player to superstar quarterback is already legendary, the Chiefs - one of the NFL's most storied franchises - kick off their bid for a third straight Super Bowl title. But a rash of injuries threaten their strong start to the 2024 season and raise serious concerns about the challenging road ahead.

1.title: FR - The Kingdom - S01E02 - Don't Judge
1.plot: Guided by a resolve never to judge anyone else and a firm belief in second chances, legendary Chiefs coach Andy Reid has leaned on family bonds to sustain him through the highs of victory and the lows of unthinkable tragedy. As the 2024 season continues, injuries and new additions engender major question marks.

1.title: FR - The Kingdom - S01E03 - In Our Chiefs Era
1.plot: In the most anticipated game of the regular season, the Chiefs square off against AFC rivals Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills. Meanwhile beyond the field, the team works to maintain focus, a difficult task considering their dominance and global popularity have earned them love and hate in equal measure.

1.title: FR - The Kingdom - S01E04 - The Formula
1.plot: An ankle injury to Patrick Mahomes puts more pressure - and the team's Super Bowl hopes - on the shoulders of Chris Jones and the Chiefs' defense. A Christmas Day showdown against the Pittsburgh Steelers has major postseason implications.

1.title: FR - The Kingdom - S01E05 - Heartland
1.plot: With Chiefs Kingdom in full-throated support, Kansas City earns a home playoff win against the Texans. Their reward: an AFC Championship Game rematch with the Buffalo Bills, with a third straight trip to the Super Bowl on the line.

1.title: FR - The Kingdom - S01E06 - The Pursuit
1.plot: The Chiefs arrive in New Orleans on the verge of Super Bowl history. Standing in the way of their three-peat hopes are the Philadelphia Eagles, who have no intention of playing supporting characters in a storybook ending.

meta.plot: Suivez deux histoires d'amour parallèles se déroulant à deux époques différentes : les parents de Jamie Fraser dans les Highlands écossais du début du XVIIIe siècle et les parents de Claire Beauchamp dans l'Angleterre de la Première Guerre mondiale.

1.title: FR - Outlander : Blood Of My Blood - S01E03 - School of the Moon

1.title: FR - Outlander : Blood Of My Blood - S01E05 - Needfire

1.title: FR - Outlander : Blood Of My Blood - S01E06 - Birthright
1.plot: Henry continues to look for Julia until a new discovery threatens to end his search.

1.title: FR - Outlander : Blood Of My Blood - S01E08 - A Virtuous Woman

1.title: FR - Outlander : Blood Of My Blood - S01E09 - Braemar

1.title: FR - Outlander : Blood Of My Blood - S01E10 - Something Borrowed
1.plot: Ellen prepares for her wedding day, while Julia attempts her escape.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E02 - Shots for Dots
1.plot: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents, begins plotting his escape. Meanwhile, Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach. In town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E03 - Graduation
1.plot: Luke begins to plan his escape while Sigsby is distracted trying to expose Stackhouse's disloyalty. Meanwhile, Tim loses a friend.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E04 - The Box
1.plot: As Luke's tests intensify, a new arrival causes problems for Sigsby; Tim isn't buying the official story about what happened to Annie.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E05 - Back Half
1.plot: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E06 - Run
1.plot: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E07 - Hide
1.plot: Luke and Tim go on a desperate search for help as Sigsby uses all of her formidable assets in a last-ditch attempt to keep the Institute's secrets.

1.title: FR - L'Institut - S01E08 - Fight
1.plot: Our characters come together for a final confrontation with unimaginable consequences.

meta.plot: "L'Institut" nous plonge dans les mystères d'une organisation secrète qui enlève des enfants dotés de pouvoirs psychiques et les utilise pour des missions ultrasecrètes dans le but de "sauver le monde". Luke Ellis, un surdoué qui a le pouvoir de télékinésie, est le dernier kidnappé. Il est déterminé à s'échapper avec ses nouveaux amis et espère trouver un moyen de faire tomber l'organisation.
