1.plot: Tempers flare at Chevening House, where an unexpected guest's arrival sends Kate and Dennison scrambling for a resolution. Hal makes a new connection.

1.title: FR - La Diplomate - S01E06 - Some Lusty Tornado
1.plot: To appease Trowbridge, Kate seeks Hal's help with a high-profile visitor and consults an informed source in secret as complicated feelings begin to grow.

1.title: FR - La Diplomate - S01E07 - Keep Your Enemies Closer
1.plot: After a sit-down with a Russian ambassador leads to new intel and mixed messages, Kate takes a trip to the Oval Office and reconnects with an old friend.

1.title: FR - La Diplomate - S01E08 - The James Bond Clause
1.plot: In London, Hal's actions cause friction as Kate heads to Paris with Dennison to get a handle on the Lenkov situation, which soon takes a shocking turn.

2.title: FR - La Diplomate - S02E01 - When a Stranger Calls
2.plot: After rushing back to London, Kate shares her suspicions about the bombing. The search is on for Lenkov — and Roylin. Eidra delivers devastating news.

2.title: FR - La Diplomate - S02E02 - St. Paul's
2.plot: Eidra helps sneak an unannounced guest into Grove's funeral, Kate realizes she might have made a bad call before the bombing, and Stuart speaks his mind.

2.title: FR - La Diplomate - S02E03 - The Ides of March
2.plot: A lavish Fourth of July party gives Kate a chance to help Dennison, who sees an opportunity after the prime minister's announcement about Lenkov.

2.title: FR - La Diplomate - S02E04 - The Other Army
2.plot: Kate proposes a unique solution to the Roylin problem. A risky plan unfolds at the prime minister's event in Scotland. Stuart confronts his feelings.

2.title: FR - La Diplomate - S02E05 - Our Lady of Immaculate Deception
2.plot: Vice President Grace Penn arrives in London with an agenda — and advice — as fallout from Roylin's bombshell affects Kate's relationship with Trowbridge.

2.title: FR - La Diplomate - S02E06 - Dreadnought
2.plot: Kate puts her best foot forward after pillow talk with Hal forces her to face hard truths, and Vice President Penn offers a blunt lesson in geopolitics.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E01 - Emperor Dead
3.plot: Amid a growing constitutional crisis, the staff scrambles to stage an impromptu inauguration, while Hal exploits the chaos behind the scenes.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E02 - Last Dance at the Country Club
3.plot: Kate weighs a compelling offer. Eidra faces scrutiny over fallout from the Roylin debacle. Stuart pitches a proposal that goes far deeper than policy.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E03 - The Riderless Horse
3.plot: As the nation pauses to mourn, Grace considers the framework of her administration. Private strain threatens Kate and Hal's polished public image.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E04 - Arden
3.plot: Kate's unique role grants her access to anyone she wants — except the one person she needs. Dennison puts actionable intelligence to personal use.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E05 - Birdwatchers
3.plot: Forced to play the perfect couple, Kate and Hal confront a looming problem in international waters and a development that could torpedo U.S. credibility.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E06 - Amagansett
3.plot: At an emergency strategy session, Grace weighs unthinkable choices, while Kate rolls the dice on a gamble that could alter the course of history.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E07 - PNG
3.plot: Sequestered inside Winfield House as embassies go on alert and allies fall silent, Kate and Callum race to contain a potential disaster.

3.title: FR - La Diplomate - S03E08 - Schrodinger's Wife
3.plot: Kate must use all her leverage and political instincts to avert a catastrophe at a high-stakes summit — with the fate of nations hanging in the balance.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E01 - The Comeback
1.plot: Aarch the previous Akillian GF "Galactik Football" striker has a memory of his last football match when he takes a penalty but a freak snow and ice storm disrupts the game and the planet Akillian is left in an ice age. Aarch has come back after 15 years to make a new team and try for the GF cup. Aarch meets a few unhappy people with his return, but a bunch of teens,are excited to hear of his return. Some guys are sent to deal with Aarch and his friend clamp that very evening but their saved by the group of teens who are glad to know of his arrival.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E02 - A New Hope
1.plot: Aarch collects new Command for Galactik Football.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E03 - The Challenge
1.plot: During the tests, Aarch is convinced that Tia and the others possess the Breath of Akillian. He still has one position to fill on his team, so he visits his brother to convince him to let Rocket (Aarch's nephew) play.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E04 - The Team
1.plot: The team that Aarch has put together has been approved and is now headed for the moon of Ibo. They'll be playing a friendly match against the legendary Wamba team, whose star attacker Lun Zaera is especially dangerous.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E05 - The Captain
1.plot: Today the Snow Kids are up against the Red Tigers in a match that will decide which of the two teams is going to represent Akillian in the Galactik Football Cup. The police have taken Tia back to her parents.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E06 - Second Wind
1.plot: The Snow Kids are losing 3-0 against the Red Tigers at half-time. They have to win this match if they want to qualify. Will Tia's return be enough to turn the situation around? Not if Artegor Nexus has anything to say about it.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E07 - Coach's Pet
1.plot: The tensions among the Snow Kids are making themselves felt: Micro-Ice is trying to get closer to Mei, but she has only one thing on her mind: becoming an attacker. Worse yet, the Snow Kids have to deal with the Rykers.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E08 - The Storm
1.plot: While the Shadows-Pirates game is in full swing, Aarch looks for the captain of his team, but to no avail. Rocket has disappeared. Tia thinks she knows where he could be hiding, but an enormous snowstorm is brewing outside.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E09 - Revenge Match
1.plot: Today the Snow Kids are playing the return match against the Rykers if they lose this match, our young heroes will advance no further in the competition. Micro-Ice's thoughts, however, have turned to Mei.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E10 - The Pirates
1.plot: The Snow Kids are traveling to play another legendary team: the Pirates of Shiloe. Since the Pirates are always on the move and ready to respond to any possible attack by Technoid, anything could happen.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E11 - The Professor
1.plot: During the return match against the Pirates, Rocket is injured. Clamp is somewhat distracted as he follows the match, and who could blame him? Memories of his past work for Technoid are coming back to him.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E12 - The Escape
1.plot: While Clamp is being kidnapped by Technoid robots, Sonny escapes through the ventilation duct and winds up face to face with Micro-Ice. Everyone at Aarch Academy is very worried: Aarch searches for Clamp, who suddenly reappears.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E13 - The Striker
1.plot: Snow Kids are up against the terrifying Shadows, and Micro-Ice still has not come back. Aarch is crazed with worry how will they play the match without him. D'Jok puts the blame on Mei, saying that it's her fault that Micro-Ice has left.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E14 - Black Hole
1.plot: Micro-Ice's return is a relief to everyone, because the Snow Kids are leaving immediately for the planet Shadows to play the return match. How will the Snow Kids play successfully under these conditions against Artegor's team.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E15 - Last Chance
1.plot: It's half time in the Snow Kids-Shadows match, and our young heroes have no energy left. They let the provocations of their opponents get to them and Thran seems exhausted they're losing 3-0. Only Rocket has managed to get his second wind.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E16 - Genesis Stadium
1.plot: These new and surprising conditions excite everyone, especially Mei, who has agreed to be a spokes-model for a brand of shampoo. But Tia has other things on her mind; armed with a photo of Rocket's mother, she goes to look for her.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E17 - Get Ready
1.plot: D'Jok has become the newest rising Galactik Football star, and he and his teammates are extremely confident before their upcoming match against the Wambas. Sonny and the Pirates have discovered why MetaFlux is so extremely important.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E18 - Under Pressure
1.plot: The match against the Wambas nearly turned into a complete fiasco. D'Jok really has let fame go to this head. Mei is being pressured by her mother to film new ads. And Tia has planned a surprise party for Rocket's birthday.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E19 - The Star
1.plot: The next match the Snow Kids will be playing against the Lightnings. Clamp who is still being held in a secret Technoid laboratory is getting sicker. Bleylock offers him an antidote that will allow him to live, but demands the Meta-Flux.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E20 - Metaflux
1.plot: The Snow Kids have qualified for the semi-final and the real Clamp is back. Unfortunately, he has some very bad news to report MetaFlux can be very dangerous to the health of players that use it. also D'Jok finds out that Sonny is his dad.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E21 - The Forfeit
1.plot: Aarch and his players are in serious trouble. Without MetaFlux, our young heroes seem to be losing control of the Breath of Akillian. They have no chance of winning the match against the Technoid team.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E22 - The Missing Link
1.plot: While the Pirate chief tries to put the MetaFlux in a safe place D'Jok confesses to Micro-Ice that Sonny Blackbones is his father. D'Jok's disappearance during the second semi-final between the Shadows and the Cyclopes makes Aarch worried.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E23 - Blackmail
1.plot: While almost all the parents have come to attend the party right before the final, D'Jok isolates himself. Mei can no longer approach him, and even the Pirates cannot convince him to speak to them. D'Jok is highly preoccupied.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E24 - The Duel
1.plot: Before the final Aarch is pessimistic about his team's chances of winning D'Jok is the most troubled of all if the Snow Kids win the final his father Sonny will die Sinedd seems to know about this terrible dilemma and makes D'Jok an offer.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E25 - The Traitor
1.plot: The Snow Kids are just minutes away from the Galactik Football Cup final!. Will D'Jok really throw the game to save his father? Will Maya manage to convince him not to? Will the Pirates ally themselves with Technoid to save Sonny?

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E26 - The Cup
1.plot: Everyone in Genesis Stadium is holding their breath D'Jok is going to shoot the free kick that will tie the score in the Galactik Football Cup final D'Jok is worn out. The Pirates have just arrived where Bleylock is holding Sonny prisoner.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E01 - Return to Genesis
2.plot: Four years after their triumphant victory in the Galactik Football Cup the Snow Kids return to Genesis Stadium and prepare to do it again but all is not well with the team. Ahito has a mysterious illness and may have to return to Akillian.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E02 - The Suspension
2.plot: Rocket saves Tia's life in Genesis Forest, but to do it, he uses The Breath. Yuki becomes the new Snow Kids' goalkeeper after Addim tells Aarch of the illegal use of The Breath. Aarch has no choice but to suspend Rocket indefinitely.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E03 - A Team Reinvented
2.plot: Aarch searches for a replacement for Rocket, but it's not easy. Rocket is irreplaceable. D'Jok suggests Mark from Akillian to step in. Sinedd introduces Rocket to Netherball a dangerous one-on-one football match played inside The Sphere.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E04 - The New Captain
2.plot: Clamp tells Sonny that he saw Bleylock alive. Sonny doesn't believe it, Aarch makes D'Jok the new captain of the Snow Kids in Rocket's absence; Tia takes it badly - The "friendly" between the Snow Kids and The Shadows is very unfriendly.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E05 - The Homecoming
2.plot: The Snow Kids go home to Akillian to surprise Ahito who is there recovering from his illness. The big news is Ahito's coming back to Genesis with the Snow Kids, but he's still not ready to play.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E06 - Netherball Rules!
2.plot: Back on Genesis, Norata blames Aarch for Rocket's disappearance. Rocket plays the Rykers's star Kernor - the current Netherball champion - in a brutal one-on-one match. Will she remain in The Sphere?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E07 - Doubts Within
2.plot: The Snow Kids go to Addim saying that Rocket should not be suspended. It's announced that D'Jok will replace Rocket on the All-Star Team but D'Jok seems a bit too happy about it Mei reminds him of the real problem Rocket is still missing.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E08 - Rocket's Descent
2.plot: Plunging into the world of Netherball, Rocket plays Woowamboo of the Wambas. Will Rocket keep control of The Sphere? Sonny tells his men they need to find Rocket. Rocket may lead them to Bleylock - if Bleyok is alive.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E09 - The All-Stars
2.plot: The Snow-Kids watch the match on the Holo-TV: the All-Stars vs. the Technodroids V3s - Luur of the Xenons is very impressive; his flux, the Heat of Xenon is one of the most powerful forces in the galaxy.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E10 - Rocket vs. Sinedd
2.plot: Against the wishes of Bleylock and Harris, Sinedd plays Rocket in a rough match of Netherball. Will Sinedd control The Sphere? The pirates Arty and Bennett follow Wolfen and Zoran into the lower levels of Genesis Stadium.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E11 - The Champions Stumble
2.plot: Harris sneaks into Addim's office and places a video file on her computer to keep Rocket playing Netherball. The League votes to delay Rocket's return to the GFC, early in the match with the Wambas, the Snow Kids are losing.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E12 - Last Stand
2.plot: The Snow Kids are trailing the Wambas at the half and the team is very depressed especially D'Jok. It looks bad for our champions suddenly Ahito comes back and subs for Yuki in the second half Aarch pushes the Snow Kids to win the match.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E13 - Fluxless
2.plot: The Shadows/Pirates match begins, Bleylock orders his robots in a spacecraft to fire a flux device at the Shadows planet causing a huge explosion the Shadows suddenly lose their flux The Pirates easily beat the Shadows 7-2.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E14 - New Order
2.plot: After the explosion on the Shadows planet, and the Pirates GF team is disqualified. Rocket plays Luur in Netherball in a wicked obstacle match. D'Jok tells Rocket that he can play GF again, but Rocket tells him he's never coming back.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E15 - Revelations
2.plot: Tia discovers that Technoid is holding her parents prisoners Mei promises to help she introduces Tia to her special friend Corso The Xenons and the Cyclops play in the quarterfinals. Luur uses his flux, the Heat of Xenon to deadly results.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E16 - New Rules
2.plot: Dame Simbai informs him that the explosion on the Shadows planet was a flux device Sonny now knows what's behind Netherball. Aarch announces the new assistant coach for the Snow Kids Artegor Nexus who putting Yuki in Tia's vacant position.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E17 - Open Doors
2.plot: Tia is taken prisoner with Sonny and his pirates aboard the Technoid prison barge. She spots her parents in a nearby cell The Snow Kids play the Rykers in the quarterfinals match but Rocket has not come back and Tia is with the pirates.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E18 - Warren Steps In
2.plot: D'Jok competes in the Big Kicks Challenge in Genesis Stadium with other GF stars. D'Jok and Mark (and secretly Tia) go back down to watch Warren play Rocket in a brutal Netherball match with obstacles can Warren beat Rocket?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E19 - The Technodroid V3s
2.plot: The Lightnings and the Technodroids V3s battle it out in their quarterfinals match. Yuki warms up to Micro-Ice to his shock. But they're late for practice again. D'Jok goes down to play Rocket in Netherball, but someone steps in his way.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E20 - The Fallen Star
2.plot: Tia bravely enters the Netherball Sphere to play Rocket but Rocket's too far gone. He's too wrapped up in the sport to know it's even her. Rocket plays harder than ever. Can Rocket be beaten? Will Tia survive the match?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E21 - Coach Artegor
2.plot: The Snow Kids are thrilled to have Rocket back but Rocket is shocked to see Artegor coaching. After the Shadow's flux returns Artegor gets his wish The Shadow play the Xenons in their semifinals match can Shadows beat the invincible Xenons

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E22 - Rocket, the Midfielder
2.plot: Against Maya's wishes D'Jok plays in the Snow Kids semifinals match with the Lightnings. But on the pitch, Ahito falters could he still be sick As halftime approaches the Snow Kids are trailing Aarch is not sure that his team wants to win.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E23 - Destiny
2.plot: It's the second half of the semifinals match between the Snow Kids and the Lightnings and the Snow Kids are losing 2-0. Rocket rallies the team to everyone's surprise, and thanks to D'Jok's great idea, the Snow Kids fight back.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E24 - Final Preparations
2.plot: Sonny finds Bleylock in an alley. Now Sonny knows Bleylock's true intentions to destroy Genesis Stadium Snow kids parents are at Genesis expecting a night out with their children however the Snow Kids have their own plans.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E25 - A Team Unravels
2.plot: Cup finals fever has hit Genesis Stadium despite the Snow Kids being the current champions the odds are on the Xenons and their power flux the Heat of Xenon meanwhile Arty and Bennett find Bleylock but lose the flux devices in Luna Genesis

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E26 - Bleylock's Revenge
2.plot: Snow Kids play the second half time against Xenons D'Jok manages to tie the result to 2:2. Meanwhile, The Pirates chase Bleylock Can Snow Kids beat Xenons Harris is shown placing a flux device saying that one day they will rule the galaxy.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E01 - Stars in Danger
3.plot: The Snow Kids are on Akillian practicing for their upcoming friendly match against the Shadows. But they play without conviction. When explosions at Genesis Stadium sever the contact with Mei who was participating from a distance.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E02 - The Break-Up
3.plot: Mei still can't be found but then suddenly appears on Arcadia Sports along with Sinedd She announces that she is joining the Shadows and will participate in the Paradisia tournament Rocket, asks Artegor Nexus to help the Snow Kids.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E03 - Welcome to Paradisia
3.plot: Phoenix hopes to equip Paradisia with its own Flux but Vega reminds him that this has a price The teams are looking for new stars including the Snow Kids since Mei has joined the Shadows On the beach Rocket can't take his eyes off Lun-Zia

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E04 - A New Strategy
3.plot: In space Sonny and his pirates are being chased by the Paradisia security forces while D'Jok receives a tempting offer from Lord Phoenix Aarch and Artegor join the Snow Kids practice session to show them how it's done.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E05 - Resonance
3.plot: While Rocket and Tia are jogging on the beach, they meet Nikki 4, one of the players on the mysterious Team Paradisia Rocket finds her to be very strange, while practicing the Breath of Akillian Rocket suddenly collapses to the ground

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E06 - May the Show Begin!
3.plot: As the Shadows/Rykers and Elektras/Cyclops matches take place simultaneously at Deep Stadium and Dome Stadium, the pirates are caught in the "Phoenix Corporation" control room. Sonny discovers Lord Phoenix's real identity.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E07 - Fathers and Sons
3.plot: While Sonny, rescued by his pirates, remains in grave condition, D'Jok and the Snow Kids are preparing for their matches: Team Paradisia versus the Wambas, and the Snow Kids versus the Pirates. The Snow Kids are predicted to lose.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E08 - The Other Side of Paradisia
3.plot: On Paradisia, two exciting matches will pit the Xenons versus the Technodroids V4 and the Lightnings versus the "other" Akillian team, the Red Tigers. To everyone's surprise, the Red Tigers seem to have found the Breath.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E09 - The Secret of Deep Stadium
3.plot: The Xenons take on the Snow Kids in a quarterfinal match. In another quarterfinal match D'Jok and Team Paradisia battle Warren and the Lightnings. Sonny recovers and returns to try and stop the multi-flux plan.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E10 - Friends and Enemies
3.plot: Sinedd reveals his parents died during the earlier flux war and that he has never seen them, but they mysteriously reappear. The first semifinal is held between the Shadows and the Elektras.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E11 - Battle for the Final
3.plot: Tia and Mice learn of the multi-flux and try to help break the pirates out of Deep Dome The Snow Kids parents visit Paradisa to help relax their kids before the second semifinal match between the Snow Kids and Team Paradisia

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E12 - Betrayal on the Field
3.plot: Elsewhere Sonny corners Phoenix and forces him to reveal that multi-flux is in the core. It is believed Paradisia will be stable for a week, Brim Simbra, arrives and deems that Paradisia must be evacuated for everyone to be safe.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E13 - Endgame
3.plot: The championship begins The teams battle to a 2:0 Halftime score a robotic cat approaches Phoenix A hologram of Harris comes out and thanks Lord Phoenix for playing right into his trap massive earthquakes begin to rock Paradisia's surface.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E14 - A New Start
3.plot: The Snow Kids survive the blast and return to Akillian. Things don't look as bright for Brim Simbra and Lord Phoenix though. The two are officially declared dead. Brim Balarius is made the new head of the flux committee.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E15 - Crossed Fates
3.plot: In order to participate in the Cup LunZia must learn the Breath Mei must learn the Smog Yuki must learn the Wave Mei decides she can't tolerate the sickness Mei visits D'Jok who has started up football classes for young kids in the Genesis

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E16 - The Secrets of the Breath
3.plot: Shadows win their first game of the Cup 3:0, Mei reveals herself to her teammates as they board the shuttle. Snow Kids with Mei versus The Wambas, Clamp contacts Sonny and reveals the news that Harris is after the Cup.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E17 - Reconstituted Families
3.plot: D'Jok, Warren, and Artegor start Club Galactik, a youth camp teaching all the basics of Galactik Football but without the emphasis on heavy practice. Two matches are shown- the Pirates vs. the Red Tigers and the Cyclops vs. Team Paradisia.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E18 - Sinedd's Shadow
3.plot: A press conference is held announcing that D'Jok has rejoined the Snow Kids Mei learns that Sinedd's parents were fake Sinedd plays all out in the first half and gives the Shadows a 2:1 lead The Snow Kids walk away with a 3:2 in to advance

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E19 - The Ghost of Paradisia
3.plot: Clamp decides to go to Paradisia with Sonny to make sure they get the correct sample of multi-flux and to find Harvey's signal. The second quarterfinal between the Lightning and Team Paradisia takes place.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E20 - Walk for a Pirate
3.plot: Sonny and company begin looking for the human survivor on Paradisia. The survivor is none other than Magnus Blade in the Zenons/ Rykers quarterfinal game the Zenons advanced 3:2 and after that begins game Pirates/ Elektras.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E21 - Farewell, Paradisia
3.plot: The pirates escaping Paradisia with Magnus Blade In the escape Brim Simbra gets Sonny to promise he won't let the Multi-flux enter the cup. Brim Simbra passes away, and the Snow Kids/ Zenons semifinal match has its opening face-off.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E22 - All Together!
3.plot: The Snow Kids battle the Zenons in the first semifinal. The Pirates return Thran and Clamp to the Snow Kids at Halftime Adium sneaks out to see Aarch Magnus reveals that Team Paradisia is a group of cyborgs that contain the multi-flux

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E23 - Lost Illusions
3.plot: Aarch resigns as the coach of The Snow Kids so he can spend his time with Adium. Rocket moves from being a player to being the new coach of the Snow Kids. The second semifinal takes place between Team Paradisia and the Elektras.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E24 - The Second Chance
3.plot: Maya informs Sinedd his parents are still alive and that he has a little sister. She gets him to agree to meet with them. Magnus shows up to meet Harris thinking Harris will be there with a hologram. Sinedd rejoins the Snow Kids.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E25 - On All Fronts
3.plot: Aarch and Norata trace the bomb on Achillian to Arcadia, more specifically to Aarch's academy. The match between the Snow Kids and Team Paradisia begins, Aarch and Norata find the multi-flux bomb in the basement of his academy.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E26 - The Stars of Akillian Are Eternal
3.plot: D'Jok score for 1:1 and then Sinedd scores and Snow Kids win the cup 2:1 vs Team Paradisia. Pirates eliminates Harris's cat while then eliminates Harris and Vega who are knocked out into space. The Snow Kids win the cup 3 times in a row.

meta.plot: Cette série met en scène l'histoire d'une jeune équipe de football futuriste, les Snow Kids, qui va essayer de gagner la Galactik Football Cup pour leur planète Akillian, après s'être faite recruter par une ancienne légende du football. Mais pour ce faire, ils devront faire face à de nombreuses équipes bien plus aguerries que la leur comme les Shadows, les Lightnings ou les Wambas, et devront s'imposer comme la meilleure équipe. On suit alors leurs débuts de joueurs, de l'anonymat à la célébrité et leur évolution aussi bien dans le football que dans leur vie privée.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Prisoner Aaron Wallace becomes a lawyer, litigating cases for other inmates while fighting to overturn his own wrongful conviction.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E02 - Promises
1.plot: Tensions rise between Aaron and his crew when he provides counsel to a white supremacist in order to repay his debt to inmate Wild Bill. District Attorney Maskins ups his game when Aaron sues the NYPD in an attempt to gain access to his case file. Meanwhile, his daughter’s boyfriend, Ronnie, braces for confrontation as he visits the prison to meet Aaron for the first time.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E03 - Brother's Keeper
1.plot: Determined to gain access to his police file, Aaron decides to represent an inmate from Safiya’s drug rehabilitation program whose brother is a cop. District Attorney Maskins and Assistant District Attorney O’Reilly close in on proof of Aaron’s malfeasance during Jose Rodriguez’s trial, targeting Marie as a way to get to Aaron.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E04 - Marie
1.plot: Taking us back nine years, Marie struggles in her marriage to Aaron as she deals with the turbulence of Aaron’s arrest, trial and incarceration.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E05 - Witness
1.plot: While litigating on behalf of an inmate locked up on a robbery charge, Aaron is torn between doing what's right and what's best for his case. Heartened by Aaron's new lead, Marie recommits to his case, researching witnesses on Aaron's behalf. Plus, Safiya closes in on Foster's drug smuggling scheme.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E06 - Burner
1.plot: Aaron confronts O'Reilly in court, targeting the search warrant used in Aaron's arrest and the DA's failure to disclose a confidential informant. Marie's father comes to town, intent on encouraging her and Darius to solidify their relationship. Maskins arranges for a dangerous inmate, Cassius Dawkins, to be transferred to Bellmore in hopes that he'll cause problems for Safiya and Aaron.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E07 - Do Us Part
1.plot: Aaron struggles to balance the demands of his own case with the needs of an inmate who's fighting for the right to marry his dying girlfriend. Safiya defies the prison board, effectively jeopardizing Anya's campaign as well as their marriage.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E08 - Daylight
1.plot: In order to maintain his lifeline to the outside world, Aaron is forced to defend Cassius Dawkins when he puts three white supremacists in the hospital; Marie struggles with her feelings for Aaron after he signs her divorce papers.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E09 - Buried
1.plot: Aaron pushes to represent longtime inmate Easley Barton, hoping that winning this 23-year-old case against Maskins will strengthen his own. Captain Foster continues his drug-smuggling racket as Safiya closes in. Marie struggles with her breakup with Darius as she continues to help Aaron in his case.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E10 - Character and Fitness
1.plot: Flashing back to the previous nine years of his incarceration, Aaron's journey from terrified novice prisoner to attorney and social crusader unfolds.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E11 - Switzerland
1.plot: Aaron bolsters his case with newfound information from Marie; Cassius suspects Aaron is a snitch and seeks retribution; Foster struggles to lay low during his last two weeks before retirement, but Safiya turns up the heat.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E12 - Closing Statement
1.plot: Aaron finally gets his chance to argue for his retrial in court, but it's thwarted by the return of prison warden Cyrus Hunt; Safiya deals with the aftermath of the prison riot and attempts to salvage her reforms.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E13 - Fathers
1.plot: When Maskins and Cyrus Hunt try to thwart Aaron's attempt at a retrial, Aaron is forced to attempt a desperate move, risking the wrath of a powerful new adversary. The election comes to a head as Safiya tries to warn Aaron that he is now a marked man on the season finale

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E01 - Never Stop Fighting
2.plot: After nine years of fighting to win his freedom, it’s do or die for Aaron Wallace. As dangerous enemies lurk at Bellmore and Marie faces criminal charges for assisting Aaron in prior cases, Aaron must find a way to gain the upper hand on Maskins.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E02 - Homecoming
2.plot: A newly liberated man, Aaron acclimates to family life outside of prison. As he attempts to help Jamal with his case, Aaron encounters Jamal’s sister who needs legal help of her own. Former nemesis Spencer Richardson proposes an intriguing work opportunity to Aaron and Roswell.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E03 - The Necessity Defense
2.plot: At the urging of Spencer Richardson, Aaron defends a woman charged with holding hospital workers at gunpoint to secure lifesaving treatment for her son. Aaron and Marie navigate their newly intimate relationship, and a young social justice warrior joins Aaron and Roswell’s firm.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E04 - Time to Move Forward
2.plot: As a favor to Jamal, Aaron defends a man in a witness tampering case, while tensions rise at home in the run-up to the Wallace family Thanksgiving.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E05 - Collars for Dollars
2.plot: After Aaron and Roswell agree to help a young woman facing deportation for a minor crime, they realize her case could be a key to exposing a broad pattern of police corruption. Meanwhile, Jasmine begins to spend more time at Ronnie's house and Marie grapples with the first signs of an empty nest.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E06 - 354
2.plot: After an urgent call from Bellmore concerning the growing COVID-19 pandemic, Aaron enlists Safiya’s help and heads back to the prison to investigate. Meanwhile Marie faces a choice: Expose her family to the virus or go all-in at the hospital.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E07 - Say His Name
2.plot: Aaron takes on the case of an unarmed man shot by a police officer. Safiya represents Ronnie after he’s arrested and roughed up by law enforcement, and the family struggles with whether to have Aaron Jr. baptized.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E08 - For the People
2.plot: Aaron faces pressure from all sides when he is forced to decide which charges to bring against the officers responsible for the killing of an unarmed civilian. While Safiya pursues video evidence that could change their case, Roswell searches for a way to move the case from Staten Island to a friendlier venue.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E09 - The Blue Wall
2.plot: With Aaron and Marie facing threats from an increasingly hostile community, Aaron and his team double down by pursuing criminal charges against a high-ranking police officer they believe tried to cover up the shooting.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E10 - Andy Josiah
2.plot: Aaron and his legal team face their toughest trial yet as they prosecute the police officer responsible for the killing of an innocent, unarmed Black man.

meta.plot: Accusé à tort de meurtre et envoyé en prison à vie, Aaron devient avocat depuis sa cellule et se sert de sa nouvelle occupation pour aider ses compagnons, mais aussi pour prouver son innocence. Sa quête de liberté est motivée par son désir de retrouver sa famille et de récupérer la vie qui lui a été arrachée. Injustement condamné, le détenu va devoir se heurter aux limites du système judiciaire.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E01 - Movie Night
1.plot: The boys try to figure out why Dad can't stay awake during movie night.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E02 - Viral
1.plot: The boys convince Dad to try and go viral during his weather report.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E03 - Bomber Jacket
1.plot: Preston loses his beloved World War II bomber jacket.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E04 - Plane
1.plot: Dad confronts his fear of flying on the way to Mexico.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E05 - Duncan Holds a Baby
1.plot: Duncan struggles to hide his fear of holding babies.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E06 - Dad's Birthday
1.plot: Dad's old friends are in town for his birthday, and they have quite the stories to tell.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E07 - Hot Tub
1.plot: The boys beg Dad to let them get a hot tub.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E08 - Call to the Battalion
1.plot: The boys try to set Dad up on a date to find love.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E09 - Therapy
1.plot: The boys get a cool new therapist.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E10 - Improv
1.plot: Tristan gets immersed in a new hobby.

meta.plot: À la suite du décès de leur mère, trois frères et leur père dévoué affrontent ensemble toutes sortes d’aventures qui consolident leur relation.

1.title: FR - Ludwig - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Puzzle setter John ‘Ludwig’ Taylor’s life is upended when his identical twin, DCI James Taylor, disappears. John reluctantly assumes his identity in order to track him down.

1.title: FR - Ludwig - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: On a mission to crack the code in his twin’s notebook, John returns to the police station. A frustrated Lucy takes matters into her own hands and plays detective herself.

1.title: FR - Ludwig - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: A new case takes Ludwig on a walking tour of Cambridge, where he’s faced with an impossible question. Meanwhile, Lucy goes undercover and makes a grim discovery of her own.

1.title: FR - Ludwig - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A body falls from the fourth storey of a construction site. Was it just a terrible accident, or a perfectly executed murder? When things don’t add up, John questions his abilities.

1.title: FR - Ludwig - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: John and the gang go back to school to investigate the suspicious death of a headmaster. Lucy sneaks off on a covert mission, and a shocking revelation leaves John reeling.

1.title: FR - Ludwig - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A cryptic late night call from Holly sees Lucy lured into danger. Back at the station, all eyes are on John as the pressure ramps up. Will his cover finally be blown?

meta.plot: John Taylor mène une vie paisible et solitaire en concevant des puzzles sous le nom de « Ludwig ». Lorsque son frère jumeau, James, disparaît sans laisser de traces, John endosse l'identité de son frère pour tenter de le retrouver.

Tout se passe à l'âge de la pierre dans une ville appelée Saint-Granit (Bedrock), mais où la société est exactement la même que celle des États-Unis dans la deuxième moitié du XXe siècle. C’est une version fantaisiste de la préhistoire où des dinosaures, des ptérodactyles, des tigres à dents de sabre, des mammouths laineux et d'autres animaux disparus depuis longtemps coexistent avec des hommes des cavernes, qui emploient une technologie équivalente à celle du XXe siècle en se servant surtout de divers animaux comme outils.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E01 - The Flintstone Flyer
1.plot: Fred fakes illness so he and Barney can get out of taking their wives to the opera.  Using prehistoric helicopter as a means of escape, the two of them join their bowling team for a night of fun.  They almost get away with their scheme, until loose-lipped Barney gives away their night's activities.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E02 - Hot Lips Hannigan
1.plot: Believing he has made Wilma and Betty disappear through magic, Fred capitalizes on his newfound freedom by taking Barney to a nightclub, the Rockland, where an old friend, trumpeter Hot Lips Hannigan, is performing.  The jazz is cool until the wives show up to teach their wayward husbands a lesson.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E03 - The Swimming Pool
1.plot: Fred and Barney jointly build a swimming pool, but Barney hogs the pool time, angering Fred.  To get even, Fred hires a pal to pose as a police officer and break up one of his neighbor's pool parties.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E04 - No Help Wanted
1.plot: Fred uses his influence with a business friend to obtain a job for Barney, who becomes a furniture repossessor.  To the dismay of both, Barney's first assignment is to repossess Fred's television!  Unwilling to betray his friend, Barney pays off Fred's delinquent television bill with his first paycheck.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E05 - The Split Personality
1.plot: A conk on the head turns Fred into an aristocratic sophisticate, whose behavior manages to disrupt the entire city of Bedrock.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E06 - The Monster from the Tar Pits
1.plot: A Hollyrock film company goes on location in Bedrock to film its new feature Monster From The Tar Pits, and gullible Fred is enlisted as stand-in for star Gary Granite.  But Fred's real problems begin when Wilma and Betty audition for roles in the film and end up going ga-ga upon meeting movie stars Rock Pile and Wednesday Tuesday.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E07 - The Babysitters
1.plot: Roped into babysitting little Egbert, the child of a friend, Fred and Barney take the tot over to the pal Joe Rockhead's house to watch the fights on television.  Egbert befriends Joe's pet runtosaurus and dresses the creature up in his baby clothes, which results in chaos when the pet--whom Fred and Barney mistake for the baby--escapes from the house and dashes up a tree.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E08 - At the Races
1.plot: To finance their dream of opening a pool hall, Fred and Barney visit the dinosaur racetrack where Fred bets his entire paycheck on a long shot.  He tells Wilma that he has lost his check.  When the long shot pays off, Fred and Barney are initially elated, but they quickly realize their problems are only beginning.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E09 - The Engagement Ring
1.plot: Barney decides to surprise Betty with a belated engagement ring, which he gives to Fred for safekeeping.  But Wilma discovers the ring and assumes it is a gift for her.  Not wanting to shatter her illusions, Fred decides to buy a second ring, but doesn't have the cash.  He cons Barney into going several rounds with a boxing champ in order to win a $500 prize.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E10 - Hollyrock, Here I Come
1.plot: Wilma and Betty win a trip to Hollyrock from a television contest.  Finding themselves lonely and bored, Fred and Barney take vacations from work and follow them out.  When Wilma is ""discovered,"" Fred muscles his own way into the world of television to bring her back.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E11 - The Golf Champion
1.plot: Fred's victory in The Loyal Order of Dinosaurs golf tournament is soured when club president Barney withholds his trophy for nonpayment of club dues.  Fred retaliates by demanding that Barney return every item he has borrowed over the years.  The stalemate continues until Wilma and Betty manage to bring their husbands back together.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E12 - The Sweepstakes Ticket
1.plot: Barney hides the sweepstakes ticket he and Fred have bought in the lining of an old coat, which Betty subsequently gives to a passing hobo.  While the boys try to recover the ticket, convinced it is the winning one, Wilma and Betty have their own winning ticket stashed away at the Rubble's house.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E13 - The Drive-in
1.plot: Fed up with their jobs, Fred and Barney secretly plan to buy a restaurant, but then Fred has to deal with a suspicious Wilma who wants to know why two young girls (carhops who are seeking a job) are calling for him, and what the messages regarding two tons of dino-burger meat mean.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E14 - The Prowler
1.plot: With a burglar on the loose in Bedrock, Betty decides to take judo lessons to protect herself.  When Wilma wants to take lesson also, Fred ridicules the idea, arguing that one glimpse of a burglar would send her running in fear.  To prove his point, Fred poses as the burglar and sneaks into the Rubble household, on the same night the real criminal shows up.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E15 - The Girls' Night Out
1.plot: Fred and Barney decide to treat their wives to a night out, at an amusement park.  Fred cuts a song at a recording booth as a souvenir but misplaces the record.  It is later discovered by a group of teens who pass it along to a deejay, and Fred is suddenly transformed into unwitting rock star ""Hi-Fye.""

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E16 - Arthur Quarry's Dance Class
1.plot: Fred and Barney sign up for dance lessons at Arthur Quarry's so that they do not humiliate themselves at the charity ball.  Their excuse that they have joined the volunteer fire department falls apart when Betty and Wilma realize that the all-stone town of Bedrock is fire proof.  The wives then suspect that their husbands are slipping out to meet other women.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E17 - The Big Bank Robbery
1.plot: When he discovers a bag containing $86,000, Fred's dreams of being a wealthy man finally seem to be coming true.  But the money has been stolen from the bank, so Wilma and Betty force Fred and Barney to return the money to the bank, and unwittingly set them up as the primary suspects!  The wives set a trap for the real culprits and Fred ends up saving the day.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E18 - The Snorkasaurus Hunter
1.plot: Would-be hunter Fred convinces Wilma and the Rubbles to spend their vacation time in the mountains, hunting for snorkasaurus.  Fred is successful in his hunt, but he gets more than he bargained for when the wives insist that the snorkasaurus be taken home as their new pet, Dino.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E19 - The Hot Piano
1.plot: To commemorate his tenth wedding anniversary (which he only remembers because it falls on ""Trash Day""), Fred wants to buy Wilma a Stoneway piano.  He finds a hot deal--ultimately too hot--from a shady, cash-only businessman named 88 Fingers Louie.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E20 - The Hypnotist
1.plot: While attempting to demonstrate his skill as a hypnotist to his wife and the Rubbles, Fred manages to hypnotize Barney into thinking that he is a frisky puppy, and is then unable to bring him back.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E21 - Love Letters on the Rocks
1.plot: Jealous Fred's discovery of a love poem that was sent to Wilma prompts him to hire Bedrock's top detective Perry Gunite, to find out who the home-wrecking poet is.  Gunite's investigation mistakenly points to Barney.  Fred plans revenge against his friend until Wilma reminds her husband that he had written the poem himself years earlier during their courtship.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E22 - The Tycoon
1.plot: When industrial tycoon J.L. Gotrocks decides he wants to rub shoulders with the common people, dead-ringer Fred is hired to fill in for him in the board room.  Fred savors his new lifestyle at the country club, but the plan begins to unravel when J.L. demonstrates little tolerance for the common folk.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E23 - The Astra' Nuts
1.plot: Thinking they are undergoing an examination for a physical contest, Fred and Barney mistakenly sign up for a three-year stint in the Army!  After a tearful goodbye to their wives they enter into the service, where they quickly blunder their way into volunteering for the first lunar landing mission.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E24 - The Long, Long Weekend
1.plot: Friend Gus Gravel invites the Flintstones and the Rubbles to his seaside hotel for an all-expense-paid vacation.  But upon arriving, the four find that the hotel's planned ""activities"" seem more like work.  Gus finally confesses that his entire hotel staff has just resigned on the eve of a huge convention.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E25 - In the Dough
1.plot: Wilma and Betty are finalists in a television bake-off, but on the eve of the event, they contract measles.  Donning wigs and dresses, Fred and Barney take their places in the contest.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E26 - The Good Scout
1.plot: Assuming the command of a Boy Scout troop, Fred quickly learns the hazards of a ""routine"" camping trip.  Fred blunders his way through until an overnight flood leaves him and the troop hanging on a tree limb over a treacherous waterfall, hoping a ranger will rescue them.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E27 - Rooms for Rent
1.plot: Tired of hearing their husbands complain about finances, Wilma and Betty rent rooms to piano and bongo-playing student musicians.  Fred and Barney go along with the arrangement, unaware that their wives are providing the lodging in return for music and dancing lessons.

1.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S01E28 - Fred Flintstone: Before and After
1.plot: Fred agrees to appear in a before-and-after weight reduction commercial, but is humiliated to learn that he is the before example.  An offer of $1,000 if he can drop twenty-five pounds in a month fails miserably, as does every other diet plan, until an overeaters group takes him on as a challenge.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E01 - The Hit Song Writers
2.plot: After discovering that Barney is a closet poet, Fred manages to link him up with songwriter Hoagy Carmichael and the three set out to write a hit song.  The resultant tune garners the boys a moment of fame as songwriters.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E02 - Droop Along Flintstone
2.plot: The Flintstones and the Rubbles take up Fred's rich cousins, Tumbleweed and Mary Lou Jim, on their offer to take care of their ranch while they go on an ocean cruise.  Having gotten lost on the ranch, Fred and Barney stumble onto a nearby film location, where they are chased by cowboys and Indians.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E03 - The Missing Bus
2.plot: Receiving a pay cut after thirteen years at the quarry, Fred decides to quit and become a bus driver.  With Barney as co-pilot, Fred delivers fifty kids to school, a nerve-shattering experience.  Not wanting to let the job get the better of him, he dutifully picks them up again but mis-delivers them home.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E04 - Alvin Brickrock Presents
2.plot: When his neighbors' domestic fights suddenly end with the disappearance of the wife, Fred suspects Alvin Brickrock of foul play.  After reading a detective magazine, he becomes convinced that Brickrock is really Albert Bonehart, wife-murderer.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E05 - Fred Flintstone Woos Again
2.plot: Needled by Wilma about his lack of romanticism, Fred takes his wife on a second honeymoon to Rock Mountain Inn, accompanied by the Rubbles.  When the Flintstones learn that the official, Judge Wedrock, who married them was never licensed, Wilma takes advantage of the situation by making Fred court her all over again.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E06 - The Rock Quarry Story
2.plot: Movie star Rock Quarry has had enough of Hollyrock, and decides to move to Bedrock, where he is stalked by star-struck Wilma and Betty for an autograph.  Meanwhile, Fred has an auto collision with the actor and invites him home to dinner, where he is recognized by Wilma despite his insistence that he is not Rock Quarry.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E08 - Flintstone of Prinstone
2.plot: Determined to rise above manual labor, Fred attends night class at Prinstone University and is drafted as a quarterback on the varsity team.  But during the big game against Shale U., and exhausted Fred creates problems when he confuses his football signals with his accounting course figures.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E10 - Social Climbers
2.plot: Wilma and Betty wrangle tickets to the upper-crust Ambassador's Reception and convince their husbands to go with them, sending Fred and Barney to charm school to prepare for the event.  But the middle-class foursome ultimately discover that trying to play ""stuffy"" is no fun.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E11 - The Beauty Contest
2.plot: Fred and Barney are appointed judges for the Loyal Order of Water Buffalo's beauty contest.  But complicating matters are Wilma's and Betty's suspicions, pressure from Mr. Slate, whose daughter is the competition, and threats from a racketeer who wants his girlfriend to be named Miss Water Buffalo.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E12 - The Masquerade Ball
2.plot: Fred buys tickets to a society costume ball from his supervisor, Mr. Rockhead.  Fred's plan to use this opportunity to butter up his costumed boss backfires when Rockhead switches costumes, and instead of being the recipient of Fred's honey, he becomes an unwitting confidant in his scheme.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E13 - The Picnic
2.plot: Coveting the trophy collection of Lodge brother Joe Rockhead, Fred realizes that dumping Barney as his partner will improve his chances of winning during the annual field day games.  This plan causes resentment from both Barney and Rockhead.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E14 - The House Guest
2.plot: While plumbers at the Rubble home try to unfix Fred's attempted repair job, Betty and Barney move in temporarily with the Flintstones.  The wives are convinced the forced togetherness will cause problems between Fred and Barney and they are right, although the husbands go to extreme measures to try to hide their bickering.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E15 - The X-Ray Story
2.plot: Ailing Dino is taken to the vet, who diagnoses him as having a ""dinopeptic germ,"" which is common to dinosaurs but lethal in humans.  But when Dino's x-rays are mistaken as Fred's, Wilma is alerted and told to prepare the only known cure: keeping the patient awake for seventy-two hours, without telling him why.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E16 - The Gambler
2.plot: A compulsive gambler in his younger days, Fred has been cured through psychiatric consultation--until paperboy Arnold tempts him with a bet.  When the Flintstones' furniture begins to mysteriously disappear, Barney is dispatched to investigate Fred's marble games behind locked doors.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E17 - A Star is Almost Born
2.plot: While shopping in a Bedrock drugstore with Betty, Wilma is discovered by a famous television producer.  As a result, Fred borrows money from Barney to pay for acting lessons a quits his job in order to manage his wife's career.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E18 - The Entertainer
2.plot: Fred works overtime to earn extra money for a surprise gift for Wilma, and is ultimately tapped by Mr. Slate to entertain an important female client at the Copa Cave night club.  Unfortunately, the Rubbles and Wilma show up at the club that same night.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E19 - Wilma's Vanishing Money
2.plot: While searching for a hairpin to fix the toaster, Fred finds a secret stash of cash that has been hidden by Wilma.  To teach her a lesson, he uses the money to buy a new bowling ball, unaware that Wilma has been saving up to buy him the same ball as a birthday present.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E20 - Feudin' and Fussin'
2.plot: While Fred is napping away his pre-golf tournament tensions, Barney interrupts his pal's dreams with a practice shot.  Temperamental Fred explodes at Barney, which results in the Flintstones almost finding themselves without neighbors, when the Rubbles put their house up for sale.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E21 - Impractical Joker
2.plot: Fed up with Fred's practical jokes, Barney decides to give him a taste of his own medicine.  Barney sets up the gag with a stack of five, crisp $100 bills, his prize from the Sudsy-Wudsy jingle contest.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E22 - Operation Barney
2.plot: While driving to work, the boys decide to play hookey and go instead to the ballpark.  They call in sick to their bosses and Barney is promptly ordered to report to the company nurse for a check-up.  Fred then concocts an elaborate ruse that does indeed get Barney out of work--and into the hospital.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E23 - The Happy Household
2.plot: After a squabble about finances, Wilma seeks employment of her own.  She applies for an office job at the Bedrock Radio & Television Corporation, but instead becomes the hostess of the ""Happy Housewife Show,"" a situation that makes things less than happy back at the cave.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E24 - Fred Strikes Out
2.plot: Once more, Fred forgets the anniversary of the night he proposed to Wilma.  After being chastised by Wilma, he agrees to take her on a date to the movies, but she wants to go on the same night he is supposed to be captaining his bowling team in the bowling alley, Fred tries to do both.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E25 - This is Your Lifesaver
2.plot: Fred and Barney encounter the penniless J. Montague Gypsum, who is threatening to jump from a bridge.  Fred takes the man home and learns too late how responsible he is for the life he saved.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E26 - Trouble-In-Law
2.plot: Having sold her home, Fred's antagonistic mother-in-law arrives at the Flintstone cave, and Fred tries to play cupid after meeting a rich Texan who is looking for an elderly wife.  He invites the man home for dinner, but Wilma becomes suspicious of the would-be suitor.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E27 - The Mailman Cometh
2.plot: Fuming that he is the only employee of the quarry not to received a raise in the mail, Fred writes a blistering letter to his boss, Mr. Slate, then Wilma frantically tries to retrieve it after Mr. Slate apologizes for the oversight.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E28 - The Rock Vegas Story
2.plot: Fred and Barney run into old friend Sherman Cobblehead, owner of The Golden Cactus Hotel in Rock Vegas, at an eatery.  Cobblehead's casual promise to ""take care of"" Fred should he ever come to Vegas is misinterpreted as a guarantee that Fred will be a big winner in the casino.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E29 - Divided We Sail
2.plot: Fred receives a ticket to a television game show that offers big prizes, but succumbs to stage fright before the show.  Barney subs for him and wins a house boat, which Fred then tries to claim as his.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E30 - Kleptomaniac Caper
FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E31 - Latin Lover
2.plot: Impressed by actor Roberto Rocketing, Wilma tries to turn Fred into a reasonable facsimile, and is surprisingly successful--ultimately a little too successful, as the dashing, mustachioed Fred now causes women to swoon in his arms.

2.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S02E32 - Take Me Out to the Ball Game
2.plot: Fred is chosen by PeeWee League players (including Arnold and Mr. Slate's son) to umpire a playoff game.  His troubles mount when he must call the game honestly despite the pressures from friends, employers, and big league baseball scouts, who are observing Fred in action.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E01 - Dino Goes Hollyrock
3.plot: Hearing  about a talent search for a new animal star to appear in ""The Adventures of Sassie,"" Fred coaches Dino and prepares for an audition.  But Dino gets more than he bargained for when he lands the part.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E02 - Fred's New Boss
3.plot: When Barney loses his job, Fred approaches Mr. Slate about hiring his friend for the quarry.  He is mortified, however, when Barney lands the position of vice president, and becomes Fred's boss!

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E03 - Barney the Invisible
3.plot: In an attempt to cure Barney's hiccups, Fred offers his friend a swig from an experimental soft drink he has formulated.  The brew turns Barney invisible, and Fred's elaborate attempts to hide the fact make Wilma wonder about her husband's sanity.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E04 - Bowling Ballet
3.plot: Fred discovers he is off his game right before the big bowling match.  After hearing in a television commercial that rhythm is ""the secret of success in many activities, including bowling,"" he rushes off to the Bedrock Dance Academy to sign up for ballet lessons.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E05 - The Twitch
3.plot: Wilma is in dither over finding an act for her auxiliary's benefit show until big mouth Fred boasts that he will line up singer Rock Roll, whose hit song is ""The Twitch.""  Now committed, Fred has to pull out all the stops to obtain the rock star's participation.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E07 - The Buffalo Convention
3.plot: The talking dodo bird that Fred gives Wilma for her birthday turns snitch, informing her that Fred and Barney are plotting to sneak away for a Water Buffalo Convention in Frantic City.  Wilma, Betty, and the wives of Bedrock plan a surprise of their own at the convention.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E08 - The Little Stranger
3.plot: Fred overhears Wilma on the phone mentioning ""a little stranger"" who will shortly be visiting the household.  Assuming that Wilma is pregnant, Fred summon his dreaded mother-in-law.  But the ""little stranger"" turns out to be Arnold the paperboy.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E09 - Baby Barney
3.plot: With his eye on an inheritance, Fred tells his rich Uncle Tex that he has named his child after him.  Fred, of course, has no son, which means that he has to find a baby now that Uncle Tex is coming to visit!  Unable to borrow a real baby, desperate Fred cons Barney into playing ""Baby Tex.""

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E10 - Hawaiian Escapade
3.plot: Wilma and Betty enter a television contest and win first prize, a trip for two to Rockiki Beach and a role on the television show ""Hawaiian Spy.""  The two families journey to Hawaii, where Fred ends up working as a stunt man on the show.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E11 - Ladies' Day
3.plot: Barney and Fred skip work to go to the ball park, but Barney only has one ticket.  The situation gets complicated when Fred dresses up as a women so he can get in free for Ladies' day.  After Betty finds lipstick on Barney's handkerchief, the wives are in hot pursuit.  Adding to Fred's problems is the fact that Mr. Slate is entertaining a client at the game.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E12 - Nuttin' But the Tooth
3.plot: Barney's loud suffering from a toothache has been keeping the entire neighborhood awake at night, so Fred promises to take him to the dentist the next morning.  But having already spent the money for the dentist, Fred has to find a low-cost way to remove his friend's tooth.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E13 - High School Fred
3.plot: An efficiency expert hired by Mr. Slate informs Fred that he will be fired unless he gets a high school diploma.  Slate offers to send Fred to school, and Wilma mistakenly assumes that Fred is being groomed for an executive position.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E14 - Dial S for Suspicion
3.plot: A series of strange accidents coupled with Wilma's sudden insistence on having Fred take out a life insurance policy, and her devotion to a murder mystery novel about a wife who bumps off her husband, causes Fred to wonder if his life is in danger.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E15 - Flash Gun Freddie
3.plot: Fred convinces Barney to buy an instant Polarock camera and the two go into the photo business.  When they mistakenly snap the pictures of two escaping bank robbers, they are able to sell the photos and recoup Barney's money.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E17 - Wilma, the Maid
3.plot: At Wilma's insistence, Fred hires an Italian maid, Gina Lolabrickida, to do the cooking and cleaning, but problems arise when she quits on the night Wilma has promised her to Betty, and Fred brings home Mr. Slate for an authentic Italian dinner.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E18 - The Hero
FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E19 - The Surprise
3.plot: The appearance of Barney's nephew, baby Marblehead,  causes a rift between him and Fred.  Fred just can't understand Barney's devotion to the visiting baby, but his attitude changes when Wilma informs him that they are going to have a baby of their own.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E20 - Mother-In-Law's Visit
3.plot: With fatherhood impending, Fred promises to become more kind, considerate, and thoughtful.  His willingness to change is strechted practically beyond endurance when his mother-in-law shows up to help Wilma during her pregnancy.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E21 - Foxy Grandma
3.plot: Fred's inept efforts at housework during Wilma's pregnancy are worse than no efforts at all, so he sets out to hire a housekeeper, ultimately bringing home a bank robber named Grandma Dynamite, who is in need of a hideout.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E22 - Fred's New Job
3.plot: With the baby coming, Fred asks Mr. Slate for a raise.  Slate, however, is tired of such demands from expectant fathers, so he plans to head Fred off with ""Operation Cringe.""

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E23 - The Blessed Event
3.plot: Wilma is still pregnant and Fred is trying to be calm. This shatters when the docter tells him the blessed event could happen any day now.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E24 - Carry On, Nurse Fred
3.plot: Fatherhood has already made Fred resolute in his effort to acquire serenity, but his will power is put to the test by the formidable Nurse Frightenshale, who is sent by Wilma's mother to take care of the Flintstones' cave.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E25 - Ventriloquist Barney
3.plot: Barney learns how to throw his voice and can't resist having some fun at Fred's expense.  He leads Fred to believe that his newborn daughter Pebbles has miraculously learned to talk.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E26 - The Big Move
3.plot: Having worked to clean up his own act, Fred now worries that Pebbles will pick up Barney's uncouth ways.  Fred moves the family to a ""better"" neighborhood, but quickly realizes that the ""high life"" isn't what it seems.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E27 - Swedish Visitors
3.plot: After using the family's vacation money to buy a fur wrap, Wilma devises a scheme to repay the money by renting their home to Swedish musicians.

3.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S03E28 - The Birthday Party
3.plot: While preparing a surprise birthday party for Fred, Wilma assigns to Barney the task of keeping Fred out of the way and occupied, and Barney is so successful that both he and Fred are missing at party time.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E01 - Ann-Margrock Presents
4.plot: Fred and Barney learn that local talent is being sought for the Bedrock Bowl's premiere event, a television special starring Ann-Margrock (voiced by Ann-Margret).  The boys go home and prepare for an audition, and are aided by Ann-Margrock herself (whom they fail to recognize), who comes in to the Flintstones' home to use the phone after her car breaks down.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E02 - Groom Gloom
4.plot: Frustrated that paperboy (and part-time babysitter) Arnold always beats him at table-tennis, Fred has a nightmare in which an older Arnold elopes with his grown-up daughter Pebbles.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E03 - Little Bamm-Bamm
4.plot: Betty and Barney discover a foundling named Bamm-Bamm on their doorstep and become smitten with the child.  They set out to adopt him, but discover that the Welfare Bureau has promised the boy to wealthy Pronto Berger, who is being represented by attorney Perry Masonry.  When Berger learns that his wife is pregnant, however, the Rubbles are free to adopt the baby.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E04 - Dino Disappears
4.plot: Upset that Fred has forgotten the anniversary of his joining the household, Dino runs away in a sulk.  The next morning Fred and Barney seach for him, bringing home a look-alike pet that they assume to be Dino.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E06 - The Flintstone Canaries
4.plot: Fred forms a barbershop quartet to compete on the ""Hum Along With Herman"" television show, and in the process discovers that Barney is a natural lead tenor.  The catch is that Barney can sing only when he's in the bathtub.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E07 - Glue for Two
4.plot: Fred's formula for a new soft drink, which he hopes will make him rich, instead acts as a kind of glue.  Not only does Fred get stuck to Barney, but both of them become affixed to Barney's bowling ball.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E08 - Big League Freddie
4.plot: When Fred's performance for the Bedrock Quarry baseball team flounders, he is replaced by Roger who attracts the attention of Big League scouts, but since he is wearing Fred's uniform, the scouts try to sign up Fred.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E09 - Old Lady Betty
4.plot: To earn enough money to buy Barney a surprise gift, Betty answers an ad for a job which specifies an elderly lady.  Disguising herself, Betty gets the job, but discovers that her employers are counterfeiters.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E10 - Sleep On, Sweet Fred
4.plot: Betty and Wilma employ a ""sleep-teaching"" method to try and turn Fred and Barney into perfect spouses.  The plan goes awry, and the foursome are ultimately arrested as thieves.  After pleading their cases in court, the wives are sentenced by the judge to twenty days of serving their ""victimized spouses"" breakfast in bed.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E11 - Kleptomaniac Pebbles
4.plot: In a jewelry store to buy a birthday gift for Wilma, Fred and Pebbles unknowingly encounter jewel thief Baffles Gravel, who plants a priceless diamond bracelet on Pebbles.  After finding the hot ice, Fred and Wilma try to get it back to the store before Pebbles ""crime"" is discovered.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E12 - Daddy's Little Beauty
4.plot: Fred misconstrues an overheard conversation and enters Pebbles in a beauty contest, only to find out that the contest is for somewhat older ""babes"" instead of ""babies.""  Overcoming the resistance of the contest coordinator, Fred enters Pebbles anyway, with surprising results.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E13 - Daddies Anonymous
4.plot: Fred and Barney join an exclusive ""fathers club,"" which offers hen-pecked husbands the chance to play poker under the guise of taking their children for afternoon walks.  Fred has to do some fancy switching, though, when he rushes home one day with the wrong infant.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E14 - Peek-a-Boo Camera
4.plot: Attending a premarital bachelor party for a Lodge buddy, rowdy Fred and Barney start dancing with the chorus girls in a nightclub, unaware that they are being filmed for television's ""Peek-A-Boo Camera.""  The boys do everything possible to keep their wives from seeing the show when it airs on television, and almost succeed.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E15 - Once Upon a Coward
4.plot: After being robbed without putting up a fight, Fred tries to prove that he is not a coward.  Later, while bowling, he recognizes the voice of the robber and bowls him over, thus restoring his male pride.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E16 - Ten Little Flintstones
4.plot: Chaos reigns supreme when ten androids from another planet--all whom are dead-ringers for Fred--land in Bedrock causing havoc in an attempt to conquer the earth.  When the alien master admits failure and recalls the androids, Fred is left to explain his odd behavior.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E17 - Fred el Terrifico
4.plot: Vacationing in Rockapulco, Fred encounters international jewel thieves who plant a million dollars' worth of stolen diamonds on him to carry across the border.  The deception is detected and Fred is offered a reward, and is subsequently arrested back home for failing to declare the reward money!

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E18 - Bedrock Hillbillies
4.plot: Fred inherits a shack in the hills from his hillbilly relatives, and with it a hundred-year-old feud with the Hatrock clan.  Fred settles the feud by rescuing a Hatrock baby, by then starts it anew by insulting the Hatrock matriarch.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E19 - Flintstone and the Lion
4.plot: Fred befriends a kitten while on a fishing trip and decides to make a house pet of it, not realizing that the tiny kitten will grow up to be a full-sized lion, which begins eating the family out of house and home.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E20 - Cave Scout Jamboree
4.plot: After stumbling upon an international gathering of scouts during a camping trip, Fred and Barney become the hit of the scout encampment, much to the dismay of Wilma and Betty when the boys visit them later in Bedrock.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E21 - Room for Two
4.plot: After building a new room onto the Flintstone home, Fred and Barney start feuding.  Fueling the rift is the fact that Barney cast the deciding vote against Fred for Water Buffalo of the Year, and Barney's discovery that half of Fred's new room is on his property.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E22 - Ladies' Night at the Lodge
4.plot: Disguising themselves to gain entry into the all-male Water Buffalo Lodge meeting, Wilma and Betty argue that wives should be allowed to attend the meetings.  But after going through painful initiation ceremonies as new members, they decide they are better off staying home.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E23 - Reel Trouble
4.plot: Proud papa Fred shows his home movies of Pebbles to everyone, including two criminals who discover that he has captured them on film.  But rather than sit through the films again, the criminals turn themselves in!

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E24 - Son of Rockzilla
4.plot: Thinking he will be discovered, Fred takes a job wearing a monster costume in a publicity stunt for a new horror movie.  He creates the desired effect, frightens the townspeople, and falls into his own monstrous dilemma.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E25 - Bachelor Daze
4.plot: The razing of the Honeyrock Hotel reminds Wilma and Betty of their courtships while working as hotel waitresses, at which time they mistook hellhops Fred and Barney for young millionaires.

4.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S04E26 - Operation Switchover
4.plot: After mocking Wilma's housekeeping efforts, Fred accepts her challenge to swap jobs for one day.  He soon learns that a housewife's labors are tougher than he thought.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E01 - Hop Happy
5.plot: Barney and Betty decide to get Bamm-Bamm a pet of his own, deciding on a stone-age kangaroo.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E02 - Monster Fred
5.plot: Fred has a bowling accident and becomes involved with mad doctors who experiment in personality transference.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E03 - Itty Bitty Fred
5.plot: Fred accidentally shrinks himself when an experiment goes wrong and ends up appearing on television as Barney's ventriloquist dummy.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E04 - Pebbles' Birthday Party
5.plot: Fred plans Pebbles' birthday party on the same day as the Water Buffalo Lodge party.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E05 - Bedrock Rodeo Round-Up
5.plot: Wilma's old friend, Bony Hurdle, pays her a visit because he's participating in the Bedrock rodeo, but Fred gets jealous and decides to compete, too.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E06 - Cinderellastone
5.plot: Fred is angry that he's not invited to his boss' party, but after reading "Cinderella" to Pebbles, he dreams that a fairy godmother takes him to the party after all.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E07 - A Haunted House is Not a Home
5.plot: Fred stands to inherit his Uncle J. Giggles Flintstone's estate under one condition: The family has to spend a night in his relative's eerie mansion staffed by creepy old servants.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E08 - Dr. Sinister
5.plot: Fred and Barney become enmeshed in international spyjinks when they inadvertently become involved with a beautiful foreign agent and the villainous Dr. Sinister, who is intent on world domination.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E09 - The Gruesomes
5.plot: Trying to be neighborly, Fred and Barney offer to babysit for the Gruesome family, who've moved into Tombstone Manor next door with their weird kid and a menagerie of creepy critters.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E10 - The Most Beautiful Baby in Bedrock
5.plot: A baby contest at the lodge sparks a spat between the Flintstones and the Rubbles over who has the most beautiful child in Bedrock, prompting a disappointed Pebbles and Bamm Bamm to run away.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E11 - Dino and Juliet
5.plot: An annoying neighbor makes Fred's life a misery with his interference, so he enlists Dino to protect him, but finds that Dino is in love with the neighbor's dog.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E12 - King for a Night
5.plot: The King of Stoneslyvania goes missing before his country can secure a bank loan, leaving advisors for the King to ask Fred to impersonate him to get the loan.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E13 - Indianrockolis 500
5.plot: To earn money for Pebbles' college fund, Fred adopts the name Goggles Pisanno and drives Barney's home-built sports car in the Indianrockolis 500 race.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E14 - Adobe Dick
5.plot: Fred and Barney have one whale of a tale to tell after they get swallowed by the legendary sea creature Adobe Dick while on a Water Buffalo fishing trip.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E15 - Christmas Flintstone
5.plot: After Fred takes a job as a department-store Santa, he proves so successful that the real Santa asks Fred to stand in for him and deliver presents on Christmas Eve.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E16 - Fred's Flying Lesson
5.plot: Fred has his head in the clouds when he wins free flying lessons in a raffle and contemplates a new career as an airplane pilot.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E17 - Fred's Second Car
5.plot: Fred is in the market for a second car and buys one at a local police auction. But he's unaware that the vehicle contains a fortune in stolen gems and that the jewel thieves who hid them have returned to get them back.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E18 - Time Machine
5.plot: On a visit to the Bedrock World's Fair, the Flintstones and the Rubbles take a ride in a time machine that sends them into the future with stops at ancient Rome and Arthurian England, and encounters with Christopher Columbus and Ben Franklin.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E19 - The Hatrocks and the Gruesomes
5.plot: Fred frets a visit from hillbilly cousins with whom older Flintstone relatives feuded a long time ago, but the stay is a pleasant one until the hosts realize the guests aren't leaving any time soon.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E20 - Moonlight and Maintenance
5.plot: Fed up with doing so many domestic chores, Fred moves his family to the Bedrock Towers, a fully automated complex--where he takes on the nighttime job of "new resident stationary engineer" (aka janitor) to help pay the rent.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E21 - Sheriff for a Day
5.plot: While on a mineral-gathering trip out West, Fred gets appointed sheriff of a ghost town called Rocky Gulch just in time to deal with a rough-and-tumble trio of outlaw brothers who ride into town looking to gun down the local lawman.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E22 - Deep in the Heart of Texarock
5.plot: The Flintstones and the Rubbles lock horns with cowasaurus rustlers who have been preying on Fred's Uncle Tex's ranch in Texarock.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E23 - The Rolls Rock Caper
5.plot: Fred and Barney team with debonair detective Aaron Boulder to solve crimes and mysteries.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E24 - Superstone
5.plot: The gang take the kids to a local theater for a personal appearance by a TV superhero. But when the actor resigns, the producers ask Fred to step in so the show can continue.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E25 - Fred Meets Hercurock
5.plot: Fred lands a role in an action-movie series playing a hunky Greek hero, but he soon discovers that being a film star isn't all it's cracked up to be.

5.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S05E26 - Surfin' Fred
5.plot: During a vacation at the beach, Fred is bitten by the surfing bug and becomes a big kahuna to the young people hanging 10.

6.title: FR - Les Pierrafeu - S06E01 - No Biz Like Show Biz
6.plot: Pebbles and Bamm-Bamm develop remarkable musical talent, which is exploited by teen impresario Eppy Brianstone.
