meta.plot: Trois orphelins élevés par un maître des arts martiaux vivent une violente aventure réunissant pouvoirs démoniaques, cartels, rites et sacrifices sanglants.

Un compte rendu détaillé de l'escroquerie du jeu Monopoly de McDonald's au cours des années 1990, raconté par les participants à l'affaire, y compris les agents du FBI qui ont surpris l'agent de sécurité qui a orchestré l'ensemble du stratagème.

1.title: FR - McMillion$ - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: An anonymous tip to FBI agent Doug Mathews speaks of a con surrounding the much-beloved McDonald's Monopoly game and its mysterious mastermind, a man going by the moniker of “Uncle Jerry.”

1.title: FR - McMillion$ - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Hoping to unmask “Uncle Jerry,” the FBI investigates two prominent figures they believe are connected to the scam; Agent Mathews and McDonald's employee Amy Murray pay a visit to a prior winner, who sweats and mumbles as their cameras roll.

1.title: FR - McMillion$ - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Frank Colombo reveals how “Uncle Jerry” would sell the winning tickets to his brother, Gennaro “Jerry” Colombo, for a premium. The undercover FBI video crew interviews a winner who tries to obscure the origins of her million-dollar game ticket.

1.title: FR - McMillion$ - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Gennaro “Jerry” Colombo lands in the ICU, leading Jerome “Jerry” Jacobson to scout for new recruiters. Dwight Baker and others join the operation. The FBI gathers intel on “Uncle Jerry's” middlemen and ends up tailing Dwight to the airport.

1.title: FR - McMillion$ - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Focusing their attention on Dwight Baker, the FBI intercepts a call with “Uncle Jerry” that leads them to capture evidence of a game piece exchange. The FBI works overtime to launch a coordinated cross-country day of indictments.

1.title: FR - McMillion$ - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the trial nears, any of the defendants take plea deals, but George Chandler and others decide to fight to prove their innocence. When Jerome “Jerry” Jacobson takes the stand, the remaining details of how he pulled off his scheme are disclosed.

meta.plot: Printemps 1936, René Magritte, un jeune artiste, se rend à Londres pour la première exposition internationale sur le surréalisme. Magritte et plusieurs autres jeunes talents prometteurs sont hébergés dans la propriété de West Dean appartenant au richissime mécène, Lord James. Bientôt Margritte se réveille à côté du cadavre de Sheila Legge. Ayant complètement perdu connaissance la nuit précédente, Margritte doit découvrir ce qui s'est passé afin d'innocenter, ou de condamner, son propre nom.

1.title: FR - Ceci n'est pas un crime - S01E01 - The Lovers
1.plot: England, 1936. Young surrealist artists, including René Magritte and Salvador Dalí, gather at the grand West Dean estate for a private exhibition. When a shocking murder occurs, Scotland Yard is called in and the estate is locked down.

1.title: FR - Ceci n'est pas un crime - S01E02 - The Glass Gun
1.plot: A new incident shakes West Dean. As the surrealist artists begin to suspect one another, Scotland Yard's investigation starts to focus on a single guest. Paranoia spreads, secrets unravel, and new facts about Sheila's past come to light.

1.title: FR - Ceci n'est pas un crime - S01E03 - The Lobster Telephone
1.plot: The guests hold a beautiful farewell, while Scotland Yard discovers who will receive a surprising inheritance. Magritte starts his own search for the truth, and new suspects begin to emerge on the estate.

1.title: FR - Ceci n'est pas un crime - S01E04 - The Phantom Lady
1.plot: New guests arrive at West Dean, bringing tension and poor manners. As Quant and Thistlethwaite race to connect dots, a masked figure with a face of roses emerges from the shadows. Suspicion grows. Is it a warning - or something dangerous?

1.title: FR - Ceci n'est pas un crime - S01E05 - The Gift
1.plot: Another disappearance? Tension peaks as the exhibition countdown begins. The estate reopens, the gala begins. Lord James' elite guests Picasso, Guggenheim, Freud arrive, ready to turn surrealism into gold. Champagne, whispers, and a twist.

1.title: FR - Ceci n'est pas un crime - S01E06 - The Survivor
1.plot: It's opening night. The world's most extravagant art lovers gather, ready to turn surrealism into gold. But as the gala begins, the night takes an unexpected turn and secrets are revealed. Will our artists finally become world-famous?

1.title: FR - Electric Bloom - S01E01 - How It Started
1.plot: After being forced to perform together in Battle of the Bands, Posey, Jade, and Tulip come together despite their differences and pull off a performance that’s truly electric.

1.title: FR - Electric Bloom - S01E02 - How It Almost Ended
1.plot: Worried that the band may fall apart because of their differences, Tulip books Electric Bloom for their first gig. The girls ultimately learn their differences make them stronger.

1.title: FR - Electric Bloom - S01E03 - How We Rocked Homecoming
1.plot: Posey worries Shelly Sharp is mad at her after Electric Bloom wins the homecoming performance slot. In the end, Posey learns that not everyone is going to like you and that's okay.

1.title: FR - Electric Bloom - S01E04 - How We Got Crushed
1.plot: The girls' crushes on Lucas Jasper come to a head at the school musical, wreaking havoc on opening night. In the end, they make a pact to never let a boy come between them again.

meta.plot: A Chicago, Marissa Irvine se présente au 14 Arthur Avenue pour récupérer son fils, Milo, censé être avec un camarade de classe de sa nouvelle école. Mais la femme qui lui ouvre la porte n’est ni la mère de l’ami de son fils, ni sa nourrice. Pire, elle ne connaît pas Milo et prétend ne l’avoir jamais vu ! Où est l’enfant et qui est responsable de sa disparition ? Milo demeure introuvable et l’angoisse grandit. Débute alors le cauchemar absolu de tout parent...

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Marissa Irvine arrives to collect her young son Milo from his first playdate, but the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes and doesn't have Milo, beginning every parent's worst nightmare.

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As Detective Alcaras investigates Milo's disappearance, Marissa, with Jenny's help, works hard to raise awareness; a press conference turns ugly when questions are asked about the Irvines' past business dealings

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Alcaras turns his attention to the recent Chicago Marathon, attended by Carrie, the Irvines and a potential new suspect; a canvassing event aims to keep the case alive; Peter takes matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Alcaras struggles to balance work and home life and must make a difficult choice when he's tempted by an offer that goes against his morals; the police struggle to connect the mystery marathon man with Carrie and Milo.

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: News from Alcaras concerning Carrie's hideout throws suspicion on all of the Irvines. Brian uncovers a betrayal from Peter, who accuses Lia of lying. A long-buried family secret threatens to tear the Irvines apart.

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The Irvines struggle to adjust to their new normal, while also recovering from the fallout of their arguments. As Marissa tries to cope with past events, Jenny deals with domestic pressures of her own and uncovers some of Richie's secrets.

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Years after suffering a tragedy, a chance encounter with a young Milo leads Carrie to fixate on the boy. Her obsession takes a dark turn while planning the kidnapping, forcing her to ask for help when things go awry, with deadly consequences.

1.title: FR - All Her Fault [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Reeling from the recent home invasion, Marissa tries to put the pieces together to learn the truth. As Peter comes clean, she must decide how to protect the family. Alcaras hones in on the truth before being forced to make a tough decision.

1.title: FR - Hotel Costiera - S01E01 - Sheryl
1.plot: When the billionaire Aaron Tarsky goes missing while out fishing at sea with his young wife Sheryl, Daniel and his team are called in by his family to figure out what happened. Daniel will realize that the truth is rarely as it seems and solving the case will reveal a hint to another truth he's seeking.

1.title: FR - Hotel Costiera - S01E02 - Richard
1.plot: An old Jewish woman dies while staying at Villa Costiera, and her son Richard flies from New York to take her body back home for proper burial. It’s Daniel and his team’s job to make that happen, arranging the transfer in a race against time. In the meantime, Daniel, in his search for Alice, will start piecing the puzzle together, finding the name of the guy in the picture with her: Bruno.

1.title: FR - Hotel Costiera - S01E03 - April
1.plot: A woman from Daniel’s past shows up in need of his help. It’s April Mackenzie, a fellow Marine who lost a bracelet containing sensitive data. Daniel and his team must find out where the bracelet is and how to get it back before word gets out and April gets in trouble. He will also track down Bruno and confront him with the burning question: where is Alice?

1.title: FR - Hotel Costiera - S01E04 - Hassan
1.plot: A young boy arrives at Villa Costiera in the hotel’s goods van. His name is Hassan, and he is looking for Daniel. Daniel and his team must figure out why while keeping the boy safe. But as he gets answers on one front, he meets a dead end on another. He discovers where Alice is, but once he arrives, he realizes someone got there before him.

1.title: FR - Hotel Costiera - S01E05 - Bruno
1.plot: Alice is now in real trouble, held hostage by a gang of thieves who want to use her to rob a priceless necklace at an auction held at Villa Costiera. Daniel and his team manipulate Bruno to find the villa where the gang is holding Alice, and when Daniel is about to rescue her, things take an unexpected turn.

1.title: FR - Hotel Costiera - S01E06 - Alice
1.plot: Daniel, his team, and Alice’s family must all collaborate to come up with a plan to get the necklace to the gang holding Alice. But despite the scheming, the auction gets intense and filled with unexpected twists. Daniel will have to come up with another plan to save the day. Will Daniel’s secret backup plan work? Will Alice return safely in the arms of her father?

meta.plot: Daniel de Luca, un ex-Marine au passé mystérieux, résout des problèmes à l'hôtel Villa Costiera. Mais pendant qu'il s'occupe des riches clients de l'établissement, Daniel est sur la trace d'Alice, une fille disparue qui a de sérieux ennuis.

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Premiere episode - 1
1.plot: The youngest head of the Israeli Security Agency in the nation’s history must confront a massive leak that threatens to upend both his career and the organization.

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Who can he trust?
1.plot: His greatest fear comes true and everyone closest to him becomes a suspect. Who can he trust?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Itamar Crosses the Lines
1.plot: His most important agent is in danger, and to save her he is about to cross the lines for the first time. How far will Itamar go?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The most loyal or the most dangerous?
1.plot: Is Scully, the closest and most loyal man to Itamar, also the most dangerous man? Is Itamar's most important operation at risk?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - The Turning Point
1.plot: The turning point of the season from the first minute to the last. Will Itamar be able to solve everything?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Trap
1.plot: The head of the Shin Bet makes an extreme move. What is he about to discover and is everything about to change?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Brilliant operation or dangerous mistake
1.plot: The head of the Shin Bet sends fighters to an operation in Gaza. A brilliant move? Or a mistake that will cost him dearly?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Suspect in the House
1.plot: Itamar's wife becomes the main suspect, but what if he's wrong?

1.title: FR - Trust No One [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Season Finale
1.plot: What will happen to his son? What is his wife planning? Who is the leaker? And what will happen to the head?

meta.plot: La série suit la vie d'Itamar Molcho, directeur du Shin Bet (service de sécurité intérieure israélien), durant un mois tumultueux qui bouleverse sa vie professionnelle et personnelle. Au fil des épisodes, la plus grave fuite de l'histoire du Shin Bet est révélée, faisant naître des soupçons qui planent sur tous ses proches.

L'inspectrice spéciale Hulda Hermannsdóttir s'attaque à une dernière affaire classée avant d'être contrainte à une retraite anticipée. Celle-ci concerne le meurtre mystérieux et choquant d'un jeune demandeur d'asile russe survenu un an auparavant.

1.title: FR - Dimma - S01E01 - The Mountain of Pigs
1.plot: As Hulda unwillingly approaches retirement, a year after the unexpected death of her daughter Dimma, she is faced with a case of a missing woman that consumes her entirely.

1.title: FR - Dimma - S01E02 - Hello Old friend
1.plot: Frustrated by the arrival of a new partner, Lukas, Hulda wades through the complex and corrupt world of refugees in Iceland to uncover a possible prostitution ring.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E01 - Perpetratin'
1.plot: Autumn Night, a mysterious beauty with a harrowing past washes up on the shores of the Pynk seeking employment. Mercedes Sundayz, a night headlined by the club's OG, brings unexpected trouble from a number of patrons.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E02 - Scars
1.plot: The Pynk's annual carwash receives a visit from a surprising guest while Autumn's past comes back to haunt her. Back at the club, souls are bared, and deals are negotiated in the private booths.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E03 - Higher Ground
1.plot: Autumn dons a bold new look and learns the rules of working a "regular" from The "Trinity," each of whom receives a visit from her favorite repeat customer. Uncle Clifford learns about big changes coming to Chucalissa.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E04 - The Trap
1.plot: Mercedes and Autumn make major moves toward building new lives for themselves. At the Pynk, gossip spreads like wildfire, and patrons flood in for a big night.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E05 - Belly
1.plot: Two foes find themselves trapped together for a weekend under unlikely circumstances. Keyshawn reaches new heights, and Lil' Murda glows up big time.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E06 - Legacy
1.plot: All throughout the Pynk, surprising new bonds are formed as everyone fights to secure their bag and their future. Andre faces pushback on his deal with the warring Kyle brothers.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E07 - Last Call For Alcohol
1.plot: Uncle Clifford goes to war for the hearts and minds of Chucalissa.;back at the club, the Pynk family comes together to prepare for its biggest night yet.

1.title: FR - P-Valley - S01E08 - Murda Night
1.plot: Folks from Biloxi to Atlanta pack out the Pynk to see two shining stars on a unforgettable night. Meanwhile, Autumn's past finally catches up with her. Season Finale.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E01 - Pussyland
2.plot: Still reeling from the events of Murda Night, the Pynk family faces off against a new foe: Rona.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E02 - Seven Pounds of Pressure
2.plot: While The Pynk staff prepares for their biggest night yet, Uncle Clifford reaches a personal milestone.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E03 - The Dirty Dozen
2.plot: Keyshawn and Lil’ Murda embark on a new adventure. Meanwhile, Mercedes ventures into uncharted territory.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E04 - Demethrius
2.plot: While Keyshawn’s glow-up continues, Big Teak struggles with life on the outside. Back in Chucalissa, The Pynk is visited by a surprise guest.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E05 - White Knights
2.plot: Sit on down and get ready to learn the history of Mississippi...

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E06 - Savage
2.plot: Andre’s mayoral campaign picks up speed as Autumn and Uncle Clifford wage war. Mercedes finds herself further entangled in Memphis. Back in Chucalissa, Lil’ Murda helps Big Teak find his footing in a broken new world.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E07 - Jackson
2.plot: Uncle Clifford wrestles with her future while opening the door to the past. Meanwhile, Mercedes struggles with the complexities of motherhood.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E08 - The Death Drop
2.plot: Some folks across Chucalissa fight for what’s theirs, while others struggle to accept the things they can’t change.

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E09 - Snow
2.plot: The Pynk framily shows up and shows out, giving folks a night they won’t ever forget...

2.title: FR - P-Valley - S02E10 - Mississippi Rule
2.plot: It’s the big finale, y’all. New beginnings and endings abound in Chucalissa.

meta.plot: Au fin fond du delta du Mississippi se trouve une oasis de paillettes au milieu de trajectoires humaines violentes où la beauté peut-être difficile à trouver. Chaque épisode retrace l’histoire kaléidoscopique d’un petit club de strip-tease où des personnages haut en couleurs franchissent ses portes, qu’ils soient brisés par la vie, plein d’espoir ou complètement perdus.

Lorsque Thony De La Rosa, une médecin cambodgienne, vient aux États-Unis pour faire soigner son fils, elle découvre que son chemin ne sera pas aussi simple qu'elle l'avait espéré. Alors que le système lui fait rapidement défaut, la poussant à se cacher, elle décide de ne pas se laisser abattre et marginaliser, et devient une femme de ménage pour le crime organisé. Utilisant sa ruse et son intelligence, Thony se fraye un chemin dans la pègre, faisant tout ce qu'elle doit pour survivre.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E01 - TNT
1.plot: Thony, a whip-smart Cambodian doctor, struggles to make ends meet as an undocumented worker after coming to the U.S. from the Philippines in search of a medical treatment for her ailing son. After witnessing a murder, Thony cleans the crime scene to stay alive, then begins living a double life, cleaning for a crime syndicate while doing what is necessary to save her son.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E02 - The Lion's Den
1.plot: Thony attempts to sever ties with the crime syndicate when the FBI comes asking questions. But when her son’s health declines, she crosses a moral line, getting deeper involved with the syndicate. Meanwhile, things turn violent during a weapons exchange when inventory goes missing and Arman has 24 hours to find the thief.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E03 - Legacy
1.plot: Thony is given a dire ultimatum by Garrett that could compromise her son's access to medical treatment. Arman is tasked with collecting large "donations" for Hayak's daughter's wedding, calling into question his real role within the family. Meanwhile, a rift forms between Fiona and her son, Chris, when a secret is revealed that has major consequences for his future, sending Fiona into a spiral as she tries to find a solution.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E04 - Kabayan
1.plot: Facing a heartbreaking setback with Luca's treatment, Thony desperately takes matters into her own hands. But when a potential donor refuses to participate, she turns to Arman for help, who escalates the situation to get results. Meanwhile, Garrett makes a risky demand of Thony, pushing her deeper into moral ambiguity.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E05 - The Icebox
1.plot: When a party bus cleanup job takes a turn for the worse, and Garrett puts Thony in a threatening position, she must choose between her loyalty to Arman and saving Fiona from deportation. Meanwhile, after all his efforts to secure a new business for Hayak, Arman is blindsided when Hayak chooses his daughter over him.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E06 - Mother's Mission
1.plot: Since their brush with ICE, Fiona and Thony’s relationship is strained, as a result of Thony’s lies. Meanwhile, Arman uses Thony’s relationship with Garrett to feed information to the FBI. Then, as Luca’s health declines, Thony must decide if she can work with Mother Donna, who may be a potential resource for a liver transplant for Luca, but at what cost to Thony.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E07 - Our Father, Who Art in Vegas
1.plot: Thony's marital issues are amplified as Marco begins asking tough questions about her methods of getting Luca life-saving treatments. Meanwhile, Arman is determined to make his way out from under Hayak, but Garrett is hell-bent on foiling his plans.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E08 - Full on Gangsta
1.plot: Thony enlists Arman’s help to get to Mexico for Luca’s transplant, but plans go dangerously off course when Hayak finds out Arman is lying to him. Thony finds herself in a desperate situation, forcing her to call upon both the former doctor and the newfound “gangsta” in herself.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E09 - Coming Home Again
1.plot: Arman's fallout with Hayak has severe consequences for Thony, who must now find her way back home from Mexico with Luca. In hiding, Arman tries to help Thony get back, but it is Garrett who steps in to get Thony across the border where, upon re-entry, things aren't what they seem.

1.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S01E10 - The Crown
1.plot: In need of a way out, Thony tries to make a deal with Garrett to save herself and help Arman; Loyalties are put to the test as families both unite and fall apart.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E01 - Sins of the Father
2.plot: Season Two picks up with Thony desperately trying to find her son, Luca, after he was kidnapped by his father Marco. With nowhere else to turn, she enlists the help of FBI Agent Garrett Miller to track him down before they leave the country. Meanwhile, an incident involving Chris forces Fiona to shield her son by any means necessary.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E02 - Lolo and Lola
2.plot: Thony's in-laws (Fiona's loving-yet-overbearing father and reserved-yet-strong mother) come to Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Thony must help Arman by meeting with Robert Kamdar, Nadia's gregarious and charming ex-lover.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E03 - El Diablo Que Conoces
2.plot: Thony must team up with Arman and Nadia in a new money-making venture to save Luca's life. Meanwhile, Fiona works to keep Chris out of trouble when the threat of evidence arises.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E04 - Bahala Na
2.plot: After Fiona puts herself in a dangerous situation, Thony resorts to calling Arman for help, which continues to drive a wedge between Arman and Nadia. Meanwhile, Garrett works to get put back on the Cortez case, and Chris struggles with the emotional aftermath of recent events.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E05 - The Brit
2.plot: Arman and Nadia attempt to take control of their drug-selling venture when they realize Thony’s ethical methods aren’t making them enough money. Meanwhile, Fiona takes the lead on starting her and Thony’s new cleaning business and Garrett is one step closer to solving the Cortes case.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E06 - Paradise Lost
2.plot: An unexpected trio emerges in the mission to take down Cortés, as Arman and Nadia's relationship hits a breaking point. Meanwhile, Fiona attempts to keep her family safe as Chris continues to grieve.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E07 - Truth or Consequences
2.plot: Detective Flores digs deeper into the cause of Marco's death. Meanwhile, Thony, Arman and Garrett team up to bring down Kamdar.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E08 - Spousal Privilege
2.plot: JD temporarily takes in Fiona and the kids during a time of need. Meanwhile, Garrett changes strategies in his attempt to stop Kamdar.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E09 - The Ask
2.plot: As Luca grows sicker, Thony will do anything to get him a new medication, including asking Kamdar for help. Meanwhile, Arman confronts Nadia about her secret.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E10 - Trust
2.plot: As Arman and Nadia plan their most dangerous scheme yet, Thony questions her alliances, especially with Luca's health deteriorating. Meanwhile, Garrett zeroes in on a suspect in Maya's death.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E11 - Sanctuary
2.plot: Thony is confronted by Garrett regarding the truth behind Maya's death as Nadia tries to stay on Kamdar's good side. Meanwhile, Fiona helps Luca celebrate his birthday.

2.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S02E12 - At Long Last
2.plot: After Thony, Arman and Garrett work together to come up with a plan to take down Kamdar once and for all, Thony decides to take things into her own hands to ensure the safety of Fiona and Luca. Season finale.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E01 - Arman
3.plot: When Arman mysteriously disappears, Thony and Nadia begrudgingly team up to look for him. Meanwhile, Fiona tries to manage the aftermath of her deportation to the Philippines and reconnects with an old flame.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E02 - For My Son
3.plot: Thony turns to Ramona to get Fiona back to the United States but finds herself indebted. Meanwhile, a secret Fiona has kept hidden for decades comes to light, creating friction between herself and family members.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E03 - El Camino del Diablo
3.plot: When Thony is tasked with cleaning cars for Ramona, she comes across a distressed woman in need of medical attention. Fiona attempts to return to the States and Nadia confronts Agent Russo for information about Arman's disappearance.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E04 - Agua, Fuego, Tierra, Viento
3.plot: As Luca's CPS interview nears, Thony focuses on getting Fiona back home with the help of Jorge. Meanwhile, Nadia continues to investigate Arman's disappearance and finds herself face-to-face with Ramona.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E05 - All of Me
3.plot: When Thony and Fiona are faced with a terrifying situation, they set out to fix it before it's too late. Meanwhile, Jorge throws a wrench in Ramona's plan to find Arman, and Ramona starts to question his allegiance.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E06 - El Reloj
3.plot: Thony gets a new lead on Arman's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Ramona tries to cut a deal with Nadia and Luca attends his first day of school.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E07 - Velorio
3.plot: Ramona grows increasingly more apprehensive of Thony's involvement in Arman's life and suspects Thony and Nadia of jeopardizing her and Jorge's plans. Meanwhile, Jeremy volunteers to install security equipment at Fiona's house.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E08 - Know Thy Enemy
3.plot: As Thony starts to spiral, Fiona grows tired of her antics and goes to Russo for help. Meanwhile, Ramona and Jorge focus on cleaning up Arman's mess, ensuring nothing can be traced back to them.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E09 - From the Ashes
3.plot: Ramona considers an offer from Thony that causes a shift in their dynamic. Jorge teams up with Nadia as a way to use her connections and Russo's team gets closer to breaking their case open.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E10 - Smoke and Mirrors
3.plot: After finding hidden cameras in her home, Thony attempts to get her family's normal life back by turning down a powerful offer from Ramona. Meanwhile, Jorge proposes a new money-laundering venture to Nadia. Then, Ramona and Jorge's properties are searched by the FBI after Russo obtains a warrant against them.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E11 - Fight or Flight
3.plot: As Ramona continues her attempts to recruit Thony into her business, Thony and Fiona work with the FBI to help Nadia. Meanwhile, the FBI starts organizing a plan to take down Ramona inside her own event.

3.title: FR - The Cleaning Lady - S03E12 - House of Cards
3.plot: Russo receives a terrifying warning from Sin Cara and Jorge gets news that could alter his alliances.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E01 - #Pilot
1.plot: Sassy Sam Puckett (Jennette McCurdy) and eccentric Cat Valentine (Ariana Grande) buddy up as roommates after Sam rescues Cat from a garbage truck.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E02 - #FavoriteShow
1.plot: Sam and Cat attempt to save their favorite TV show from being cancelled while babysitting two boys.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E03 - #TheBritBrats
1.plot: Sam and Cat babysit two polite, British girls. Sam tries to fulfill a community service requirement at Elderly Acres.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E04 - #NewGoat

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E05 - #TextingCompetition
1.plot: Cat persuades Sam to enter a texting competition where she faces off against a sweet boy with domineering mother. Dice attempts to dodge his annoying old pal.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E06 - #BabysitterWar
1.plot: A client compliments one of the girls, but Sam and Cat aren't sure to whom he was referring, so they get competitive and try to outshine each other as babysitters.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E07 - #GoomerSitting
1.plot: Sam and Cat agree to babysit Goomer while Dice is away; Goomer loses his eyesight before a big match.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E08 - #ToddlerClimbing
1.plot: Sam and Cat confront a competing babysitting service when they post bad reviews about Sam and Cat's babysitting service.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E09 - #MommaGoomer
1.plot: Dice enlists the help of Sam and Cat to convince Goomer's mother that Goomer is a high school teacher.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E10 - #BabysittingCommercial
1.plot: Sam and Cat make a commercial for their business that features Dice's dog. A family claims that Dice's dog belongs to them.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E11 - #RevengeOfTheBritBrats

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E12 - #MotorcycleMystery
1.plot: Sam, Dice, and Goomer go to a mixed-martial arts fight, leaving Cat at home to study. Sam's motorcycle goes missing. Cat loses her memory.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E13 - #SecretSafe
1.plot: Sam opens a safe in her bedroom and discovers a tunnel leading to a secret room. Cat films herself for 24 hours.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E14 - #OscarTheOuch
1.plot: Sam Puckett and Cat Valentine babysit a very accident-prone boy named Oscar. They then try their best to make Oscar have fun while keeping him safe. [

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E15 - #DollSitting
1.plot: Sam and Cat are hired to baby-sit a doll on Halloween. Cat thinks she turned Dice into a monkey.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E16 - #PeezyB
1.plot: Sam gets a job as the assistant to the huge rap star Peezy B. Cat finds babysitting much more challenging without Sam around to help.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E17 - #SalmonCat
1.plot: An old TV show's title causes problems for the girls because it's similar to their business's name, so Sam and Cat try to find the show's creators, who are in the midst of a long-standing feud.

1.title: FR - Sam & Cat - S01E18 - #Twinfection
1.plot: Cat pranks Sam by using a pair of twins they're watching, and Sam gets even by pranking Cat with Melanie, Sam's twin sister.

meta.plot: Sam & Cat est une sitcom américaine pour adolescents qui a été créée le 8 juin 2013 sur Nickelodeon. Il s'agit d'un spin-off croisé d'iCarly et de Victorious. Il met en vedette Jennette McCurdy dans le rôle de Sam Puckett et Ariana Grande dans le rôle de Cat Valentine. Les filles se rencontrent par hasard au cours d'une aventure bizarre et deviennent colocataires, puis lancent une entreprise de baby-sitting pour gagner de l'argent supplémentaire.

meta.plot: Léa, 28 ans, est l'une des rares femmes rabbins de France : frêles épaules, grandes responsabilités puisqu'elle doit trouver les réponses dans le labyrinthe de petites et de grandes questions de la vie des gens. Mais comment être un guide pour les autres quand on est soi-même aux prises avec les fondamentaux de l'amour, de la famille et en quête de sens ?

L'histoire se répète quand les invités se retrouvent coincés et disparaissent les uns après les autres, de manière de plus en plus brutale.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The Savage family discovers that yet another housekeeper has quit and, while the boys see this as their dad's opportunity to hire a cute French maid, Nick decides it's time his boys learn how to take care of themselves. Stunned, the boys decide that they need a plan to change their dad's mind.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E02 - Tutoring
1.plot: It's progress report time at school, and while the Savage boys – with the exception of Sam – are far from straight A students, Nick can't ignore the fact that Chris is failing five classes this year. The greatest shock is that studious Sam is failing a class, and when the guys find out it's gym, he becomes the butt of everyone's humor in this jock-filled household. When Sam agrees to tutor Chris so he won't be kicked off the football team in exchange for the coach giving him a passing grade in P.E., Sam soon realizes he got the short end of the rope.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E03 - Almost Men in Uniform
1.plot: When Nick and his brother, Jimmy, are called in to work unexpectedly, Nick is forced to take the younger boys, T. J. and Kyle, with him to the fire station, which leaves Sam, Jack and Chris home alone. The boys recently found out that people give firemen in uniform free stuff as a way of showing their gratitude. When they combine this knowledge with the fact that Jimmy just dropped off a bunch of Nick's freshly cleaned uniforms from the dry cleaners, they put two and two together, which equals a heap of trouble.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E04 - Nick Kicks Butt
1.plot: Nick is forced to confront the boys when he finds a pack of cigarettes in the house, and when the guilty party reluctantly owns up to them, he calls Nick on his hypocrisy, as Nick himself smokes cigars. In an effort to convince his son to quit, Nick makes a deal with him that he finds very hard to keep.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E05 - Car Jack
1.plot: When Jack begs his dad to get him his own car, Nick agrees to put up half the money if Jack will raise the other half and, after a series of schemes, he finally comes up with it. Jack's Uncle Jimmy takes him to get the car, but when he comes home with a motorcycle instead, Nick is none too pleased and shows the boys a "Blood on the Highway" – type safety video – which doesn't deter Jack or his brothers one bit.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E06 - Free Lily
1.plot: It's Halloween, and the Savage boys are trying to figure out what to do for their annual prank. Kyle feels he's too old for trick or treating this year, leaving Nick and T.J. to go it alone. When Chris is forced to dissect a frog in class, he gets the idea – via a spooky visit from the ghost of the late class frog – of just what to do for their prank this year.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E07 - For Whom the Cell Tolls
1.plot: Sam's love, Angela, has a new boyfriend, and so Jack, noticing how depressed Sam is, encourages him to go to the mall with him to meet someone else. Sam reluctantly agrees, and when Jack introduces him to a very good looking girl, Erin, Sam can hardly believe it when she agrees to go out with him. It becomes apparent very quickly, however, that Erin's main priority is talking on her cell phone instead of actually talking to him. Meanwhile, Chris has taken a job selling glider planes from a cart in the mall.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E08 - Carnival Knowledge
1.plot: When the boys find out a church carnival is in town, they're all excited to go – each for his own reasons. Jack and Chris devise a plan to pick up on girls who have already entered the fair so they won't have to pay for their admission, and although trying to woo Angela, Sam reluctantly accepts her idea that they can go to the carnival as "friends." Meanwhile, as the boys are causing chaos at the fair, T.J. has to finish his school report before he can go, but when he's done, the dog eats the memory stick containing his report... and T.J. has a very hard time convincing Nick that the dog really did eat his homework.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E09 - My Two Sons
1.plot: In an effort to get him out of the house, the boys decide it's time for Nick to meet a woman. Their attempt at setting him up via an internet dating service backfires, however. When he does find someone he's interested in – Maggie – Nick is afraid she'll be scared off if he tells her the truth about having five sons.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E10 - Thanksgiving With the Savages
1.plot: Nick is excited to spend Thanksgiving – his favorite holiday – with his family, but much to his disappointment, Sam decides to spend it with his girlfriend Angela's family, whom he considers more "civilized." Plans are interrupted, though, when Nick and Jimmy are unexpectedly called away on a fire, so the boys decide to surprise Nick by making Thanksgiving dinner on their own. In looking up the proper way to cook a turkey online, they find a video of Thanksgiving safety tips hosted by none other than Officer Cox. However the stores are now sold out of turkeys, so they resort to buying a live one – and get more than they bargained for. Meanwhile, Sam soon learns that there's more to Angela's seemingly perfect family than meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E11 - The Man Without a Ball
1.plot: When Nick leaves the boys to rake the yard while he goes off to golf with Jimmy, they decide instead to play a game of "rake ball," but accidentally hit their dad's championship baseball over the fence and into mean old Mrs. Riley's yard. When Mrs. Riley refuses to give the ball back, it turns into an all-out feud.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E12 - Voodude
1.plot: Kyle finds himself smitten with Josie, a girl he is used to spending time with in detention, but fears having a girlfriend will turn him into a "wuss." Meanwhile, T.J. and the boys are hard at work on a "destructo-boggan" which is guaranteed to knock all of the inner tubes off the slopes this year, and Sam is poodle-sitting his girlfriend Angela's dog, Sally Sue, which doesn't sit well with the Savage dog.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E13 - Savage XXX-mas
1.plot: Eager to earn money to buy Christmas gifts for their girlfriends, the three older boys find jobs at a lingerie store, but their jobs turn out to be less than glamorous and tensions arise when Sam gets promoted and Chris and Jack are left to do the grunt work. Meanwhile the two younger boys, Evan and T.J., are less than thrilled when Nick puts them to work helping with the fire station's annual toy drive for needy kids.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E14 - Save a Dance For Me
1.plot: Chris is thrilled when he is asked to the "Backwards Dance," in which the girls ask the boys, by Jessica, the hottest girl in school. The only problem is that Jessica is the leader of the dance squad, and Chris – who is a terrible dancer – will have to dance with her in front of the entire school. Meanwhile, there's trouble in paradise when Angela and Sam disagree on plans for the dance; and, in their quest to film each other doing dumb things for an America's Funniest Home Videos-style website, Kyle and T.J. finally drive Nick to the breaking point.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E15 - Teen Things I Hate About You
1.plot: Tired of coming home to a house full of teenagers every Saturday night, Nick brings the boys with him to a town meeting to encourage the city to open a teen center. Nick is none too pleased when they agree, however, as he is given the task of supervising the kids. The boys aren't thrilled either when Nick turns out to be a real stickler for the rules – as opposed to their fun Uncle Jimmy.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E16 - Saving Old Lady Riley
1.plot: The boys administer their own form of CPR – complete with bicycle pump and toilet plunger – on Old Lady Riley when she has a heart attack on their doorstep, and are then wrongfully lauded as heroes. But when they're awarded the "Caring Kid Award," it's just too much to take for one onlooker who happens to know the truth.

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E17 - Crimes and Mini-Wieners
1.plot: The principal suspects Kyle, Chris and Sam of starting a food fight and makes them serve as lunch ladies in the school cafeteria for a week as punishment. Meanwhile, Nick is having to work the night shift, and Jack tricks him into hiring April – a girl he has a crush on – to baby-sit T.J..

1.title: FR - Les Sauvages - S01E18 - Bad Reception
1.plot: Sam asks Nick and the boys to finally meet his girlfriend Angela's family at her grandmother's birthday party, but they opt to stay home and watch the Super Bowl instead. When their cable goes out in the middle of the game, however, they go over to the quiet birthday party and turn it into their annual Savage Super Bowl Party. Meanwhile, Sam has put together a birthday surprise for Angela's grandmother, which doesn't quite turn out as planned.

meta.plot: Elevés par un père célibataire, les frères Savages ont épuisé une bonne vingtaine de gouvernantes. Produite entre autres par Mel Gibson, cette sitcom s'inspire de sa propre expérience de père d'une famille nombreuse.

meta.plot: Après avoir été violée, Amélie, une femme de chambre, développe des super pouvoirs qui lui permettent d'identifier et de combattre les délinquants sexuels. Elle juge le bien et le mal et réprime son propre traumatisme… Jusqu’à ce qu’elle rencontre de manière inattendue son propre violeur. La série explore les thèmes du traumatisme, de la justice et de la rédemption, tout en offrant une perspective féministe sur la lutte contre les violences sexuelles. Programmation spéciale à l’occasion de la Journée internationale pour l'élimination de la violence à l'égard des femmes.

meta.plot: La vie de Françoise, hôtesse de l’air à la retraite, et de sa fille Sophie volent en éclat le jour où leur mari et père, JP, est enlevé. Sophie découvre alors que sa mère et son père étaient des agents pour le compte de l’Etat dans un département non officiel de restitution d'œuvres d’art : toute sa vie est bâtie sur un mensonge. En échange du père, le ravisseur, Thompson, ne demande rien de moins que "Leda et le Cygne", un tableau de Léonard de Vinci disparu depuis plus de trois siècles. Françoise va devoir faire équipe avec sa fille, qui lui en a toujours voulu d’être une mère absente…

meta.plot: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.

Un jour miraculeux, dans une petite ville rurale du Wisconsin, les morts sortent soudain de leurs tombes. Mais ce n’est pas une histoire de zombies : les revenants sont exactement comme avant, en chair, en os… et apparemment bien vivants. Quand Dana Cypress, flic locale et mère célibataire, se retrouve plongée au cœur d’un meurtre aussi violent qu’inexplicable, elle doit démêler les fils d’une affaire qui plonge la ville dans la peur et la paranoïa. Car désormais, qu’on soit mort ou vivant, tout le monde est suspect.

Autrefois, les Sept Grands régnaient sur leurs domaines respectifs à Twisted-Wonderland, un monde rempli de magie. Leurs glorieuses actions ont fait d’eux des légendes et la prestigieuse université de magie Night Raven dédia ses sept dortoirs à ces illustres figures : la Reine de Cœur, le Roi des animaux, la Sorcière des mers, le Sorcier des sables, la plus belle Reine, le Roi des Enfers et la Fée des ronces. Mais Yuken (Yu), un jeune lycéen, ignorait l’existence de ce monde avant d’être transporté en pleine nuit à la cérémonie de bienvenue de l’académie Night Raven. Il doit maintenant affronter des monstres, des apprentis magiciens fantasques et des situations mystérieuses, tout ça, sans posséder de magie. Yu réussira-t-il à retourner dans son monde ?

FR - Les secrets du Skinwalker Ranch - S02E06 - Skin Deep

3.plot: When the team conducts their most ambitious experiment yet at the Triangle, they are shocked by what appears in the sky above Skinwalker Ranch.

3.plot: After another season of shocking discoveries, the team reviews all the strange experiences and compelling evidence of the last three years.

4.plot: Ranch owner Brandon Fugal and his team, led by chief investigator Erik Bard and astrophysicist, aerospace engineer and optical scientist Dr. Travis Taylor, elevate their investigation of the mysterious 512-acre Utah property as they work to reveal the truth.

4.plot: After discovering new evidence of massive metallic objects buried beneath the Mesa, the team conducts an experiment at the Triangle that leads to one of the most shocking revelations ever seen on Skinwalker Ranch.

4.plot: The team turns their focus back to the mesa and almost immediately gets more evidence of something buried deep within it; Brandon returns to the ranch with Utah's Attorney General, who is eager to find out who is monitoring the ranch.

4.plot: As the team conducts their most complex experiment ever at the Triangle, they are stunned as a number of bizarre events unfold before their eyes.

4.plot: After conducting an experiment that reveals more evidence of incredible phenomena in the skies above Skinwalker Ranch, the team learns that the greatest mystery of the property may actually be located deep underground.

meta.plot:
Alors que la plupart des gens se tournent vers les étoiles pour trouver une vie extraterrestre, un groupe de chercheurs fait le contraire : ils cherchent sous terre. Depuis plus de 200 ans, le ranch Skinwalker de l'Utah a été le témoin de centaines d'activités paranormales et d'ovnis.

Malgré des décennies d'études, dont certaines sont secrètement financées par le gouvernement américain, personne n'a osé chercher dans les sols. Aujourd'hui, le légendaire ranch donne un accès complet à une équipe qui se prépare à faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E01 - The Magic Xylophone
1.plot: As Bluey and Bingo squabble over their magic xylophone (that has the power to freeze Dad in space and time) Dad seizes control and freezes Bluey, leaving Bingo as her only hope.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E04 - Daddy Robot
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo don't want to tidy the playroom, so they get Daddy Robot to do it for them. But when Bluey takes things too far, Daddy Robot malfunctions with disastrous results.

1.plot: At the weekend, Bluey and Bingo are playing in the garden with Dad. But Bingo gets upset, when she discovers a walking leaf insect and Dad is too caught up in the game to notice.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E07 - BBQ
1.plot: It's lunchtime on Bluey's back deck! But every BBQ needs a side salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousins asked for!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E08 - Fruitbat
1.plot: Not wanting to go to bed, Bluey tries to dream about being a nocturnal fruit bat so she can stay up all night long and soon finds herself flying through the night sky.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E09 - Horsey Ride
1.plot: When Bluey forgets to put her favourite toy away, cousin Socks grabs it and won't let go! The kids stage a horsey wedding to distract her, with Dad and Uncle Stripe as the horses!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E10 - Hotel
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them the importance of compromise.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E11 - Bike
1.plot: At the park, Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E12 - Bob Bilby
1.plot: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E13 - Spy Game
1.plot: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game in the park, their device to control the grown-ups stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E14 - Takeaway
1.plot: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway order, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E15 - Butterflies
1.plot: Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E16 - Yoga Ball
1.plot: Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E17 - Calypso
1.plot: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E18 - The Doctor
1.plot: Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo's as the other, more exciting injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E19 - The Claw
1.plot: When Bluey and Bingo are unable to grab a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum and Dad create their own version at home. But Dad isn't about to make winning easy.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E20 - Markets
1.plot: When Bluey visits the markets with five bucks from the tooth fairy, the options are endless. But as she and Indy scour the stalls for the perfect purchase, spending it proves hard.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E21 - Blue Mountains
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets, exploring the land beyond the Blue Mountains where they outsmart the Cheeky Fox to find the softest beds in the world.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E22 - The Pool
1.plot: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E23 - Shops
1.plot: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E24 - Wagonride
1.plot: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E25 - Taxi
1.plot: Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E26 - The Beach
1.plot: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E27 - Pirates
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo and Missy pretend to be pirates on the hamock swing at the park playground. Missy is frightened of the journey on the imaginary ship, but faces her fear to rescue her friends from the inside stomach of a whale.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E28 - Grannies
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo dress up as grandmothers, but disagree on if grandmothers are able to perform the floss dance or not. Bluey proves that they are not by video calling Nana, but when this upsets Bingo, Bluey decides to teach Nana the dance so that Bingo will keep playing.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E29 - The Creek
1.plot: Dad takes Bluey, Bingo and Mackenzie to the creek after they grow tired of the local playground. Bluey struggles to appreciate the beauty of the natural world surrounding her, until they arrive at the water. Bluey learns to step out of her comfort zone and try new things.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E30 - Fairies
1.plot: When the family suspects that their house has been invaded by fairies, Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad go on a hunt to search for and capture the invisible creatures. Dad accidentally hurts Bingo's feelings and makes it up to her by outsmarting the fairies.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E31 - Work
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo roleplay a day at work. Dad acts as the boss of a drainpipe factory and hires Bluey and Bingo after their successful interviews. The day takes a turn when Bluey takes control of the company and fires Dad for his breach of the strict "no dancing" rules.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E32 - Bumpy and the Wise Old Wolfhound
1.plot: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and her Dad make, and send her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E33 - Trampoline
1.plot: When Dad has to stop having fun with the girls and go to work, Bluey and Bingo scramble to keep him playing games with them on the trampoline at the same time.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E34 - The Dump
1.plot: Dad takes Bluey and Bingo on a car trip to the dump to throw away rubbish. Bluey asks Dad a range of questions on the way and he proclaims that he knows everything. But when they arrive, Bluey is saddened to learn that he is throwing away her old drawings.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E35 - Zoo
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo set up a pretend zoo at home in the backyard, with Bluey acting as the zookeeper who takes Bingo and Mum on a tour around the grounds. Bluey must devise a plan to catch the baboon (Dad) when he escapes the enclosure and takes Bingo along with him.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E36 - Backpackers
1.plot: Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks roleplay a pretend backpacking adventure around the backyard. The children become the backpacks as Mum and Dad are tasked with carrying them around while exploring their holiday destination.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E37 - The Adventure
1.plot: Bluey plays with Chloe and pretends to be a horse as she accompanies the princess on an imaginary adventure to find food at the family farm. The friends swap roles and adopt a variety of personas as they save the kingdom from an evil queen.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E38 - Copycat
1.plot: Dad wakes to find Bluey copying his every move. While the pair are playing outside, Bluey finds an injured budgie. They take the bird to the vet and learn that it has died. When they get home, Bluey reenacts the events with Bingo to cope with the budgie's death.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E39 - The Sleepover
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo's cousin Muffin arrives for a sleepover in an extremely tired state. Uncle Stripe explains that Muffin is transitioning from her daily naps. The sisters stay up late and play a game with Muffin, before helping her get to sleep when they realise she is exhausted.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E40 - Early Baby
1.plot: When Rusty and Indy's two separate games at Bluey's playgroup come into conflict, the groups explain their different activities to each other. After sharing, the friends find common ground with their games, and they decide to play together.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E41 - Mums and Dads
1.plot: While playing "Mums and Dads", Rusty and Indy have a disagreement about which parent should work, leading them to play separately. However, when they find that their friends have different ideas about how to play the game, the pair return to playing with each other again.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E42 - Hide and Seek
1.plot: Bluey plays Hide and Seek with Bingo, Mum and Dad, but is quickly distracted by her toys, leaving her family hiding around the house undiscovered. When she slows down and focuses, Bluey remembers the game and successfully finds her family.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E43 - Camping
1.plot: Bluey meets a French Labrador called Jean-Luc while on a camping trip with her family. The pair play together and build a camp site, but when Dad acts as a wild pig, the pair must find a way to communicate to combat the pig. Bluey is saddened when Jean-Luc leaves.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E44 - Mount Mumandad
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo pretend that Mum and Dad are a mountain when they are tasked with playing a game without their parents' participation. Bluey races ahead to reach the summit while Bingo brings along a backpack to carry the climbing equipment.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E45 - Kids
1.plot: During a visit to the supermarket, Bluey adopts the role of the parent while Dad must act as the child alongside Bingo. When he tries to fill the trolley with the groceries, Dad gets in trouble with Bluey for being a disobedient child.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E46 - Chickenrat
1.plot: Before bed, Bingo loses her favourite cuddly toy. Mum helps Bluey and Bingo retrace their steps to find the lost item. The siblings recount their adventures as they remember playing with Dad, who was pretending to be a "chickenrat" creature.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E47 - Neighbours
1.plot: Bluey builds a pretend house and gains some new neighbours when Bingo, Mum and Dad move into the street. Bluey must learn to get along with a difficult neighbour when Bingo invades her space and spills over onto her property.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E49 - Asparagus
1.plot: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to use manners while eating dinner at the dining table. However, when Mum gives Bluey a stick of asparagus which magically turns the family into animals, Bluey discovers the importance of manners while trying to control everyone.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E50 - Shaun
1.plot: Bluey and Bingo try to convince Dad to get a pet, but he insists that they already have a pet; a disobedient emu called Shaun. Dad's hand transforms into Shaun and the siblings learn how to look after their new pet by feeding, bathing and walking him.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E51 - Daddy Putdown
1.plot: While Mum is out for the night at a friend's baby shower, Dad must put Bluey and Bingo to bed as part of their evening routine. When the siblings are missing their mother, Bluey decides to set up a pretend baby shower of her own to take her mind off her anxiety.

1.title: FR - Bluey - S01E52 - Verandah Santa
1.plot: It's Christmas Eve and Dad and the kids are taking turns pretending to be Santa! But when Socks nips Bluey and Bluey refuses to leave her a present, they must all learn the true meaning of being good for Christmas.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E01 - Dance Mode
2.plot: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in 'Dance Mode' as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E02 - Hammerbarn
2.plot: On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour Bingo.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E03 - Featherwand
2.plot: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E04 - Squash
2.plot: When Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don’t always beat little siblings.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E05 - Hairdressers
2.plot: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Bert Handsome has nits! To help treat them, Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E06 - Stumpfest
2.plot: Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E07 - Favourite Thing
2.plot: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E08 - Daddy Dropoff
2.plot: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E09 - Bingo
2.plot: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E10 - Rug Island
2.plot: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything - bananas, campfires, even a snake! But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E11 - Charades
2.plot: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play Charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nanna must think quickly to keep the game on track.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E12 - Sticky Gecko
2.plot: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E13 - Dad Baby
2.plot: When Dad shows the kids how to use their old baby-harness, a new game is born: Dad Baby! But Dad is unprepared for the harsh realities of giving birth to a baby Bingo.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E14 - Mum School
2.plot: Bluey plays mum to a brood of bouncy balloons, including an irrepressible floater named Greenie. But she soon discovers that mothering is much harder than she imagined.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E15 - Trains
2.plot: All aboard the Dad Train! Bingo goes from home to daycare to her job at the vet every morning, but there's trouble on the line as a mischievous Bluey throws everyone off schedule.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E16 - Army
2.plot: Jack's the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

2.title: FR - Bluey - S02E17 - Fancy Restaurant
2.plot: Bingo and Bluey want Mum and Dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan until Chef Bingo's special arrives.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E01 - Perfect
3.plot: Bluey's Father's Day card has to be perfect but she can't decide what to draw! So Mum reminds her about all the fun times she's had with Dad and how he's not so perfect either.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E02 - Bedroom
3.plot: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E03 - Obstacle Course
3.plot: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E04 - Promises
3.plot: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E05 - Omelette
3.plot: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E06 - Born Yesterday
3.plot: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E07 - Mini Bluey
3.plot: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini Bluey!

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E08 - Unicorse
3.plot: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E09 - Curry Quest
3.plot: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E10 - Magic
3.plot: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule - never use magic for cheekiness!

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E11 - Chest
3.plot: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E12 - Sheep Dog
3.plot: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest. But looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E13 - Housework
3.plot: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E14 - Pass the Parcel
3.plot: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E15 - Explorers
3.plot: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E16 - Phones
3.plot: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E17 - Pavlova
3.plot: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Cafe in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

3.title: FR - Bluey - S03E18 - Rain
3.plot: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

meta.plot: Suivez les aventures de Bluey, qui vit avec sa mère, son père et sa sœur. Son énergie irrésistible et son esprit d'aventurière, l'emportent dans une série de situations tout autant drôles qu'imprévisibles.
